original_sentence: No matter how bad my mood is, that perfect combination is always enough to lift my spirits.
readingExamples: No matter how bad my mood is, that perfect combination is always enough to lift my spirits.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the way you feel at a particular time, e.g. happy, sad or angry
(2) n. the general atmosphere or feeling of a place, situation or piece of art
(3) n. a state of being angry or impatient for a period of time
(4) n. (grammar) a set of verb forms expressing fact, command, wish or possibility (indicative, imperative, subjunctive)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （语法）语气；情态
uncommonMeanings.example: In the sentence 'If I were you, I would apologize,' the verb sits in the subjunctive mood, signalling a situation contrary to reality. （议论文·语言知识·语法讲解）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 闷闷不乐的情绪；坏脾气发作
uncommonMeanings.example: Ever since he lost the finals, my brother had been in one of his moods, snapping at anyone who dared to knock on his door. （读后续写·家庭·情绪波动）

posExamples.sentence: The moment Grandma slid the tray of warm cookies onto the table, the sullen mood that had hung over the kitchen all afternoon melted away, and laughter came bubbling back into our little home. （读后续写·家庭·氛围转变）
I am writing to suggest that we play soft background music during the exam week, for a calming mood in the reading room could work wonders for students wrestling with pre-test anxiety. （应用文·建议信）
Far from being a trivial matter, one's mood profoundly shapes the quality of one's decisions; a mind clouded by anger rarely arrives at a wise judgement. （议论文·情绪与理性）
A gentle drizzle tapped against the window, and the whole café sank into a mellow, unhurried mood, as if time itself had agreed to slow down for us. （读后续写·环境渲染）

wordForms.other: moody adj. 喜怒无常的／闷闷不乐的（a moody teenager）；辨析 mood 心情≠mode /məʊd/ 方式、模式，勿混淆

idioms.idiom: be in the mood (for sth / to do sth)
idioms.example: After the long, gruelling hike, none of us were in the mood for cooking, so we simply flopped onto the grass and shared a bag of biscuits. （读后续写·旅行·疲惫）

idioms.idiom: be in no mood for sth / to do sth
idioms.example: Drenched to the skin and shivering, she was in no mood to listen to his excuses. （读后续写·冲突·情绪）

collocations.example: Having been punished by his teacher, he was in a very bad mood. 被老师惩罚后，他心情很糟。

collocations.phrase: be / feel in the (no) mood for sth / to do sth
collocations.example: The management is in no mood for compromise over this problem. 管理层没有心情就此问题妥协。
The mood of the conference was extremely encouraging. 会议的气氛非常鼓舞人心。

collocations.phrase: be in a good / bad mood
collocations.example: Grandma is always in a good mood when the whole family gathers for dinner. 全家一起吃饭时，奶奶总是心情很好。

collocations.phrase: be in the mood for sth / to do sth
collocations.example: After the long exam, I was not in the mood for talking. 长长的考试之后，我没心情说话。
Teenagers often experience sudden mood swings. 青少年常经历突然的情绪波动。
A gentle joke lifted the mood of the whole class. 一句温和的玩笑活跃了全班的气氛。

collocations.phrase: put sb in a good mood
collocations.example: The unexpected sight of cherry blossoms lining the school path put every passer-by in a wonderful mood. （读后续写·校园·环境）
Sensing the tension in the room, the teacher cracked a gentle joke to lighten the mood before announcing the results. （读后续写·课堂）
A sudden change of mood swept over the crowd the instant the national anthem began to play. （读后续写·集体场景）
During adolescence, frequent mood swings are perfectly normal and should be met with patience rather than blame. （议论文·青少年心理）
Soft candlelight and quiet piano music set the mood for a memorable family reunion. （应用文·活动策划）
The photograph perfectly captured the festive mood of the whole village on Spring Festival Eve. （读后续写·节日）
One thoughtless remark was enough to ruin the celebratory mood of the entire evening. （读后续写·冲突）
A good leader must learn to read the mood of a team and offer encouragement exactly when it is needed most. （议论文·领导力）

synonyms.example: A warm, welcoming atmosphere greeted us the moment we stepped through the door of the old bookshop. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: atmosphere 侧重某地或场合整体给人的感受(集体、环境);mood 既可指个人心情,也可指场景氛围,更强调情感色彩

synonyms.example: He struggled all his life to keep his fiery temper under control. （读后续写·人物性格）
synonyms.usage: temper 侧重易怒的性情或发怒状态(常与 lose/control 搭配);mood 中性得多,泛指一时的心情

synonyms.example: The good news lifted our spirits after weeks of disappointment. （读后续写·转折）
synonyms.usage: spirits 多与 high/low、lift/raise 搭配,侧重情绪的高低起伏;mood 更泛指当下的情绪状态

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·no matter how/疑问词+ever引导让步状语从句(vs名词性从句用whatever)
advancedExpressions.expression: no matter + 疑问词（how/when/what/where/who...）= 疑问词+ever，引导让步状语从句：No matter how (=However) busy she is, she still exercises every day. 注意：当 whoever/whichever/whatever 引导名词性从句（作主/宾/表语等句子成分）时，不能换成 no matter who/which/what。Whatever (≠ No matter what) you say is right.（此句 whatever 引导主语从句）。
advancedExpressions.example: No matter how bad my mood is, that perfect combination is always enough to lift my spirits. 不管我的心情有多糟糕，那种完美的结合总能振奋我的情绪。（课文原句，no matter how 引导让步状从）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·mood 三大高频搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: ①be in a good / bad mood 心情好／坏 ②be in the mood for sth / to do sth 有心情做某事（否定 be in no mood for / to do）③a mood swing 情绪波动。介词看清：状态用 in a mood，'想要做'用 in the mood for/to do。
advancedExpressions.example: I'm in a good mood today, but I'm really not in the mood for arguing—those constant mood swings of his exhaust me. 我今天心情不错，但我实在没心情吵架——他那忽好忽坏的情绪把我累坏了。

advancedExpressions.expression: mood（个人心情+场景氛围，最常用）/ atmosphere（某地整体氛围）/ temper（易怒的性情，lose one's temper）/ spirits（情绪高低，lift/raise one's spirits）。
advancedExpressions.example: Soft music set a relaxed mood; the whole café's atmosphere lifted everyone's spirits. 轻柔的音乐营造出放松的心情，整个咖啡馆的氛围让每个人都振奋起来。

advancedExpressions.expression: the whole ... seemed to sink into a ... mood, as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: As dusk deepened, the whole valley seemed to sink into a tranquil, dreamlike mood, as if nature herself were holding her breath. （拟人+明喻,续写渲染氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: a ... mood could work wonders for ...
advancedExpressions.example: A relaxed and encouraging mood in the classroom could work wonders for students who are afraid to speak up. （委婉建议,句式温和有说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: one's mood not only ... but also ...
advancedExpressions.example: One's mood not only colours the way one sees the world but also shapes how the world responds in return.

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was in a bad mood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A cloud of gloom seemed to settle over me that grey afternoon; try as I might to shake it off, the sour mood clung to my every thought like fog refusing to lift. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词具象化(A cloud of gloom settled) + 让步状语(try as I might) + 明喻(like fog refusing to lift)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Music can change people's mood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is widely acknowledged that a few bars of the right melody can lift a downcast mood in an instant, transforming a weary listener into someone ready to face the day anew. （议论文·正式论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is widely acknowledged that...客观化开头 + 现在分词状语(transforming...) + 具体化对比(downcast→ready to face)

classPractice.question: 我没有心情和你争辩。（用 be in no mood to do 完成句子）
classPractice.answer: I am in no mood to argue with you.
classPractice.note: 【课件】be in no mood to do sth 没有心情做某事；to do 用不定式

classPractice.type: 语境应用·按要求完成句子（翻译）
classPractice.question: 我发现他走进办公室的时候情绪不太好。（用 in a bad mood 完成句子）
classPractice.answer: I found he was in a bad mood when he entered the office.
classPractice.note: 【课件】in a bad mood 情绪不好；when 引导时间状语从句

classPractice.type: 语境应用·根据汉语提示完成句子
classPractice.question: I'll be your true friend, ____ (无论发生什么).
classPractice.answer: no matter what happens / whatever happens
classPractice.note: 【课件】no matter what = whatever 引导让步状语从句；happen 用一般现在时

classPractice.type: 语境应用·根据汉语提示完成句子
classPractice.question: ____ (无论何时我探望他), he is busy with his research work.
classPractice.answer: No matter when I visit him / Whenever I visit him
classPractice.note: 【课件】no matter when = whenever 引导让步状语从句

classPractice.type: 语境应用·根据汉语提示完成句子
classPractice.question: ____ (无论这辆汽车花多少钱), I'll buy it.
classPractice.answer: No matter how much the car costs
classPractice.note: 【课件】no matter how much 引导让步状语从句，how much 后接主谓 the car costs

classPractice.question: No matter how bad my mood is, that perfect combination is always enough ____ (lift) my spirits.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；be enough to do sth 足以做某事，不定式表结果/目的

classPractice.question: Don't ask him now—he's ____ no mood ____ jokes after failing the test. (填介词)
classPractice.note: be in no mood for sth = 没心情做某事；for 后接名词/动名词

classPractice.question: 青少年经历情绪波动是很正常的。It is quite normal for teenagers to have ____ ____.
classPractice.note: a mood swing 情绪波动，可数，此处复数 mood swings

translation: 结合体，组合体；结合，联合
original_sentence: What do you think of this combination?
readingExamples: What do you think of this combination?
definitionEn:
(1) n. two or more things joined or mixed together to form a single unit
(2) n. the act of joining or mixing two or more things
(3) n. a series of numbers or letters used to open a combination lock
(4) n. an arrangement of people or things considered as a group

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （密码锁的）密码，号码组合
uncommonMeanings.example: She spun the dial with trembling fingers, praying that the combination scrawled in her grandfather's diary would still open the rusty old safe. （读后续写·悬念·寻宝）

posExamples.sentence: The dish before us was a daring combination of sweet mango and fiery chilli, and with the very first bite my taste buds sprang to life, dancing between delight and surprise. （读后续写·美食·感官）
I firmly believe that a combination of consistent effort and a positive attitude is the surest recipe for success in your upcoming examinations. （应用文·鼓励信）
It is the combination of individual talent and collective discipline, rather than either alone, that transforms a group of players into a champion team. （议论文·团队与成功）
In an unforgettable combination of courage and kindness, the young volunteer waded into the flood to carry an elderly stranger to safety. （读后续写·英雄·行动）

wordForms.other: combine vt./vi. 结合，联合（combine A with B）；combined adj. 结合的，共同的（their combined efforts 他们的共同努力）；combining（现分/动名词）

collocations.phrase: a combination of A and B
collocations.translation: A 与 B 的结合／综合
collocations.example: Success is a combination of talent and hard work. 成功是天赋与努力的结合。
Used in combination with exercise, a healthy diet works best. 与运动相结合，健康饮食效果最佳。
Passion and perseverance proved to be a winning combination that carried the small team all the way to the final. （读后续写·励志）
The old temple set against snow-capped mountains was a perfect combination of human craft and natural grandeur. （读后续写·风景）
What struck the judges most was the unique combination of humour and depth in her speech. （应用文·比赛评述）
He fumbled with the combination lock on his locker, his mind racing as the bell rang for the final exam. （读后续写·校园·紧张）
By pairing veteran experience with youthful energy, the coach formed a combination no rival could easily break. （读后续写·体育）
The accident was caused by a combination of factors, including poor weather and driver fatigue. （议论文·因果分析）

synonyms.example: Her expression was a strange mixture of joy and disbelief when she read the acceptance letter. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: mixture 强调把不同成分混合(可指物质或情感的混杂),常带随意、不刻意之意;combination 更强调有目的地组合,结果常为一个整体

synonyms.example: The novel is a seamless blend of history and imagination. （议论文·文学评论）
synonyms.usage: blend 强调各成分和谐融合、难以分辨界限,偏褒义;combination 只表示放在一起,不必然强调融合的和谐

synonyms.example: Their marriage was a union of two families with very different traditions. （读后续写·家庭）
synonyms.usage: union 多用于正式、抽象的联合(国家、组织、人的结合);combination 用法更广泛、更日常

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·combination & combine 搭配对照
advancedExpressions.expression: ①名词：a combination of A and B（A与B的结合）②in combination with（与……一起，共同作用）③动词：combine A with B = combine A and B（把A与B结合）。名词看 of，动词看 with。
advancedExpressions.example: When you combine determination with the right method, this combination of will and skill can move mountains. 当你把决心与正确方法结合，这种意志与技巧的结合足以移山。

advancedExpressions.expression: combination（有目的地组合成整体，最通用）/ mixture（把不同成分混在一起，可随意）/ blend（和谐融合、界限难分，偏褒）/ union（正式、抽象的联合）。
advancedExpressions.example: The dish was a clever combination of flavours—not a careless mixture but a seamless blend. 这道菜是味道的巧妙结合——不是随意的混合，而是浑然天成的融合。

advancedExpressions.expression: a ... combination of A and B ... sprang to life
advancedExpressions.example: A dazzling combination of colour and sound sprang to life the instant the festival gates swung open. （拟人化,续写渲染场面）

advancedExpressions.expression: a combination of ... is the surest recipe for ...
advancedExpressions.example: A combination of patience and practice is the surest recipe for mastering a foreign language. （比喻 recipe,建议信中生动有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is the combination of ..., rather than ... alone, that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is the combination of hard work and opportunity, rather than luck alone, that determines a person's ultimate achievement. （强调句+让步,突出核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The food tasted of sweet and sour together.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With the first mouthful, a bold combination of sweetness and tang burst across my tongue, and I found myself closing my eyes to savour a flavour I would never forget. （读后续写·美食·感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动词升级(burst across my tongue) + 伴随动作(closing my eyes) + 情感收束(never forget)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Success needs talent and hard work.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that success springs not from talent in isolation but from a well-balanced combination of talent, diligence, and an unshakeable will to persevere. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that...正式主句 + not from...but from...对比结构 + 三项并列递进

classPractice.question: Her achievement was the result of a ____ of talent and effort. (n. 结合)
classPractice.note: a combination of A and B  A与B的结合，介词用 of

classPractice.question: If you ____ (combine) exercise with a balanced diet, you will soon feel healthier.
classPractice.note: combine A with B 把A与B结合；此处 if 条件句主句将来时，从句用一般现在时

classPractice.question: 这种药与酒精同时服用可能有危险。This medicine may be dangerous ____ ____ ____ alcohol.
classPractice.note: in combination with 与……结合／同时；固定短语

original_sentence: greedily emotion link cry out for mood dessert relieve do the trick B Building your language B1 The passage below is about a different kind of comfort food.
readingExamples: greedily emotion link cry out for mood dessert relieve do the trick B Building your language B1 The passage below is about a different kind of comfort food.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to succeed in solving a problem or achieving the desired result
(2) phr. (informal) to be exactly what is needed to make something work

posExamples.sentence: When words failed to comfort the sobbing child, Grandma's warm bowl of chicken soup did the trick, and before long a shy smile crept back onto his tear-stained face. （读后续写·家庭·慰藉）
If you find yourself dozing off while revising, I suggest a ten-minute walk in the fresh air — in my experience, it always does the trick. （应用文·建议信）
Many students assume that sheer willpower alone will do the trick, yet lasting motivation, in truth, is built on small, repeated victories. （议论文·学习方法）
The old engine coughed and refused to start, but a gentle tap with the wrench somehow did the trick, and the truck rumbled back to life. （读后续写·机械·转折）

idioms.example: 'Add a pinch of salt and let it simmer — that should do the trick,' Grandma said with a knowing wink. （读后续写·厨房·对话）

collocations.example: A bit more sugar should do the trick. 再加一点糖应该就可以了。

collocations.phrase: sth should / ought to do the trick
collocations.translation: 【课件】某物应该会奏效（正好能解决问题）
collocations.example: This sauce needs a bit of flavour — I know, some lemon juice should do the trick. 这个酱汁还差点味道——我知道了，放些柠檬汁应该会好。
A cup of hot tea usually does the trick when I feel cold. 我觉得冷时，一杯热茶通常就管用。

collocations.phrase: should / that should do the trick
collocations.example: Add a little salt—that should do the trick. 加一点盐——那样应该就行了。
When my little sister cannot fall asleep, a soft lullaby usually does the trick. （读后续写·亲情）
Two coats of paint should do the trick and make the old fence look brand new. （应用文·活动准备）

collocations.phrase: just the thing to do the trick
collocations.translation: 正是能解决问题的东西
collocations.example: A cup of hot ginger tea was just the thing to do the trick on that bitterly cold night. （读后续写·温暖场景）
Sometimes a single kind gesture is enough to do the trick and turn a stranger into a friend. （议论文·善意的力量）

synonyms.example: I tried her remedy for hiccups, and to my surprise it actually worked. （读后续写·日常）
synonyms.usage: work 是最通用的说法,正式非正式皆可;do the trick 更口语、更生动,常暗示'正好解决了那个具体的小难题'

synonyms.example: Regular revision proved to be far more effective than last-minute cramming. （议论文·学习方法）
synonyms.usage: be effective 偏正式、书面,适合议论文;do the trick 偏口语,不宜用于严肃论述

synonyms.example: A quick software update solved the problem that had frustrated users for weeks. （应用文·说明/报告）
synonyms.usage: solve the problem 强调彻底解决明确的问题;do the trick 更随意,可指小办法恰好管用

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·which引导非限制性定语从句(修饰前面整个名词/短语)
advancedExpressions.expression: which 引导非限制性定语从句，前面常用逗号，用于对先行词作补充说明、引出附加成分，which 可指代前面的名词、短语或整个句子。此处 which 修饰 the lovely creamy flavour。
advancedExpressions.example: Sometimes the smell alone can do the trick, not to mention the lovely creamy flavour, which works like a time machine immediately transporting me back to my sunny childhood. 有时只是闻到香味就能奏效了，更不用说那美妙的奶油味道，它就像一台时光机，立刻把我带回阳光灿烂的童年。（课文原句）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·分词短语作后置定语(修饰名词)
advancedExpressions.expression: 现在分词（短语）可作后置定语，修饰前面的名词，相当于一个定语从句（表主动/正在进行）。此处 transporting me back to my sunny childhood 作后置定语，修饰 a time machine（= a time machine that transports me back...）。
advancedExpressions.example: It works like a time machine immediately transporting me back to my sunny childhood. 它就像一台时光机，立刻把我带回阳光灿烂的童年。（transporting... 作后置定语修饰 a time machine）

advancedExpressions.expression: do the trick 奏效、恰好解决问题（口语，常搭 usually/should/that will do the trick）。近义：work（最通用）、be effective（正式）、solve the problem（彻底解决）。注意 the 不可省，trick 用单数。
advancedExpressions.example: When medicine failed, a bowl of hot soup did the trick—sometimes the simplest remedy works best. 当药物无效时，一碗热汤却奏效了——有时最简单的办法最管用。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主谓一致与时态
advancedExpressions.expression: do the trick 中 do 随主语和时态变化：三单/现在 does the trick，过去 did the trick，将来 will do the trick，情态 should/might do the trick。
advancedExpressions.example: This trick did the trick yesterday, and I'm sure it will do the trick again. 这个小办法昨天奏效了，我肯定它这次还会管用。

advancedExpressions.expression: when ... failed, ... did the trick, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: When all my careful arguments failed, a single heartfelt apology did the trick, and the frown on her face softened into forgiveness. （对比反差+画面收束,续写化解矛盾）

advancedExpressions.expression: in my experience, ... always does the trick
advancedExpressions.example: Whenever stress builds up before an exam, a short jog around the playground, in my experience, always does the trick. （拉近距离的经验分享,建议真诚可信）

advancedExpressions.expression: many assume ... will do the trick, yet in truth ...
advancedExpressions.example: Many assume that money alone will do the trick, yet in truth, genuine happiness is rooted in relationships, not riches. （先破后立,议论文反驳常用框架）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The soup made him feel better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When medicine and comforting words had both fallen short, a steaming bowl of Grandma's soup quietly did the trick, coaxing the colour back into his pale cheeks. （读后续写·亲情·治愈）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步铺垫(had fallen short) + 短语升级(did the trick) + 现分伴随+具象细节(coaxing the colour back)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Practising every day helps you improve.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is not talent but patient, daily practice that truly does the trick, quietly turning today's stumbling learner into tomorrow's confident master. （议论文·学习之道）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...强调对比 + 短语 does the trick 增添生动 + 时间对照(today's...tomorrow's)升华

classPractice.type: 汉译英（用 do the trick 短语）
classPractice.question: 再加一点糖应该就可以了。
classPractice.answer: A bit more sugar should do the trick.

classPractice.note: do the trick 奏效、管用；trick 用单数，the 不可省

translation: 含奶油的，像奶油的；乳脂状的，浓稠的
original_sentence: Each spoonful of this amazing dessert is a light, creamy experience to remember.
readingExamples: Each spoonful of this amazing dessert is a light, creamy experience to remember.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. containing cream, or looking or tasting like cream
(2) adj. smooth and thick in texture, like cream
(3) adj. (of colour) pale yellowish-white

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 乳白色的，米黄色的（颜色）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bride stepped into the hall in a flowing creamy gown that seemed to glow softly under the chandeliers. （读后续写·婚礼·色彩）

posExamples.sentence: The first spoonful of the pudding was pure bliss — smooth, creamy and impossibly rich — and for one blissful moment the whole noisy world seemed to fall silent around me. （读后续写·美食·感官）
For our school food festival, I strongly recommend the creamy mushroom soup, whose velvety texture and gentle aroma are guaranteed to win over even the pickiest eaters. （应用文·活动推荐）
While a creamy dessert may delight the tongue for a moment, we should not forget that lasting well-being is built on balance rather than indulgence. （议论文·饮食与健康）
Dawn broke over the harbour, painting the calm sea a soft, creamy gold, and the fishermen paused their work just to breathe it in. （读后续写·环境·晨景）

wordForms.other: cream n. 奶油/乳霜 v. 搅成糊状；creamy adj.（-y 名词变形容词，多形象化，如 milky, silky, oily, juicy）；creamed adj. 奶油状的；辨析拼写 cream ≠ dream/scream

collocations.example: Stir the sauce until it becomes smooth and creamy. 把酱汁搅拌至顺滑绵密。
This soup has a rich, creamy texture. 这汤有浓郁绵密的口感。
The chef was praised for the wonderfully creamy texture of his signature risotto. （应用文·美食评述）
The magnolia blossoms wore a delicate creamy white that stood out against the deep green leaves. （读后续写·自然·色彩）
The soup was so rich and creamy that a single bowl left us wonderfully full and content. （读后续写·美食）
Drizzled with a creamy sauce, the humble pasta was transformed into a dish worthy of a fine restaurant. （读后续写·美食）
The old photograph showed a young woman with creamy skin and eyes full of quiet determination. （读后续写·人物描写）

collocations.translation: 加了奶油的咖啡；奶香浓郁的咖啡
collocations.example: On rainy mornings, nothing lifts my spirits quite like a warm cup of creamy coffee by the window. （读后续写·日常温情）

synonyms.example: The dessert slid down like silk, so smooth that it seemed to melt before it even reached my throat. （读后续写·感官）
synonyms.usage: smooth 泛指质地顺滑无颗粒,适用范围广(表面、口感、过程);creamy 特指像奶油那样又滑又浓稠,还常带奶香或乳白色

synonyms.example: The wine had a velvety finish that lingered pleasantly on the palate. （应用文·美食评述）
synonyms.usage: velvety 强调如天鹅绒般细腻柔顺的触感或口感,文学色彩浓;creamy 更突出乳脂的浓稠感,更口语常见

synonyms.example: The cake was so rich that a small slice was more than enough. （读后续写·美食）
synonyms.usage: rich 侧重食物油脂／糖分含量高、味道浓厚(可能偏腻);creamy 侧重奶油般的顺滑质地,不必然强调'腻'

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·名词 +y → 形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: 许多名词加 -y 变形容词，表'像……的/富含……的'：cream→creamy 奶油般的，milk→milky 乳白的，silk→silky 丝滑的，oil→oily 油腻的，juice→juicy 多汁的，salt→salty 咸的。写美食感官描写极常用。
advancedExpressions.example: The dessert was creamy, silky and just the right kind of sweet. 这甜点绵密、丝滑，甜得恰到好处。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'口感顺滑浓稠'
advancedExpressions.expression: creamy（奶油般又滑又稠，常带奶香/乳白）/ smooth（泛指顺滑无颗粒）/ velvety（天鹅绒般细腻，文学味浓）/ rich（油脂糖分高、味浓，可能偏腻）。写美食可叠用增强画面。
advancedExpressions.example: One spoonful of the mousse—smooth, creamy and impossibly rich—melted on my tongue. 一勺慕斯——顺滑、绵密、浓郁得惊人——在我舌尖融化。

advancedExpressions.expression: smooth, creamy and impossibly ..., ... seemed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The mousse was smooth, creamy and impossibly light, and each spoonful seemed to whisper of summer afternoons long gone. （多重形容词叠加+通感,续写美食升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: whose ... texture and ... aroma are guaranteed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I recommend the pumpkin pie, whose creamy texture and warm, spicy aroma are guaranteed to bring a taste of home to every guest. （定语从句+承诺句式,推荐生动可信）

advancedExpressions.expression: while a creamy ... may ..., we should not forget that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While a creamy indulgence may please us for a moment, we should not forget that true satisfaction comes from moderation. （让步+转折,辩证看待享受）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dessert was very smooth and tasty.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the creamy dessert melted on my tongue, a wave of warmth spread through me, and for one lingering moment I forgot every worry that had weighed on my heart. （读后续写·美食·感官+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句(As...melted) + 抽象感受具象化(a wave of warmth spread) + 情感收束(forgot every worry)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Creamy food may be nice but is not always healthy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Although a creamy treat can bring fleeting delight to the palate, we would be wise to remember that health, unlike pleasure, is measured not in single indulgences but in daily balance. （议论文·饮食观）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Although 让步开头 + not...but...对比 + 隐性比较(unlike pleasure)提升思辨深度

classPractice.note: 课文原句；名词 cream 加 -y 变形容词 creamy 奶油般的，作定语

classPractice.answer: The soup was so rich and creamy that we all wanted a second bowl.
classPractice.note: rich and creamy 浓郁绵密；so...that 结果状语从句

translation: n. 味，味道；特点，特色 | vt. 给……调味，加味于（美式拼写 flavor）
original_sentence: There is also a bitter taste of coffee but this flavour is not very strong.
readingExamples: There is also a bitter taste of coffee but this flavour is not very strong.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the particular taste of a food or drink
(2) n. a special quality or characteristic that makes something distinctive
(3) vt. to add something to food or drink to give it a particular taste
(4) n. a slight sign or suggestion of a particular quality (a flavour of sth)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】特色，特点；某种韵味（c. a particular quality that something has）
uncommonMeanings.example: The book captures the flavour of London. 这本书抓住了伦敦的风情。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 特色，特点；某种韵味
uncommonMeanings.example: The narrow, lantern-lit alleys gave the old town a distinctly oriental flavour that no photograph could ever fully capture. （读后续写·古镇·特色）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某事物的）一点意味／苗头（a flavour of）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her opening remarks carried a faint flavour of sarcasm, and the audience shifted uneasily in their seats. （读后续写·人物·语气）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the noodles touched my lips, a rich flavour of home flooded my senses, and tears welled up before I could stop them. （读后续写·思乡·味觉）
Our newly opened café offers over twenty flavours of homemade ice cream, and I warmly invite every classmate to come and discover a favourite of their own. （应用文·邀请／宣传）
Grandma flavoured the stew with a handful of wild herbs she had gathered at dawn, filling the whole cottage with an aroma I still dream of today. （读后续写·亲情·细节）
A truly great festival does more than entertain; it preserves the cultural flavour of a people, passing their spirit from one generation to the next. （议论文·文化传承）

wordForms.other: 英式拼写 flavour｜美式拼写 flavor（同理 colour/color, favour/favor, neighbour/neighbor）；flavouring n. 调味料；flavoured adj. 有…味的（lemon-flavoured 柠檬味的）；flavourless adj. 无味的

idioms.translation: 一时最受欢迎的人／事物；红极一时
idioms.example: The young inventor became the flavour of the month after his clever design went viral overnight. （读后续写·励志·走红）

collocations.example: The tomatoes give (extra) flavour to the sauce. 西红柿给酱汁增添了（额外的）风味。
The book captures the flavour of London. 这本书抓住了伦敦的风情。
salt and vinegar flavour crisps 咸酸口味的薯片

collocations.phrase: a wine with a delicate fruit flavour
collocations.translation: 【课件】有淡淡水果味的葡萄酒
collocations.example: a wine with a delicate fruit flavour 有淡淡的水果味的葡萄酒
a dish with a strong spicy flavour 辣味很重的一道菜
This sauce is flavoured with garlic and herbs. 这种酱加了大蒜和香草调味。

collocations.translation: 【课件】风靡一时的人（或事物）；红极一时
collocations.example: Mary is certainly flavour of the month with the boss. 玛丽当然是老板跟前的红人。
A little garlic adds flavour to the soup. 一点大蒜给汤增添了风味。
That new singer is the flavour of the month. 那位新歌手正红极一时。
The tea had a mild, soothing flavour that seemed to wash away the fatigue of the long journey. （读后续写·旅途）
A little salt is often enough to bring out the natural flavour of fresh vegetables. （应用文·美食小贴士）
Each region of China boasts a distinctive culinary flavour shaped by its climate and history. （议论文·饮食文化）
The little street market was full of local flavour, from sizzling snacks to handmade crafts. （读后续写·市集）

collocations.phrase: capture / preserve the flavour of sth
collocations.example: The documentary beautifully captured the flavour of village life before it faded into memory. （议论文·文化记录）
The shop sells ice cream in every flavour imaginable, from classic vanilla to bold black sesame. （应用文·宣传）
She flavoured the plain rice with saffron, turning an ordinary meal into a feast for the senses. （读后续写·烹饪）

synonyms.example: The dish left a lingering sweet taste in my mouth. （读后续写·美食）
synonyms.usage: taste 是最基础的'味道',也可指'品味/鉴赏力';flavour 更强调食物独特而有层次的风味,或事物的'特色韵味',表达更细腻

synonyms.example: The rich aroma of freshly baked bread drifted through the whole street. （读后续写·气味）
synonyms.usage: aroma 特指用鼻子闻到的诱人香气;flavour 主要指用嘴尝到的味道(也含整体风味),两者常搭配出现

synonyms.example: The centuries-old buildings gave the town a character all its own. （议论文·文化）
synonyms.usage: character 指人或事物独特的性质／特征(较抽象、正式);flavour 表'特色'时更口语、更生动,常带感官联想

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·英式 -our vs 美式 -or
advancedExpressions.expression: 一批词英式结尾 -our、美式 -or，意义完全相同：flavour/flavor 味道，colour/color 颜色，favour/favor 恩惠，neighbour/neighbor 邻居，honour/honor 荣誉，labour/labor 劳动。全篇拼写要统一，别混用。
advancedExpressions.example: In British English we write flavour and colour; in American English, flavor and color. 英式写 flavour、colour，美式写 flavor、color。

advancedExpressions.expression: ①n. 味道：a rich/mild flavour；add flavour to sth 提味；bring out the flavour 提味 ②n. 特色/韵味：local flavour 乡土气息 ③v. 调味：flavour sth with sth ④习语：the flavour of the month 红极一时的人/物。
advancedExpressions.example: This street still has the flavour of old Beijing, and every stall's snacks are flavoured with a taste of home. 这条街仍有老北京的韵味，每个摊子的小吃都带着家乡的味道。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·味觉唤起记忆
advancedExpressions.expression: a rich flavour of ... flooded my senses, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: A rich flavour of childhood flooded my senses the moment I bit into the sticky rice cake, and suddenly I was ten years old again. （通感+闪回,续写唤起回忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: offer ... flavours of ..., I warmly invite ... to discover ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our stall offers a dozen flavours of traditional dumplings, and I warmly invite every visitor to discover the taste of our hometown. （宣传句式,亲切有感染力）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... does more than ...; it preserves the flavour of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Learning a mother tongue does more than convey meaning; it preserves the flavour of a whole civilisation. （分号递进,升华文化价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dish tasted like home.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One bite of the steaming dish, and a familiar flavour of home swept over me — the very taste of my mother's kitchen, carried across the years to find me here. （读后续写·思乡·味觉）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号补充抒情 + flavour of home 情感意象 + 拟人化(carried across the years to find me)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Traditional festivals keep our culture alive.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being mere holidays, traditional festivals preserve the very flavour of our culture, weaving the memories, values and hopes of a nation into a living thread that binds one generation to the next. （议论文·文化传承）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being...否定铺垫 + preserve the flavour 隐喻 + 三项并列(memories, values, hopes) + weaving...比喻收束

classPractice.note: 【课件】flavour 作'味道'讲时不可数，无冠词；had almost no flavour 几乎没什么味道

classPractice.note: 【课件】flavour 作动词'给……调味'；use sth to do sth 用某物做某事，用不定式 to flavour

classPractice.question: There is also a bitter taste of coffee but this ____ (flavour) is not very strong.
classPractice.note: 课文原句（英式拼写 flavour）；作主语用名词单数

classPractice.question: A few fresh herbs can ____ ____ ____ the plainest dish. (给…增添风味)
classPractice.note: add flavour to sth 给某物增添风味；flavour 此处不可数

classPractice.question: 那位年轻发明家一夜之间红极一时。The young inventor became the ____ ____ the ____ overnight.
classPractice.note: the flavour of the month 一时最受欢迎的人/物；固定习语

original_sentence: greedily emotion link cry out for mood dessert relieve do the trick B Building your language B1 The passage below is about a different kind of comfort food.
readingExamples: greedily emotion link cry out for mood dessert relieve do the trick B Building your language B1 The passage below is about a different kind of comfort food.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. in a way that shows a strong desire for more food, money or possessions than one needs
(2) adv. in an eager or hungry manner; wanting a lot of something very much

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 如饥似渴地，急切地（对知识、经历等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The lonely boy devoured every book in the tiny library greedily, as if each page were a window opening onto a world far larger than his own. （读后续写·求知·励志）

posExamples.sentence: After three days lost in the mountains, the rescued hikers drank greedily from the flasks the villagers offered, gulping down the cool water as though it were the sweetest thing on earth. （读后续写·脱险·感官）
In my report on food waste, I noted with concern how some diners pile their plates greedily at the buffet, only to leave half of it untouched. （应用文·调查报告）
When a society consumes its natural resources greedily, with no thought for tomorrow, it mortgages the very future of its children. （议论文·环境保护）
The kitten pounced on the bowl and lapped up the milk greedily, its tiny tail flicking with pure, unashamed delight. （读后续写·动物·画面感）

wordForms.other: greed n. 贪婪（不可数）；greedy adj. 贪婪的（be greedy for sth 贪求某物）；greedy → greedily（去 y 加 ily 构成副词，同 happy→happily, angry→angrily）

collocations.translation: 狼吞虎咽地吃／大口大口地喝
collocations.example: The hungry boy ate greedily, hardly stopping to breathe. 饥饿的男孩狼吞虎咽，几乎顾不上喘气。
The children stared greedily at the cake. 孩子们贪婪地盯着蛋糕。
The children stared greedily at the towering birthday cake, their eyes wide with anticipation. （读后续写·童趣）
He snatched greedily at the last coin on the table, blind to the disapproving looks around him. （读后续写·人物·贪婪）

collocations.translation: 贪婪地吞食／如饥似渴地阅读
collocations.example: She greedily devoured the letters from her distant friend, reading each line again and again. （读后续写·情感）
Bursting out of the smoke-filled room, he breathed greedily, drinking in the cold night air. （读后续写·逃生·感官）
The young artist gazed greedily at the masterpiece, determined to burn every brushstroke into his memory. （读后续写·艺术·求知）
Modern industries consume energy so greedily that our planet can scarcely keep pace. （议论文·可持续发展）

synonyms.example: The exhausted soldiers ate hungrily, grateful for the simplest bowl of rice. （读后续写·战争／艰苦）
synonyms.usage: hungrily 侧重因饥饿而急切,情感偏中性甚至令人同情;greedily 常暗含'贪得无厌、超过需要'的贬义色彩(用于求知时才转褒/中性)

synonyms.example: The students eagerly raised their hands, desperate to share their ideas. （读后续写·课堂）
synonyms.usage: eagerly 是纯褒义的'热切、积极';greedily 带'贪婪、过度'的暗示,二者情感色彩相反,不可随意互换

synonyms.translation: 贪婪地，狼吞虎咽地（尤指阅读或进食）
synonyms.example: He read voraciously, finishing three thick novels in a single week. （读后续写·求知）
synonyms.usage: voraciously 语体更高级、书面,尤指'如饥似渴地阅读/进食',褒贬取决于语境;greedily 更常见,贬义倾向更明显

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-y 结尾形容词变副词
advancedExpressions.expression: 形容词以辅音字母+y 结尾，变副词去 y 加 -ily：greedy→greedily 贪婪地，happy→happily 幸福地，angry→angrily 愤怒地，easy→easily 容易地，busy→busily 忙碌地。词族：greed(n.)→greedy(adj.)→greedily(adv.)。
advancedExpressions.example: Driven by greed, the greedy man grabbed the gold greedily. 出于贪婪，那个贪心的人贪婪地攫取黄金。（名→形→副 三形态同现）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'急切/贪婪地'（辨析色彩）
advancedExpressions.expression: greedily（贪得无厌、超过所需，多贬义；用于求知时可转中性）/ hungrily（因饥饿而急切，中性偏同情）/ eagerly（纯褒义的热切）/ voraciously（如饥似渴，尤指阅读/进食，书面高级）。色彩相反，别乱换。
advancedExpressions.example: He ate hungrily out of need, but grabbed the extra portions greedily out of pure want. 他因饥饿而急切地吃，却出于纯粹的贪心去抢多余的份。

advancedExpressions.expression: ... greedily, as though it were the sweetest ... on earth
advancedExpressions.example: She drank greedily from the mountain spring, as though it were the sweetest nectar on earth. （明喻+夸张,续写强化极度渴求的画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: I noted with concern how some ... greedily, only to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I noted with concern how some shoppers grabbed the free samples greedily, only to throw most of them away. （客观陈述+批评,报告文体委婉有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: when ... greedily, with no thought for ..., it ...
advancedExpressions.example: When mankind exploits nature greedily, with no thought for the generations to come, it saws off the very branch on which it sits. （时间状语+隐喻,议论文发出警示）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The thirsty man drank the water quickly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Trembling with exhaustion, the parched traveller seized the flask and drank greedily, the cool water sliding down his throat like life itself pouring back into his weary body. （读后续写·脱险·感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现分状语开头(Trembling with...) + greedily 强化动作 + 明喻(like life itself pouring back)升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: People who use resources greedily harm the future.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A generation that devours its resources greedily, heedless of the cost, does not inherit the earth from its ancestors so much as steal it from its children. （议论文·可持续发展）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 同位语式描写(heedless of the cost) + not so much...as...对比句式 + 化用名言升华论点

classPractice.question: After days without food, the rescued hikers drank ____ (greedy) from the flasks.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 drank 用副词；greedy 去 y 加 ily → greedily

classPractice.question: 辨析选词 (greedily / eagerly): The students raised their hands ____, keen to answer the question.
classPractice.note: eagerly 热切地（褒义）；greedily 贪婪地（贬义），此处课堂积极场景用 eagerly

classPractice.question: 出于贪婪，他贪婪地攫取了最后一枚金币。Driven by ____, he ____ snatched the last gold coin.
classPractice.note: 名词 greed 贪婪（介词 by 后接名词）；副词 greedily 修饰动词 snatched

original_sentence: I take my time over every spoonful, gently rolling the silky dessert around my mouth and enjoying the perfect marriage of rice and milk.
readingExamples: I take my time over every spoonful, gently rolling the silky dessert around my mouth and enjoying the perfect marriage of rice and milk.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. in a soft, careful and tender way, without force or roughness
(2) adv. in a mild, kind and gradual manner, so as not to shock or hurt someone
(3) adv. with a slight, gradual movement or slope (of a hill, breeze, curve, etc.)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （坡度、弯度）平缓地，和缓地
uncommonMeanings.example: The path wound gently upwards through the terraced fields, and with each unhurried step Grandpa's stories of his boyhood seemed to rise from the very soil beneath our feet. （读后续写·祖孙徒步·地理描写）

posExamples.sentence: She knelt beside the trembling stray, gently stroking its matted fur and whispering that it was safe now, until the frightened creature finally stopped shaking and pressed its nose into her palm. （读后续写·救助流浪动物·动作描写）

When you comfort a homesick classmate, remember to speak gently and listen more than you speak, for a warm, unhurried tone often heals far more effectively than a hundred hasty pieces of advice. （应用文·建议信）

A truly wise teacher corrects mistakes gently rather than harshly, because criticism delivered with kindness plants the seed of improvement, whereas humiliation only hardens the heart against change. （议论文·教育主题）
The morning breeze stirred gently across the lake, carrying with it the faint fragrance of osmanthus and the distant, drowsy chime of the temple bell. （读后续写·环境渲染·宁静清晨）

wordForms.other: gentle adj. 温柔的/轻柔的/平缓的；gently（以 le 结尾的形容词变副词：去 e 加 y，同 simple→simply, terrible→terribly, possible→possibly）；gentleman n. 绅士

collocations.example: She gently but firmly refused his offer. 她温和而坚定地拒绝了他的提议。
The old man smiled gently and waved us in. 老人温和地微笑着，招手让我们进去。
She gently reminded the new volunteers that patience, not perfection, was what the elderly residents truly craved. （应用文·志愿活动感悟）

collocations.translation: 轻轻推一下；温和地推动
collocations.example: His encouraging words gently nudged me towards a dream I had long been too timid to pursue. （读后续写·人物激励）
The mother rocked the feverish child gently in her arms, humming an old lullaby until his laboured breathing eased into sleep. （读后续写·亲情·夜晚守护）
The old fisherman smiled gently at our clumsy attempts, then took the rod from my hands to show me how it was done. （读后续写·长者形象）
Below us lay a gently sloping valley, its patchwork of green rice paddies glistening under the newly risen sun. （读后续写·风景描写）
Handle the antique vase gently, the curator warned, for a single careless touch could undo three centuries of survival. （读后续写·博物馆·紧张氛围）
As the evening wind blew gently through the open window, the pages of my diary fluttered like restless butterflies. （读后续写·氛围营造）

synonyms.example: She tenderly tucked the blanket around her sleeping grandmother, lingering a moment to memorise the peaceful lines of that beloved face. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 带更强烈的爱意与情感温度，多用于亲密关系；gently 更侧重动作的轻柔、不用力，情感色彩较中性

synonyms.example: 'Don't be afraid,' he said softly, and something in his calm voice made the whole trembling room fall still. （读后续写·安抚场景）
synonyms.usage: 多修饰声音、光线的柔和；gently 可修饰更广泛的动作与力度，两者常在'轻声/轻柔'语境互换

synonyms.example: He responded mildly to the harsh accusation, refusing to let anger cloud his judgement. （议论文·情绪管理）
synonyms.usage: 侧重程度不剧烈、态度不激烈（尤指反应、语气、批评）；gently 侧重动作物理上的轻柔或态度的体贴

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-le 结尾形容词变副词
advancedExpressions.expression: 形容词以辅音+le 结尾，变副词去 e 加 y（不是加 ly）：gentle→gently 轻柔地，simple→simply 简单地，terrible→terribly 可怕地，possible→possibly 可能地，comfortable→comfortably 舒适地。词族：gentle(adj.)→gently(adv.)→gentleness(n.)。
advancedExpressions.example: He spoke in a gentle voice and closed the door gently so as not to wake the baby. 他用温柔的嗓音说话，并轻轻关门，以免吵醒宝宝。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'轻柔/温和地'
advancedExpressions.expression: gently（动作轻不用力/态度体贴，最通用）/ tenderly（充满爱意，多用于亲密关系）/ softly（多修饰声音、光线的柔和）/ mildly（程度/态度不激烈，尤指反应、批评）。
advancedExpressions.example: She softly hummed a tune and tenderly stroked the baby's cheek, rocking the cradle gently. 她轻声哼着曲子，温柔地抚摸宝宝的脸颊，轻轻摇着摇篮。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·动作+心理刻画
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., gently doing sth, as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: She closed the worn photograph album, gently smoothing its cover, as if by that single tender gesture she could keep the past from slipping away. （现在分词伴随状语 + as if 虚拟，动作与不舍心理交融）

advancedExpressions.type: 应用文·建议信委婉措辞
advancedExpressions.expression: may I gently suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: May I gently suggest that we approach our new members with encouragement rather than criticism, so that everyone feels welcomed from the very first day. （用 gently 软化建议，语气谦和得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: not by force but gently, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Lasting change comes not by force but gently, the way spring rain quietly nourishes the soil long before the first green shoot appears. （not...but 对比 + 明喻，说理形象）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He touched the bird softly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With trembling fingers, he reached out and gently cupped the injured sparrow, feeling its tiny heart hammering against his palm like a frightened drum. （读后续写·救助场景·细节+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With + 名词短语状语开头 + gently 精准修饰动作 + feeling 现在分词补充触觉 + like a frightened drum 明喻，把抽象紧张具象化

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should tell them the bad news carefully.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would be far wiser to break the disappointing news gently, choosing your words with care, so that hope is bruised but never entirely crushed. （应用文·建议信·委婉正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would be wiser to... 委婉建议句式 + gently 软化冲击 + choosing 分词状语 + so that 目的状语 + bruised but not crushed 对比隐喻

classPractice.question: I take my time over every spoonful, ____ (gentle) rolling the silky dessert around my mouth.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；修饰动词 rolling 用副词，gentle 去 e 加 y → gently

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (gentle / gently / gentleness): Her ____ words and ____ smile put the frightened child at ease.
classPractice.note: 两空均修饰名词 words/smile，用形容词 gentle（若填副词 gently 则修饰动词，此处不合）

classPractice.answer: The mother held the feverish child gently in her arms.

original_sentence: My favourite food is a popular Italian dessert called tiramisu.
readingExamples: My favourite food is a popular Italian dessert called tiramisu.
definitionEn:
(1) n. sweet food served as the last course of a meal, such as cake, ice cream, pudding or fruit
(2) n. a particular sweet dish or recipe of this kind (e.g. tiramisu, cheesecake)

posExamples.sentence: The moment the waiter set the glistening dessert before her, a wave of childhood memories came flooding back — the warm kitchen, her mother's flour-dusted hands, and the sweetness of being cared for. （读后续写·食物唤起记忆）
For our end-of-term class party, I would suggest that each of us bring a homemade dessert from our hometown, so that a single table can carry the flavours of a dozen different regions. （应用文·活动建议）
It is often said that dessert is not merely the end of a meal but its emotional climax, for a well-made sweet has the power to turn an ordinary dinner into a memory worth treasuring. （议论文·饮食文化）
She carried the trembling dessert to the table with exaggerated care, and when it finally arrived intact, the whole family burst into applause as though she had performed a miracle. （读后续写·家庭温情·幽默）

wordForms.other: 拼写辨析：dessert 甜点（双 s，重音在后 /dɪˈzɜːt/）≠ desert 沙漠（单 s，名词重音在前 /ˈdezət/）≠ desert 抛弃（动词 /dɪˈzɜːt/）。记忆法：甜点让人想再来一份，所以是 double 'ss'（super sweet）。

idioms.translation: 应得的惩罚（注意拼写为 deserts，读音同 dessert，常被混淆）
idioms.example: The dishonest merchant finally got his just deserts when word of his tricks spread through the whole market. （读后续写·因果报应·注意区别拼写）

collocations.example: We had ice cream for dessert. 我们吃了冰淇淋当甜点。
Shall we look at the dessert menu? 我们看看甜点菜单好吗？
The chef personally served the dessert, watching our faces with the anxious pride of an artist unveiling his masterpiece. （读后续写·餐厅场景）

collocations.translation: 浓郁的 / 奶油味的 / 极致美味的甜点
collocations.example: The rich chocolate dessert melted on my tongue, and for one blissful moment all my exam worries simply dissolved with it. （读后续写·感官描写）
We lingered over the dessert menu long after our appetites were gone, reluctant to let such a perfect evening end. （读后续写·氛围）
She prepared the dessert entirely from scratch, following the faded recipe card her late grandmother had left behind. （读后续写·传承·怀念）
Sharing a traditional dessert is one of the warmest ways to introduce a foreign friend to the soul of your culture. （应用文·文化交流）
Although I had promised myself to skip dessert, the aroma drifting from the kitchen made that resolution crumble in an instant. （读后续写·内心挣扎·幽默）

synonyms.example: In many British homes, 'What's for sweet?' is a question children ask before they have even touched their dinner. （应用文·文化介绍）
synonyms.usage: 英式口语中 'sweet' 常等同于餐后甜点；dessert 更正式、通用，书面语和菜单上首选

synonyms.translation: 布丁；（英式）餐后甜点的统称
synonyms.example: By the time the pudding arrived, we were too full to eat, yet no one could resist just one spoonful. （读后续写·聚餐）
synonyms.usage: 英式英语中 pudding 可泛指整个甜点环节，也可指具体的布丁类甜品；dessert 范围最广，涵盖蛋糕、冰淇淋、水果等

synonyms.example: A slice of homemade cake was a rare treat in those lean years, savoured slowly and remembered for weeks. （读后续写·怀旧）
synonyms.usage: 强调'难得的享受、犒赏'的情感色彩，不限于甜点；dessert 特指餐后那一道甜品

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·易混拼写 dessert vs desert
advancedExpressions.expression: dessert n. 甜点（双 s，/dɪˈzɜːt/）｜desert n. 沙漠（单 s，/ˈdezət/）｜desert v. 抛弃、遗弃（单 s，/dɪˈzɜːt/）。记忆：甜点谁都想要 double（ss=super sweet），沙漠荒凉只剩一个 s。习语 get one's just deserts 罪有应得（拼 deserts，读音同 dessert）。
advancedExpressions.example: Don't confuse dessert with desert: after crossing the desert, he treated himself to a sweet dessert. 别把甜点和沙漠弄混：穿过沙漠后，他犒劳自己一份甜点。

advancedExpressions.expression: dessert（餐后甜品，最正式通用）/ sweet（英式口语，泛指餐后甜点）/ pudding（英式，可泛指整个甜点环节或具体布丁）/ treat（难得的美食享受，重情感色彩，不限甜点）。
advancedExpressions.example: In Britain people may ask 'What's for pudding?' meaning dessert, and a homemade cake feels like a real treat. 在英国人们可能问'What's for pudding?'意思是甜点，一块自制蛋糕像是难得的享受。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·感官+情感升华
advancedExpressions.expression: as the ... dessert melted on my tongue, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the warm dessert melted on my tongue, so too did the loneliness that had clung to me all through my first winter away from home. （感官动词 melt 一语双关，甜点消融与孤独消融并置）

advancedExpressions.expression: I propose a ... dessert-sharing ..., through which ...
advancedExpressions.example: I propose a homemade dessert-sharing afternoon, through which classmates from different provinces can taste one another's hometowns and forge friendships over shared sweetness. （提议句式 + through which 定语从句点明意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: a simple dessert reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: A simple dessert reminds us that happiness is rarely found in grand achievements alone, but far more often in small, shared pleasures savoured with the people we love. （由具体到抽象，升华主旨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dessert was very good and made me happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The first spoonful of that silky dessert sent a shiver of delight through me, and in an instant the grey, exhausting day seemed to soften into something almost bearable. （读后续写·感官+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 以具体动作 first spoonful 开头 + 'sent a shiver of delight' 生动谓语 + in an instant 时间副词 + 'soften into' 隐喻情绪变化，避免直白的 good/happy

sentenceUpgrade.original: We ate dessert together and it was a nice time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Gathered around the little table over a shared dessert, we laughed until our sides ached, and I realised that it was not the sweetness of the food but the warmth of the company that I would remember. （应用文/记叙·聚会感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词 Gathered 开头作状语 + 'laughed until our sides ached' 结果状语生动化 + not...but 强调结构点明真正的珍贵之处

classPractice.question: My favourite food is a popular Italian ____ (dessert / desert) called tiramisu.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；dessert 甜点（双 s），与 desert 沙漠（单 s）区分

classPractice.question: 辨析选词 (dessert / desert): After crossing the vast ____, they longed for nothing more than a cold, sweet ____.

classPractice.answer: After dinner, each of us had a homemade dessert.

translation: 联想，联系；协会，社团；联合，结交
original_sentence: In this article, we will talk about a particular type of comfort food whose power mainly lies in the associations it calls to mind.
readingExamples: In this article, we will talk about a particular type of comfort food whose power mainly lies in the associations it calls to mind.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a mental connection between one thing and another; an idea, memory or feeling that a word, place or object brings to mind
(2) n. an official group or organisation of people who share a common interest, aim or profession
(3) n. the act of joining, mixing with, or being connected with a particular person, group or thing
(4) n. a relationship or connection between two things, events or ideas

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】联合，交往（being in sb's company; friendship）
uncommonMeanings.example: She became famous through her association with several poets. 她通过与几位诗人的交往而出名了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】协会，社团（an organized group）
uncommonMeanings.example: Research associations are often linked to a particular industry. 研究协会常与某个特定的行业挂钩。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （因交往而受）牵连；交往关系
uncommonMeanings.example: His only crime, it seemed, was his association with the wrong crowd, yet that single connection cast a shadow over his reputation for years. （读后续写·蒙冤·社会主题）

posExamples.sentence: The faint smell of pine needles carried powerful associations for her — of snowy Christmas mornings, of her father's laughter, and of a warmth that no distance or time could ever quite erase. （读后续写·气味唤起记忆）
On behalf of the Student Volunteer Association, I am writing to invite you to join our upcoming charity book fair and help bring the joy of reading to children in remote villages. （应用文·邀请信）

There exists a clear association between regular reading and a person's ability to think critically, for those who read widely are far better equipped to weigh evidence and question hasty conclusions. （议论文·阅读价值）
Years of close association with his grandfather had quietly shaped the boy's character, teaching him patience, honesty and a deep respect for the land. （读后续写·成长·长辈影响）

wordForms.other: associate (n. 伙伴，同事)

idioms.example: The exhibition was organised by our school in association with the city museum, offering students a rare glimpse into ancient civilisations. （应用文·活动报道）
The old song became painful to him by association, for it had played on the radio the very evening his family said goodbye. （读后续写·情感·联想之痛）

collocations.phrase: the associations sth calls to mind
collocations.translation: 【课件】某物唤起的联想（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In this article, we will talk about a particular type of comfort food whose power mainly lies in the associations it calls to mind. 本文将谈一种慰藉食物，它的力量主要在于它所唤起的联想。（课文原句）
The seaside had all sorts of pleasant associations with childhood holidays for me. 海滨使我联想起童年假期的各种愉快情景。

collocations.translation: 【课件】与某人／某机构合伙（合作）；与……联合、交往
collocations.example: She became famous through her association with several poets. 她通过与几位诗人的交往而出名了。

collocations.phrase: call / bring sb / sth to mind
collocations.translation: 【课件】使想起；唤起（同义短语 bring sb/sth to mind）
collocations.example: These photos call to mind the days when we were in junior high school. 这些照片让我想起了我们上初中的日子。

collocations.translation: 【课件】研究协会／行业协会（协会，社团）
collocations.example: Research associations are often linked to a particular industry. 研究协会常与某个特定的行业挂钩。
For many people, this dish carries a warm association with childhood. 对许多人来说，这道菜带着与童年的温暖联系。
The reading festival was held in association with the city library. 阅读节是与市图书馆合作举办的。

collocations.phrase: call to mind associations / evoke associations
collocations.example: Certain foods evoke associations so vivid that a single bite can transport us across decades in a heartbeat. （议论文·记忆与食物）
There is a strong association in Chinese culture between the round moon and family reunion, a link that gives the Mid-Autumn Festival its deep emotional pull. （应用文·文化介绍）

collocations.translation: 建立联系 / 成立协会
collocations.example: A group of passionate students formed an association dedicated to protecting the endangered birds nesting along our river. （读后续写·环保行动）

collocations.translation: 有正面 / 负面的联想
collocations.example: For many patients, hospitals carry negative associations, so a few kind words from a nurse can mean far more than any medicine. （议论文·关怀）

collocations.translation: 校友会 / 体育协会 / 行业协会
collocations.example: The alumni association organised a reunion that brought three generations of graduates back to the school they still called home. （读后续写·重逢）

collocations.phrase: make an association between A and B
collocations.translation: 把 A 与 B 联系起来
collocations.example: Gradually the child learned to make an association between hard work and reward, and that lesson would guide him for life. （议论文·教育）

collocations.translation: 因关联而担责 / 获益
collocations.example: It is unjust to condemn a person by association alone, without weighing the truth of his own actions. （议论文·公正）

synonyms.example: Scientists have discovered a surprising connection between the quality of our sleep and the sharpness of our memory. （议论文·科学）
synonyms.usage: 最通用的'联系'，指客观的关联；association 更常指心理层面的联想，或人与组织的结交关系

synonyms.example: The charity organisation has helped thousands of rural children gain access to books they could never have afforded. （应用文·公益）
synonyms.usage: 指有结构、有目标的正式机构；association 强调因共同兴趣或宗旨而'联合'成的团体（如协会、学会），规模和正式度可大可小

synonyms.example: The hardship they endured together forged a bond between the two soldiers that no words could ever fully capture. （读后续写·情谊）
synonyms.usage: 特指情感上牢固的联结（亲情、友情），情感色彩浓；association 侧重认知联想或社交/组织关系，情感色彩较弱

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·whose引导定语从句(修饰人/物,表所属)
advancedExpressions.expression: whose 引导定语从句，表示'……的'，既可修饰人也可修饰物（= of which/of whom），在从句中作定语修饰后面的名词。此处 whose 修饰先行词 comfort food（whose power = the power of the comfort food）。
advancedExpressions.example: In this article, we will talk about a particular type of comfort food whose power mainly lies in the associations it calls to mind. 本文我们将谈一种治愈系食物，它的力量主要在于它所唤起的联想。（课文原句，whose 引导定语从句修饰 comfort food；其中 (that) it calls to mind 又是省略关系词的定语从句修饰 associations）

advancedExpressions.type: 词族·associate 一词多义/多词性
advancedExpressions.expression: associate v. 联想／结交（associate sb/sth with sth）；associated adj. 有关的、相关的（be associated with...与……有关联）；associate adj. 副的、非正式的（an associate professor 副教授）；associate n. 同事、生意伙伴（business associates）。
advancedExpressions.example: Most people associate this brand with good quality, and his social problems were associated with heavy drinking; the associate professor greeted his business associates warmly. 大多数人把这个品牌和优质联系起来，而他的社会问题与酗酒有关；那位副教授热情地招呼他的生意伙伴。

advancedExpressions.expression: an association with sth（与…的联系）/ in association with（与…合作）/ by association（因关联）/ a strong association between A and B（A 与 B 的密切联系）/ form an association（成立协会）
advancedExpressions.example: There is a strong association between the smell and my hometown; in association with old friends, that memory grows only warmer. （一句串联 association 核心搭配，识记词块）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·联系/联想（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: association（联想/心理联系）↔ connection（客观联系，最通用）↔ link（关联，尤指逻辑因果）↔ bond（情感纽带，最深）
advancedExpressions.example: 谈心理层面的联想用 association，谈客观关联用 connection/link，谈情感牵绊用 bond——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: associate(v. 联想/结交) → association(n. 联想/协会) → associated(adj. 相关的) → associate(n. 同事/伙伴)
advancedExpressions.example: soci = 同伴/社会（如 social 社交的、society 社会），as-(向)+soci = '与人为伴、结交'，故 associate 即'联系、结交'。

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... called to mind a flood of associations: ...
advancedExpressions.example: The faded ticket stub called to mind a flood of associations: the roar of the crowd, her father's steady hand on her shoulder, the sweet certainty that anything was possible. （冒号后三个名词短语铺陈画面，唤起回忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: organised in association with ..., the event aims to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Organised in association with the regional library, the reading festival aims to rekindle young people's love of the written word. （过去分词状语点明合作方 + aims to 说明宗旨，得体正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is a well-documented association between ... and ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is a well-documented association between early exposure to music and enhanced creativity, which suggests that the arts deserve a central place in every child's education. （引出客观关联 + which 非限定从句推导结论）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The song reminded her of her hometown.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment those familiar notes drifted through the air, a rush of associations swept over her — the winding village lane, the smoke curling from chimney tops, and her mother's voice calling her home at dusk. （读后续写·听觉唤起乡愁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment... 时间状语从句开头 + 'a rush of associations swept over her' 抽象具象化 + 破折号后三组画面并置 + 声、形、情逐层展开

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our club worked with the museum to hold the event.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Organised by our history club in association with the municipal museum, the exhibition offered students a rare chance to hold the past in their own hands. （应用文·活动介绍·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语前置作状语，主谓后置显正式 + 'in association with' 精确表达合作 + 'hold the past in their own hands' 隐喻化收尾
