translation: vi. （根据情况）变化，变更；相异，不同 | vt. 变更，改变
original_sentence: Find these expressions in the article and improve the sentences below by varying the language.
readingExamples: Find these expressions in the article and improve the sentences below by varying the language.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. (of a group of similar things) to be different from one another in size, amount, degree or nature
(2) vi. to change or be different according to the situation, time or circumstances
(3) vt. to change something, or make something different, especially to add interest or avoid monotony

posExamples.sentence: As the train sped south, the scenery outside my window varied from snow-capped peaks to misty rice paddies, and with every changing view my heart lifted a little higher. （读后续写·旅途·景色变换）
To keep our readers engaged, I suggest that we vary the style of our school magazine — mixing interviews, stories and photo essays so that no two pages ever feel the same. （应用文·建议信）
People's reactions to failure vary enormously: some are crushed by a single setback, while others draw from it the very strength they need to rise again. （议论文·挫折教育）
Opinions on the new policy varied widely among the villagers, and by nightfall the little tea house had become a battlefield of passionate, competing voices. （读后续写·社会·分歧场景）

wordForms.noun: variety (多样性) / variation (变化) / variable (变量)
wordForms.adjective: various (各种各样的) / varied (多样的) / variable (多变的)
wordForms.other: variety (n. 品种，种类)；易混词族：various(许多不同的，后接复数名词) / varied(多样的，强调种类丰富) / variable(易变的、不稳定的)；名词 a variety of = various = 各种各样的

collocations.translation: 【课件】从 A 到 B 变化；因……而不同
collocations.example: They vary from person to person, depending on our own unique experiences that have shaped our lives. 它们因人而异，取决于我们塑造了自己生活的独特经历。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在 A 到 B 之间变化／不等
collocations.example: The number of students in each class varies between 25 and 30. 各班级学生人数从25到30不等。
He varies his style of writing according to his readers. 针对不同的读者，他变换创作的风格。
The students' work varies considerably in quality. 学生作业的质量甚是参差不齐。

collocations.translation: 变换措辞（避免重复）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Find these expressions in the article and improve the sentences below by varying the language. 在文中找出这些表达，通过变换语言来改进下面的句子。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: vary in size / shape / colour / degree
collocations.translation: 在大小 / 形状 / 颜色 / 程度上不同
collocations.example: The handmade lanterns varied in shape and colour, each one carrying the unique imagination of the child who had made it. （读后续写·手工·童趣）
The quality of the essays varied greatly, and it soon became clear that effort, not talent, was what set the best apart. （议论文·努力）
The amount of homework varies according to the difficulty of the topic, so students should plan their evenings with some flexibility. （应用文·学习建议）

collocations.translation: 调整饮食 / 作息 / 方法（求变化）
collocations.example: Coaches encourage athletes to vary their training routine so that both body and mind stay fresh and motivated. （议论文·科学训练）

collocations.phrase: vary from person to person / place to place
collocations.translation: 因人而异 / 因地而异
collocations.example: Tastes in food vary from region to region, and a dish beloved in one province may seem utterly strange in the next. （应用文·文化差异）

collocations.translation: 从 A 到 B 不等；变化范围从……到……
collocations.example: The volunteers' ages varied from lively teenagers to sprightly retirees, yet a shared purpose bound them into one warm family. （读后续写·志愿群像）

synonyms.example: Our opinions differed sharply at first, but a long, honest conversation gradually brought us to common ground. （读后续写·和解）
synonyms.usage: 静态强调'两者/多者之间存在差异'，不含变化过程；vary 强调'在一个范围内变动、参差不齐'，或'主动求变'

synonyms.example: The topics discussed at the forum ranged from climate change to artificial intelligence. （应用文·会议报道）
synonyms.usage: 常与 from...to... 连用，强调覆盖的范围区间；vary 更突出'各不相同、不整齐'的性质，range 更客观描述跨度

synonyms.example: His mood fluctuated wildly in the days before the results, soaring with hope one hour and sinking with dread the next. （读后续写·心理·忐忑）
synonyms.usage: 特指数值或情绪的'上下起伏、不稳定'；vary 是更中性的'变化/不同'，不必然含上下波动之意

advancedExpressions.expression: various adj. 不同的、各种各样的（后接复数名词）：come in various shapes and sizes 有各种各样的形状和大小；variety n. 【U】多样性 /【C】种类、品种：a variety of = varieties of = all kinds/sorts of... 各种各样的（a wide variety of ways 多种用途）。
advancedExpressions.example: Tents come in various shapes and sizes, and this tool can be used in a (wide) variety of ways. 帐篷有各种各样的形状和大小，这一工具有多种用途。

advancedExpressions.expression: vary from A to B（从 A 到 B 不等）/ vary in size/shape（在大小/形状上不同）/ vary with/according to（随…而变）/ vary from person to person（因人而异）/ vary widely（差异很大）
advancedExpressions.example: Prices vary from shop to shop and vary according to the season, so they can vary widely within a single month. （一句串联 vary 高频搭配，识记词块）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·变化/不同（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: vary（在范围内变动/参差不齐）↔ differ（静态强调彼此不同）↔ range（from…to… 覆盖区间）↔ fluctuate（数值/情绪上下波动）
advancedExpressions.example: 强调各不相同用 vary/differ，强调跨度区间用 range，强调上下起伏用 fluctuate——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: vary(v.) → variety(n. 多样性) → variation(n. 变化) → various(adj. 各种的) → varied(adj. 多样的) → variable(adj./n. 多变的/变量) → variously(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: vari = 变化的词根；a variety of = various = 各种各样的；作文常用 a wide variety of activities 替换 many kinds of。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·vary 作不及物动词
advancedExpressions.expression: vary 常作 vi.（主语自身各不相同），后接 from…to…/in…/with…；作 vt. 时意为'（主动）变换'，如 vary the language。
advancedExpressions.example: Opinions vary.（观点各异，vi.）；We should vary our methods.（我们应变换方法，vt.）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境层次描写
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., varying from ... to ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: The mountains stretched endlessly before us, their colours varying from deep emerald at the base to a pale, ghostly blue where the peaks dissolved into cloud. （varying 分词状语铺陈由近及远的层次感）

advancedExpressions.expression: to keep ... engaged, we could vary ...
advancedExpressions.example: To keep our audience engaged throughout the show, we could vary the pace — alternating lively performances with quiet, moving moments. （目的状语 + vary 提出增添变化的建议）

advancedExpressions.type: 议论文·因人而异的辩证
advancedExpressions.expression: since ... vary from person to person, it follows that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Since people's talents and interests vary from person to person, it follows that a one-size-fits-all education can never do justice to every learner. （since 引出前提 + it follows that 推出结论）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The colours of the leaves were different.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The autumn leaves varied endlessly in colour, from flaming crimson to burnished gold, until the whole hillside blazed like a painter's spilled palette. （读后续写·秋景·色彩）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: vary in colour 精准替换 different + from...to... 具体色彩 + until 结果状语推向高潮 + 'like a painter's spilled palette' 明喻收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: The magazine should have different kinds of articles.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To hold our readers' attention from cover to cover, I firmly believe we should vary the content of the magazine, weaving together interviews, essays and photo stories into a richer, more inviting whole. （应用文·建议信·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 目的状语开头 + I firmly believe 表明立场 + vary the content 动词精准 + weaving 分词补充手法 + 三名词并列 + 比较级 richer/more inviting 升华效果

classPractice.question: 人的智力因人而异。
classPractice.answer: People vary in intelligence. / Intelligence varies from person to person.
classPractice.note: 【课件】vary in sth 在某方面有差异；vary from person to person 因人而异

classPractice.question: 习俗随时代而变化。
classPractice.note: 【课件】vary with sth 随……而变化

classPractice.question: 天气一天天变化。
classPractice.answer: The weather varies from day to day.
classPractice.note: 【课件】vary from day to day 一天天变化（from A to A 结构表'逐……变化'）

classPractice.question: The volunteers' ages varied ____ lively teenagers ____ sprightly retirees.
classPractice.note: vary from A to B 从 A 到 B 不等，表示变化范围

classPractice.question: 用 various / varied / variety 填空：A ____ of activities were on offer, and the ____ programme kept every guest entertained.
classPractice.note: a variety of + 名词（各种各样的）；varied 作定语意为'多样的'；两者与形容词 various 词族易混

classPractice.question: 老师建议我们变换语言以改进句子。The teacher suggested that we improve the sentences by ____ the language.
classPractice.note: 课文原句结构；by doing sth 通过做…；vary the language 变换措辞，介词 by 后用动名词

translation: vt. 联系，关联；把……连接起来 | n. 联系，连接；关系，纽带；链接
original_sentence: Reading 5 10 15 3 up eating certain foods in our family, then those foods tend to be linked with positive emotions.
readingExamples: Reading 5 10 15 3 up eating certain foods in our family, then those foods tend to be linked with positive emotions.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make a connection between two or more things, people, ideas or events; to show that they are related
(2) vt. to join or connect two things physically
(3) n. a relationship or connection between two things or ideas
(4) n. a physical connection between two things; one ring of a chain
(5) n. a word, image or button on a webpage that takes you to another page when clicked (hyperlink)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （链条的）一环；环节
uncommonMeanings.example: He often said that a family was like a chain, and that even the weakest link deserved to be cherished rather than cast aside. （读后续写·亲情·比喻·熟词僻义）

posExamples.sentence: For years the old bridge had linked the two villages, and to the children racing across it each morning, it was far more than stone and iron — it was the very thread that bound their two worlds together. （读后续写·地点·情感象征）
I am writing to propose that our school set up an online platform providing a direct link between students and career advisers, so that no one need face the future entirely alone. （应用文·建议信）
Numerous studies have linked a lack of sleep to poor concentration, which strongly suggests that teenagers who sacrifice rest for study may be defeating their own purpose. （议论文·健康与学习）
Slowly, the detective uncovered the hidden link that tied every scattered clue together, and the truth she had chased for months finally clicked into place. （读后续写·悬疑·顿悟时刻）

wordForms.other: linkage (n. 连接，联系)

idioms.translation: 缺失的一环；关键的联系
idioms.example: For weeks the team had felt something was wrong, and now she had found the missing link that explained everything. （读后续写·揭秘）

idioms.idiom: a weak link / the weakest link (in the chain)
idioms.example: A team is only as strong as its weakest link, so we must support our struggling members rather than blame them. （议论文·团队合作）

collocations.example: If we grow up eating certain foods in our family, then those foods tend to be linked with positive emotions. 如果我们从小在家就吃某些特定的食物，这些食物就容易与积极的情绪产生关联。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be linked with that of sb
collocations.example: Her name is often linked with that of a well-known painter. 她的名字经常和一位著名画家的名字联系在一起。

collocations.translation: 【课件】把 A 与 B 联系起来
collocations.example: The new bridge will link the island to the mainland. 这座新桥会把这座岛与大陆连接起来。

collocations.translation: 【课件】同义短语：与……有关联，彼此相关
collocations.example: Experts believe that these two factors are closely related to each other. 专家们认为这两个因素彼此之间密切相关。

collocations.translation: 【课件】同义短语：与……相连，有关联
collocations.example: Research associations are often connected to a particular industry. 研究协会常与某个特定的行业有关联。
It has been proved that lung cancer is associated with smoking. 已证明肺癌和吸烟有关。

collocations.translation: 把 A 与 B 联系起来
collocations.example: Researchers have linked regular exercise with a sharper memory, giving students yet another reason to step away from their desks now and then. （议论文·健康）

collocations.phrase: a link between A and B
collocations.translation: A 与 B 之间的联系
collocations.example: Scientists are still exploring the mysterious link between music and human emotion. （议论文·科学）

collocations.translation: 密切的 / 牢固的 / 直接的联系
collocations.example: There is a direct link between the kindness we show and the friendships we keep, for warmth, once given, has a way of returning. （议论文·人际）
The exchange programme forged a lasting link between our two schools, one that letters and video calls have kept alive for years. （应用文·交流活动）

collocations.phrase: serve as a link / a link between generations
collocations.translation: 充当纽带 / 代际间的纽带
collocations.example: Grandmother's handwritten recipes served as a link between generations, carrying the family's story from one kitchen to the next. （读后续写·传承）
Simply click on the link below to sign up for the volunteer programme and become part of something bigger than yourself. （应用文·招募通知）
Once he broke the link with his old troublemaking friends, his grades and his spirits began to rise together. （读后续写·转变）

synonyms.translation: 【课件·同义群】与……有关联，彼此相关
synonyms.example: Experts believe that these two factors are closely related to each other. 专家们认为这两个因素彼此之间密切相关。
synonyms.usage: 【课件同义短语群】be linked to/with = be related to/with = be connected to/with = be associated with，均表'与……有关联'，可互换；relate 常用 relate A to B 或 be related to B

synonyms.example: Research associations are often connected to a particular industry. 研究协会常与某个特定行业有关联。
synonyms.usage: 【课件同义短语群】connect 最通用，物理连接与抽象关联皆可；与 link/relate/associate 在'有关联'义上可替换

synonyms.example: It has been proved that lung cancer is associated with smoking. 已证明肺癌和吸烟有关。
synonyms.usage: 【课件同义短语群】associate 侧重心理联想或客观关联，固定搭配 be associated with；与 be linked/related/connected with 同义可换

synonyms.example: A single railway line connected the remote mountain town to the bustling world beyond, and with it came both hope and change. （读后续写·地理·变迁）
synonyms.usage: 最通用的'连接'，物理和抽象皆可；link 更强调'把两者关联起来、证明其关系'，尤指逻辑或因果上的联系

synonyms.example: Most people associate the colour red with joy and celebration, especially during the Spring Festival. （应用文·文化）
synonyms.usage: 侧重心理上的'联想'（把 A 想到 B）；link 侧重指出两事物间客观存在的联系或关系

synonyms.example: The teacher skilfully related the abstract theory to our everyday lives, and suddenly the lesson made perfect sense. （议论文·教学）
synonyms.usage: 强调'与……有关、把……联系到'，常用 relate A to B；link 更中性直接，也常用于'A 与 B 之间有联系'的名词结构

advancedExpressions.expression: link A to/with B（把 A 与 B 联系起来）/ a link between A and B（A 与 B 的联系）/ be linked to/with（与…相关）/ serve as a link（充当纽带）/ a direct link（直接联系）
advancedExpressions.example: Studies link sleep to health; there is a direct link between the two, and the two are firmly linked in every doctor's mind. （一句串联 link 核心搭配，识记词块）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·联系/连接（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: link（关联，尤指逻辑因果）↔ connect（最通用，物理/抽象皆可）↔ associate（心理联想）↔ relate（使有关，relate A to B）
advancedExpressions.example: 指出客观因果用 link，泛指连接用 connect，心理联想用 associate，'与…有关'用 relate——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: link 既作 vt.（link A to/with B）又作 n.（a link between A and B）；被动用 be linked to/with；名词僻义为'链条的一环'。
advancedExpressions.example: The bridge links two towns.（v.）→ There is a link between the two towns.（n.）→ They are linked by a bridge.（被动）

advancedExpressions.expression: in that instant, the link between ... became clear
advancedExpressions.example: In that instant, the link between her grandmother's silence and the faded photograph became painfully clear, and tears blurred the world before her. （in that instant 定格顿悟时刻 + link 揭示隐藏关联）

advancedExpressions.type: 应用文·搭建桥梁的倡议
advancedExpressions.expression: such a platform would serve as a vital link between ...
advancedExpressions.example: Such a platform would serve as a vital link between experienced seniors and anxious newcomers, ensuring that valuable advice is never lost. （serve as a link 表达'充当纽带'，ensuring 分词说明意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: a growing body of evidence links ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: A growing body of evidence links excessive screen time to declining attention spans, a warning that today's young people can ill afford to ignore. （links...to 引出研究关联 + 同位语补充告诫）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bridge connected the two villages.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Spanning the roaring river, the ancient stone bridge linked the two villages that had shared harvests, festivals and heartbreaks for a hundred years. （读后续写·地点·历史厚重感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词 Spanning 前置作状语 + linked 精准动词 + that 定语从句注入历史与情感 + 三名词并列 shared harvests, festivals and heartbreaks 增强年代感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Studies say bad sleep leads to poor grades.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A growing number of studies have firmly linked insufficient sleep to declining academic performance, reminding us that burning the midnight oil may cost far more than it earns. （议论文·健康与学业·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: A growing number of studies 增强说服力 + firmly linked...to 因果关联 + reminding 分词引出启示 + 'burning the midnight oil / cost more than it earns' 习语与对比升华

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: Parents prefer to choose names that are ____ (link) to beautiful things and good luck.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】be linked to/with sth 与……相关联，此处用过去分词构成被动

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: The new bridge will link the island ____ the mainland.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】link A to/with B 把 A 与 B 连接起来，介词 to、with 均可

classPractice.question: Those familiar foods tend to be ____ (link) with positive emotions in our memory.
classPractice.note: be linked with/to sth 与……相关联；此处用被动语态过去分词

classPractice.question: 用 link / associate 填空：Numerous studies have ____ a lack of sleep ____ poor concentration.
classPractice.note: link A to/with B 指出客观因果关联（to、with 均可）；associate 侧重心理联想，此处强调研究得出的客观联系用 link

classPractice.question: 科学家们仍在探索音乐与情感之间的联系。Scientists are still exploring the ____ ____ music and emotion.
classPractice.note: a link between A and B 名词结构，between 表示两者之间

translation: 情感，强烈的感情，激情，情绪
original_sentence: It is a good idea to refer to your personal experience or emotion in this part.
readingExamples: It is a good idea to refer to your personal experience or emotion in this part.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a strong feeling such as love, fear, anger, joy or sadness, often accompanied by physical reactions
(2) n. the part of a person's character that consists of feelings, as opposed to thought or reason
(3) n. strong feeling as expressed in one's voice, face or behaviour

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·辨析】emotional 情绪上的；激起感情的；情绪激动的（修饰经历/人）
uncommonMeanings.example: The funeral was a very emotional experience for all of us. 那次葬礼对我们大家来说都是一次令人情绪激动的经历。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·辨析】emotionless 没有情感的；冷漠的（与 emotional 反义）
uncommonMeanings.example: He stared back at her with an emotionless face, betraying not a single trace of what he truly felt. 他面无表情地回望着她，丝毫没有流露真实的感受。

posExamples.sentence: As the final note of the anthem faded, a wave of emotion rose in his chest that he could neither name nor hold back, and before he knew it, tears were streaming down his weathered face. （读后续写·爱国·情感爆发）
When you write a thank-you letter, do not be afraid to let genuine emotion shine through, for a few heartfelt words are worth a hundred polite but empty phrases. （应用文·写作指导）
While reason tells us what is true, it is emotion that moves us to act, and no great cause in history has ever advanced on cold logic alone. （议论文·理性与情感）
She fought to keep her emotions in check as she read her late father's letter aloud, her voice trembling on every line yet somehow refusing to break. （读后续写·克制·催泪场景）

wordForms.adjective: emotional (情感的，动情的) / emotionless (无表情的)

idioms.example: On graduation day I was gripped by mixed emotions — pride at how far I had come, and a quiet grief at leaving behind the only world I had ever known. （读后续写·毕业·矛盾心理）

idioms.idiom: wear one's emotions on one's sleeve
idioms.translation: 把感情表露无遗，喜怒形于色
idioms.example: Unlike his reserved brother, Tom wore his emotions on his sleeve, and one glance at his face was enough to read his whole heart. （读后续写·人物性格对比）

collocations.example: Her voice was full of emotion. 她的嗓音充满了激情。
She was good at hiding her emotions. 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

collocations.translation: 【课件】与积极情绪相关联（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: If we grow up eating certain foods in our family, then those foods tend to be linked with positive emotions. 如果我们从小在家就吃某些特定的食物，这些食物就容易与积极的情绪产生关联。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 提及／谈到自己的情感（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It is a good idea to refer to your personal experience or emotion in this part. 在这部分提及你的个人经历或情感是个好主意。（课文原句）
In many cultures men are taught to hide rather than express emotion, yet true courage often lies in daring to feel openly. （议论文·情感表达）

collocations.phrase: a wave / surge / rush of emotion
collocations.example: A surge of emotion swept over the crowd as the exhausted runner staggered across the finish line, refusing to give up. （读后续写·体育·感动）

collocations.phrase: control / hold back / contain one's emotions
collocations.example: She struggled to control her emotions during the farewell, biting her lip until she tasted the faint sting of tears. （读后续写·离别·克制）
Overcome by emotion, the old soldier could not finish his speech; he simply saluted the flag and let his silence say everything. （读后续写·庄严·动情）
A truly great film stirs deep emotion in its audience, leaving them changed long after the screen goes dark. （议论文·艺术）
Foods eaten in childhood are often tied to positive emotions, which is why a familiar flavour can lift our spirits on the hardest days. （议论文·食物与心理）
He read the poem aloud with such emotion that the whole classroom fell silent, moved beyond words. （读后续写·朗诵·感染力）
There was a raw emotion in her voice that no polished performer could ever fake. （读后续写·真情流露）

synonyms.example: A warm feeling of belonging spread through her the moment the whole class stood up to welcome her back. （读后续写·归属感）
synonyms.usage: 最普通、口语化的'感觉、情感'，范围广、程度可轻可重；emotion 更强调'强烈而深刻的情感'，书面性和情感强度更高

synonyms.example: The letter was full of noble sentiment, expressing a love for one's country that no danger could shake. （应用文·正式抒情）
synonyms.usage: 偏书面、正式，常指'一种带看法的情感态度'（可指群体情绪或高尚情操）；emotion 更指个人内心真实、生理性的强烈感受

synonyms.example: He spoke of his dream with such passion that even the most doubtful listeners found themselves believing. （读后续写·梦想·感染力）
synonyms.usage: 特指'强烈、炽热、持久的情感或热爱'（尤指爱、怒、执着）；emotion 是情感的统称，涵盖各种感受，强度不必然如此炽烈

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·现在分词短语作伴随状语（逻辑主语通常是句子主语）【课件】
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件语法点】现在分词短语作伴随状语时，(1) 表示与谓语动作同时发生的动作；(2) 其逻辑主语通常就是句子的主语；若逻辑主语不是句子主语，须在分词前加上其自身的逻辑主语（构成独立主格）。
advancedExpressions.example: With pleasure, I remember the lazy Sunday afternoons I used to spend, listening to her stories and greedily eating bowl after bowl of rice pudding.（listening/eating 逻辑主语即句子主语 I，作伴随状语）／ He walked slowly on the quiet street, his pet dog following him.（逻辑主语 dog 与主语不一致，故用独立主格 his pet dog following him）

advancedExpressions.expression: show/express emotion（流露情感）/ mixed emotions（复杂心情）/ a wave of emotion（一阵情感涌动）/ control one's emotions（控制情绪）/ with emotion（满怀感情地）
advancedExpressions.example: Gripped by mixed emotions, she fought to control her emotions, yet a wave of emotion still broke through as she spoke with emotion. （一句串联 emotion 核心搭配，识记词块）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·情感/感受（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: emotion（强烈深刻的情感，书面）↔ feeling（最通用口语，程度可轻可重）↔ sentiment（带看法的情感态度，正式）↔ passion（炽热持久的激情）
advancedExpressions.example: 写强烈内心感受用 emotion，泛指感觉用 feeling，正式抒情/群体情绪用 sentiment，热爱执着用 passion——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: emotion(n.) → emotional(adj. 情感的/情绪激动的) → emotionally(adv. 在情感上) → emotionless(adj. 无表情的/冷漠的)；e-(向外)+mot(动)+ion='内心的触动'
advancedExpressions.example: mot = 动（如 motion 运动、motive 动机、move 移动），情感即'心之所动'，故 emotion 意为'情感、情绪'。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·情感爆发升华
advancedExpressions.expression: a wave of emotion swept over sb, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: A wave of emotion swept over him as the crowd chanted his name, and for the first time in his life he understood what it meant to belong. （'a wave of emotion swept over' 生动化情感 + and 引出顿悟，结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: words alone can scarcely convey the emotion I feel when ...
advancedExpressions.example: Words alone can scarcely convey the emotion I feel when I recall how selflessly you stood by me in my darkest hour. （感谢信/道歉信 谦辞开头，用 emotion 强化真挚，比 thank you 更有分量）

advancedExpressions.expression: reason may guide the mind, but it is emotion that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Reason may guide the mind, but it is emotion that fires the will; a society that values only cold logic will never inspire greatness. （but 转折对比 + 强调句 it is...that + 分号并置说理，凸显情感的力量）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very sad and started to cry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For a moment she held herself together, but as the memories came flooding back, the emotion she had bottled up for years finally broke loose, and she wept without shame. （读后续写·情感决堤·层次）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 先抑后扬 held herself together...but + 'came flooding back' 生动化回忆 + 'the emotion...broke loose' 拟物化情感 + 'wept without shame' 替换 cry，画面更有张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: I feel very thankful for your help.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is with the deepest emotion that I write these lines, for your unwavering support carried me through a time when I had all but lost hope. （应用文·感谢信·正式抒情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 强调句 It is with...that I... 正式抒情开头 + 'the deepest emotion' 提升情感分量 + for 引出原因 + 'carried me through / all but lost hope' 具体化处境，避免空洞的 thankful

classPractice.question: The film stirs deep emotion in its audience, and it is highly ____ (emotion).
classPractice.note: emotion(n.) → emotional(adj. 动情的)；系动词 is 后接形容词

classPractice.question: On graduation day I was gripped by ____ ____: pride at how far I had come, and grief at leaving home.
classPractice.note: mixed emotions 复杂的心情、喜忧参半；情感为可数复数

classPractice.question: 他满怀感情地朗读了这首诗。（用 with ... emotion）He ____.
classPractice.answer: read the poem with (great) emotion / read the poem aloud with emotion
classPractice.note: with emotion 满怀感情地，作方式状语；read 过去式不变形

definitionEn:
(1) n. a small shallow round dish that a cup stands on
(2) n. any small shallow dish shaped like this, used for holding food, water, or paint
(3) n. something round and shallow that resembles such a dish in shape

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （flying saucer 中）飞碟状不明飞行物
uncommonMeanings.example: That night the villagers swore they had seen a silver saucer hovering above the paddy fields, its rim glowing like a second moon before it vanished without a sound. （读后续写·悬疑·目击不明飞行物）

posExamples.sentence: Grandmother poured the steaming tea into a delicate cup, set it gently on its matching saucer, and slid it across the table towards me, her eyes brimming with a warmth that no words could ever convey. （读后续写·亲情·祖孙温情）
Please remember to place a small saucer beneath each candle during the charity dinner, so that the dripping wax will not stain our carefully arranged tablecloths. （应用文·活动通知）
The child stared up at the fireworks with eyes as wide as saucers, utterly spellbound by the blossoms of light unfurling across the velvet sky. （读后续写·惊叹·儿童视角）

wordForms.other: 易混拼写：saucer(碟/茶托) ← sauce(酱汁) ← source(来源)；三词形近，注意 sauce 结尾 -ce、source 中间有 o、saucer 加 -r

collocations.example: On the tray sat a single cup and saucer, a silent testament to the guest who never came. （读后续写·失落·等待）
Ever since he read that article, the boy has been convinced that a flying saucer once landed in the woods behind his house. （读后续写·想象·童年）

collocations.phrase: eyes like saucers / eyes as wide as saucers
collocations.translation: 眼睛瞪得像碟子一样大（形容惊讶）
collocations.example: When the magician produced a dove from the empty hat, the little boy's eyes grew as wide as saucers. （读后续写·惊奇·魔术表演）

collocations.phrase: set / place sth on a saucer
collocations.example: She set a slice of lemon on the saucer, a small gesture of hospitality that made the weary traveller feel instantly at home. （读后续写·待客·温情）
Every evening the kind widow would leave a saucer of milk on the doorstep for the stray cat that had adopted her lonely cottage. （读后续写·善良·人与动物）

synonyms.example: He carried the small dish of soy sauce carefully so as not to spill a single drop. （读后续写·细节·用餐）
synonyms.usage: 泛指各种盛食物的盘碟，saucer 特指放在杯子下面的小浅碟

synonyms.example: She arranged the dumplings neatly on a white plate before setting them on the table. （应用文·食谱说明）
synonyms.usage: plate 是较大的平盘（用来盛主食），saucer 小而浅、专配茶杯咖啡杯

advancedExpressions.expression: a cup and saucer（一套杯碟）/ a flying saucer（飞碟）/ eyes as wide as saucers（眼睛瞪得溜圆）/ a saucer of milk（一碟牛奶）/ place sth on a saucer（放在碟上）
advancedExpressions.example: She set the cup and saucer down, and at the sight of the flying saucer in the picture, the child's eyes grew as wide as saucers. （一句串联 saucer 核心搭配，识记词块）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·盘碟（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: saucer（杯下小浅碟，专配茶/咖啡杯）↔ plate（较大的平盘，盛主食）↔ dish（泛指各种盛食物的盘碟）
advancedExpressions.example: 配茶杯的小碟用 saucer，装菜的大平盘用 plate，泛指盘碟用 dish——按大小与用途选词。

advancedExpressions.expression: eyes widened into saucers at the sight of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Her eyes widened into saucers at the sight of the acceptance letter, and for one breathless moment the whole world seemed to hold still. （用比喻放大惊喜，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: the gentle clink of cup against saucer
advancedExpressions.example: In the sudden silence, the gentle clink of cup against saucer seemed almost deafening, betraying just how nervous her trembling hands really were. （以细微声响暗示人物心理，续写以小见大）

advancedExpressions.expression: each ... should be provided with a saucer to ...
advancedExpressions.example: For hygiene and tidiness, each teacup should be provided with a saucer to catch any accidental spills during the tea-tasting session. （通知中说明细节安排）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She put the cup on the saucer.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With hands that would not stop trembling, she lowered the cup onto its saucer, the faint porcelain chime echoing the quiet flutter of her heart. （读后续写·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 独立结构描写动作细节 + 拟声词(chime)烘托氛围 + echo 建立声音与心理的呼应

sentenceUpgrade.original: The children were surprised when they saw the gift.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment the wrapping fell away, the children's eyes grew as wide as saucers, their gasps of delight tumbling over one another in the crisp morning air. （读后续写·群像·惊喜）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the moment 引导时间状语从句 + 比喻(as wide as saucers) + 独立主格(gasps tumbling over one another)群像化处理

classPractice.question: The child stared up at the fireworks with eyes as wide as ____, utterly spellbound.
classPractice.note: eyes as wide as saucers 眼睛瞪得像碟子一样大，比喻惊讶；比喻中用复数

classPractice.question: 用 saucer / sauce / source 填空：She set the teacup on its ____, then dipped a dumpling in the ____ made from a secret ____ of spices.
classPractice.note: 易混形近词：saucer 茶托/碟、sauce 酱汁、source 来源，靠语境区分

classPractice.question: 那天晚上，村民们发誓看见了一个飞碟悬在稻田上空。That night the villagers swore they had seen a ____ ____ hovering above the paddy fields.
classPractice.note: a flying saucer 飞碟，saucer 的固定搭配义项

original_sentence: Set the cooked dumplings on a plate and serve with vinegar.
readingExamples: Set the cooked dumplings on a plate and serve with vinegar.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a sour-tasting liquid made from wine, beer, or other liquids, used to add flavour to food or to preserve it
(2) n. this liquid regarded as a symbol of a sharp, bitter, or ill-tempered manner

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）尖酸刻薄的态度、怨气
uncommonMeanings.example: Years of disappointment had turned the once-cheerful man's words to vinegar, and few neighbours dared to greet him any more. （读后续写·人物·被岁月磨蚀的性格）

posExamples.sentence: Grandma dipped a plump dumpling into the little dish of dark vinegar, and as the tangy aroma rose between us, years of unspoken love seemed to gather around that humble family table. （读后续写·亲情·年夜饭）
Set the cooked dumplings on a plate and serve them with a small bowl of vinegar, into which you may stir a few slices of ginger for extra warmth and flavour. （应用文·食谱介绍）
Just as a drop of vinegar can spoil an entire jar of honey, one careless remark may undo the trust that took years to build — a truth we would all do well to remember. （议论文·人际交往·言语的分量）

collocations.translation: 配醋食用（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Set the cooked dumplings on a plate and serve with vinegar. 把煮好的饺子盛在盘子里，配醋食用。（课文原句）
He dipped each dumpling in vinegar with the practised ease of someone who had eaten this dish a thousand times before. （读后续写·细节·熟悉的动作）

collocations.phrase: a bottle / dash / drop of vinegar
collocations.example: Add just a dash of vinegar to the salad, and the crisp vegetables will taste twice as refreshing. （应用文·烹饪窍门）
The recipe calls for two spoonfuls of rice vinegar to give the sauce its distinctive tang. （应用文·食谱）
The unripe plum was as sour as vinegar, yet the children ate it laughing, their faces twisting into comical grimaces. （读后续写·童年·趣味）
She whisked together a simple vinegar and oil dressing, proving that the finest flavours often come from the humblest ingredients. （应用文·美食随笔）

synonyms.example: The chemistry teacher explained that the sharp taste of vinegar comes from a mild acid it naturally contains. （议论文·科普说明）
synonyms.usage: acid 是化学/科学层面的酸性物质，vinegar 是具体的调味液体；比喻义上 acid 也可指刻薄(acid remark)

synonyms.example: A hint of sourness lingered on the tongue, cutting cleverly through the richness of the fried meat. （读后续写·味觉描写）
synonyms.usage: sourness 是抽象的酸味特质，vinegar 是产生这种酸味的具体调料

advancedExpressions.expression: serve sth with vinegar（配醋食用）/ dip sth in vinegar（蘸醋）/ a dash/drop of vinegar（一点/一滴醋）/ rice vinegar（米醋）/ sour as vinegar（酸得像醋）
advancedExpressions.example: Serve the dumplings with vinegar, dip each one in the dark rice vinegar, and even a single drop of vinegar makes the dish sing. （一句串联 vinegar 核心搭配，识记词块）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·味觉描写（配 vinegar 的酸）
advancedExpressions.expression: sour（酸的，最直接）↔ tangy（酸爽开胃的，褒义）↔ sharp（尖锐刺激的酸）↔ acidic（酸性的，偏科学）
advancedExpressions.example: 写醋的酸可用 sour（中性）、tangy（诱人）、sharp（刺激），科学语境用 acidic——按情感色彩选词。

advancedExpressions.expression: vinegar 为不可数名词，计量用 a bottle/dash/drop of vinegar；作定语可构成 rice vinegar, vinegar and oil dressing。
advancedExpressions.example: Add a little vinegar.（对，不可数）；不说 a vinegar，而说 a bottle of vinegar。

advancedExpressions.expression: the tangy scent of vinegar drifted through ...
advancedExpressions.example: The tangy scent of vinegar drifted through the crowded kitchen, weaving together the laughter of three generations into a single, unforgettable New Year's Eve. （以气味串联记忆，续写调动多重感官）

advancedExpressions.expression: a splash of vinegar brings out the ...
advancedExpressions.example: A splash of vinegar brings out the natural sweetness of the dumplings, transforming a simple dish into a taste of home. （推荐信中突出风味亮点）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as vinegar ..., so too ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a spoonful of vinegar sharpens the flavour of an otherwise bland dish, so too can constructive criticism sharpen a mind grown complacent. （用生活类比引出观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We ate dumplings with vinegar.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We gathered around the steaming plate, dipping each dumpling into the fragrant vinegar, and in that simple, familiar ritual I finally understood what people meant by the taste of home. （读后续写·亲情升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语(dipping)增添画面 + in that ritual 承上启下 + the taste of home 主题句点明情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: A small mistake can ruin everything.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Like a single drop of vinegar souring an entire jar of honey, one thoughtless word can sour a friendship that took years of patience to sweeten. （议论文·比喻论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: like 引导明喻 + sour 一词双关(酸/破坏) + honey/sweeten 与 vinegar/sour 形成对比意象

classPractice.question: 把煮好的饺子盛在盘子里，配醋食用。Set the cooked dumplings on a plate and serve ____ vinegar.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；serve sth with vinegar 配醋食用，介词用 with

classPractice.question: Add just a ____ (drop) of vinegar to the salad, and the vegetables will taste twice as refreshing.
classPractice.note: vinegar 不可数，计量用 a drop/dash/bottle of vinegar

classPractice.question: 他熟练地把每个饺子蘸上醋。He ____ each dumpling ____ vinegar with practised ease.
classPractice.note: dip sth in vinegar 把某物蘸醋，dip 过去式 dipped，介词用 in

translation: n. 出生于某国（某地）的人；本地人 | adj. 出生地的；本地的；土著的；土产的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to the place where you were born or where you have always lived
(2) adj. (of a language) the first language you learned to speak as a child
(3) adj. (of plants or animals) growing or living naturally in a particular place
(4) n. someone who was born in a particular place

definitionEn:

translation: adj. 酸的，有酸味的；馊的 | vi. & vt. （使）变坏；变味，酸腐

The wronged villagers stood together, their united voices crying out for justice that had been too long denied. （议论文·公平正义）

collocations.translation: 因痛苦／恐惧而喊叫（字面义）
collocations.example: She cried out in pain as she twisted her ankle on the rocky trail, and instantly her companions rushed to her side. （读后续写·意外·互助）

synonyms.example: This delicate situation calls for patience and a great deal of tact. （议论文·处事之道）
synonyms.usage: call for 较中性、正式，指「需要/要求」；cry out for 语气更强烈、带迫切甚至绝望的情感色彩

synonyms.example: The rising tide of plastic waste demands immediate and decisive action from us all. （议论文·环保）
synonyms.usage: demand 强调「客观上必须」，语气坚决；cry out for 更带拟人化的情感呼喊，画面感更强

synonyms.example: After months of solitude, he craved nothing more than the sound of a familiar voice. （读后续写·孤独·渴望）
synonyms.usage: crave 指内心强烈的欲望/渴求（多指人），cry out for 主体常是事物/局面，强调外在迫切需求

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达'迫切需要'（由弱到强）
advancedExpressions.expression: need（需要）< call for（需要·要求，中性正式）< be in urgent need of（急需）< cry out for（拟人化地迫切呼唤）< be desperate for（极度渴求）
advancedExpressions.example: The dry land did not merely need rain — it cried out for it. （写作升格链：把平淡的 need 换成 cry out for，主语常为事物/局面，带拟人的画面感与紧迫感）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·cry out for 的搭配结构
advancedExpressions.expression: cry out for + n.（迫切需要某物）；be crying out for（进行时强化迫切）；字面义 cry out in pain/fear（因痛苦/恐惧而喊叫）
advancedExpressions.example: The neglected old house is crying out for repair. ／ She cried out in pain as she twisted her ankle. （比喻义'亟需' vs 字面义'喊叫'，靠后接介词 for/in 区分）

advancedExpressions.expression: everything around ... seemed to cry out for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The wilted crops, the dry riverbed, the very air itself — everything around him seemed to cry out for the mercy of a single rainfall. （用排比+拟人渲染绝境，续写造势）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., which cries out for our immediate action
advancedExpressions.example: The worsening pollution of our beloved river is a problem which cries out for our immediate and collective action. （倡议书中制造紧迫感）

advancedExpressions.expression: our times cry out for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our times, restless and ever-changing, cry out for young people of conviction — those willing to shoulder responsibility rather than merely chase comfort. （以时代口吻立论，增强气势）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old house needed to be repaired.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old house, with its sagging roof and peeling walls, seemed almost to cry out for repair, as though pleading silently with every passer-by not to let it fall into ruin. （读后续写·拟人·画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 独立结构补充细节 + cry out for 拟人化 + as though 引导虚拟从句强化哀求感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Society needs honest people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In a world too often ruled by convenience and self-interest, our society cries out for honest souls — those rare individuals who hold fast to their principles even when no one is watching. （议论文·呼吁·观点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In a world... 状语铺垫背景 + cry out for 增强呼唤力度 + 破折号补充定义 + even when no one is watching 点睛升华

classPractice.question: In an age drowning in noise and haste, our society ____ ____ ____ people who dare to slow down and think deeply.
classPractice.note: cry out for 迫切需要（习语）；主语 society 为第三人称单数，用 cries

classPractice.question: 那座摇摇欲坠的老图书馆亟需修缮。（用 cry out for）
classPractice.answer: The crumbling old library cries out for renovation. / The crumbling old library is crying out for renovation.
classPractice.note: cry out for + n. 表示（事物）迫切需要；进行时 be crying out for 更能强化紧迫感

classPractice.question: This delicate situation ____ (calls for / cries out for) patience and tact, though the wording stays calm and neutral.
classPractice.note: call for 中性正式地'需要/要求'；cry out for 语气更强、带迫切甚至绝望的情感色彩，此处语境'calm and neutral'选 call for

original_sentence: Adjectives expressing positive feelings include amazed, delighted, joyous, overjoyed, cheerful, excited, satisfied, relieved, energetic, calm and peaceful.
readingExamples: Adjectives expressing positive feelings include amazed, delighted, joyous, overjoyed, cheerful, excited, satisfied, relieved, energetic, calm and peaceful.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make an unpleasant feeling, such as pain or worry, less strong
(2) vt. to make a problem less serious, or to help someone who is in a difficult situation
(3) vt. to take over a duty or job from someone, or to free someone from a task
(4) vt. to make a boring situation more interesting or pleasant

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 接替，替换（某人上岗）
uncommonMeanings.example: At the stroke of midnight the young nurse arrived to relieve the exhausted doctor, who had not left the patient's bedside for eighteen hours. （读后续写·医院坚守·接班）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使免除（职务、负担）；解职
uncommonMeanings.example: Sensing the boy's shame, the coach quietly relieved him of the captain's armband, sparing him the humiliation of a public dismissal. （读后续写·体育·维护尊严）

posExamples.sentence: The instant the search team's torchlight swept across the cave, a wave of relief washed over the trapped hikers, and the mother sank to her knees, tears relieving the terror that had gripped her all night. （读后续写·被困获救·情感释放）
I am writing to propose several measures that could relieve the mounting pressure our senior students face, so that they may sit their examinations with a calm and confident mind. （应用文·建议信·减压）
Far from relieving poverty, indiscriminate charity may in fact deepen dependence; genuine aid must equip people to stand on their own feet. （议论文·扶贫与自立）
A single lamp glowing in the distant farmhouse relieved the oppressive darkness of the moor, and for the first time that night the lost traveller allowed himself to hope. （读后续写·迷途·环境点睛）

idioms.example: Unable to bear the silence any longer, she relieved her feelings in a torrent of words, and only then did the tension in the room begin to ease. （读后续写·情绪宣泄）

collocations.example: Listening to music can help relieve stress. 听音乐有助于缓解压力。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】帮某人减轻（负担）；开除／解除某人的职务
collocations.example: Let me relieve you of some of your bags. 我来帮你拿几个袋子吧。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: relieve the victims of the earthquake
collocations.example: The government took measures immediately to relieve the victims of the earthquake. 政府迅速采取措施来赈济地震灾民。（课件翻译原句）

collocations.phrase: relief (n.) — to one's relief / in relief
collocations.translation: 【课件】relief n. (痛苦等的)减轻；宽慰；救济物；to one's relief 令某人安心的是；in / with relief 如释重负地
collocations.example: To my relief, he didn't argue with my suggestion at all. 令我宽慰的是，他对我的建议根本没有反驳。／ He laughed in / with relief. 他如释重负地笑了。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】relieved adj. 宽心的，宽慰的；做某事而感到宽慰
collocations.example: The driver felt quite relieved to see that nobody had been injured in the traffic accident. 看到没人在这次车祸中受伤，司机深感宽慰。（课件例句）
Regular exercise not only strengthens the body but also relieves the stress that so often clouds a student's mind before exams. （应用文·倡议书·健康生活）
The gentle words of the old nurse did more to relieve the child's suffering than any medicine could. （读后续写·医院·人文关怀）

collocations.translation: 解除某人的（负担/职务/物品）
collocations.example: Stepping forward, the stranger relieved the elderly lady of her heavy bags and carried them all the way to her door. （读后续写·陌生人善意）
A reassuring phone call from home was enough to relieve the anxiety that had kept her awake for days. （读后续写·思乡·安慰）
The new footbridge greatly relieved the traffic congestion that had long plagued the school gate. （应用文·调查报告）
Volunteering after class, the students hoped to relieve the burden on the overworked cleaning staff. （应用文·志愿活动）
To relieve the monotony of the long train journey, grandfather began to spin tales of his youth, and the carriage fell silent with wonder. （读后续写·旅途·祖辈故事）

collocations.translation: 做某事/得知某事而感到宽慰
collocations.example: We were all relieved to learn that every passenger had been rescued unharmed. （议论文/应用文·新闻叙述）

synonyms.example: A few deep breaths eased the panic rising in her chest, and she stepped onto the stage at last. （读后续写·克服紧张）
synonyms.usage: ease 更口语化，常指使痛苦、紧张、程度逐渐减弱；relieve 语气稍正式，还可指'接替、免除'

synonyms.example: The government launched a series of policies to alleviate the plight of low-income families. （议论文·民生）
synonyms.usage: alleviate 为正式书面词，多用于议论文中缓解痛苦、贫困、问题等抽象大主题，比 relieve 更庄重

synonyms.example: Her mother's soft humming soothed the frightened boy until his sobbing faded into steady breathing. （读后续写·安抚孩子）
synonyms.usage: soothe 侧重情感/身体上的抚慰安抚，带温柔意味；relieve 侧重'去除'某种负面感受或负担

advancedExpressions.expression: relieve stress/pressure/tension（缓解压力）· relieve pain/suffering（减轻痛苦）· relieve sb. of sth.（解除某人的负担/职务/物品）· be relieved to do / that ...（如释重负）
advancedExpressions.example: Exercise relieves stress; the nurse relieved his pain; the stranger relieved the old lady of her heavy bags; we were all relieved to learn everyone was safe. （一次记全 relieve 的四类高频用法，其中 relieve sb. of sth. 是考试重点结构）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·relieve 词族全家桶
advancedExpressions.expression: relieve (v. 减轻) → relief (n. 减轻·宽慰·救济) → relieved (adj. 感到宽慰的，修饰人) → relieving (adj. 令人宽慰的，修饰物)
advancedExpressions.example: To her great relief, the medicine relieved the pain; she felt relieved, and the relieving news spread quickly. （名词 relief 与形容词 relieved/relieving 的区分是语法填空高频考点：修饰人用 -ed，修饰物用 -ing）

advancedExpressions.expression: a wave of relief washed over sb., relieving ...
advancedExpressions.example: A wave of relief washed over the whole family, relieving the fear that had bound their hearts since dawn. （比喻+现在分词伴随，情绪释放场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: measures such as ... would go a long way towards relieving ...
advancedExpressions.example: Measures such as flexible schedules and peer support would go a long way towards relieving the pressure weighing on our classmates. （建议信提出对策）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from relieving ..., ... may in fact ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from relieving inequality, unchecked technology may in fact widen the gap between rich and poor. （让步+转折，反驳片面观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She felt relieved when she saw her son.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment her son's small figure emerged from the crowd, the icy dread that had clutched at her heart melted away, and a warm tide of relief left her trembling, laughing and weeping all at once. （读后续写·失而复得·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment...时间状语从句 + 隐喻(icy dread / warm tide of relief) + 三动词并列(trembling, laughing, weeping)渲染情绪

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should help relieve students' pressure.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore imperative that our school take concrete steps to relieve the academic pressure bearing down on students, lest their passion for learning be crushed beneath the weight of endless assessments. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is imperative that + 虚拟语气(take) + 现在分词后置定语(bearing down) + lest引导目的状语从句

classPractice.type: 翻译句子【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: 大哭了一场 (a good cry) 才使她悲伤的情绪得以缓和。（用 relieve）
classPractice.answer: Her sadness was relieved by a good cry. / A good cry relieved her sadness.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】relieve 减轻、缓解（不愉快的情绪）；主动 A good cry relieved... 与被动 ...was relieved by a good cry 均可

classPractice.type: 翻译句子【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: 政府迅速采取措施来赈济地震灾民。
classPractice.answer: The government took measures immediately to relieve the victims of the earthquake.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】relieve the victims of... 赈济……的灾民；take measures to do sth 采取措施做某事

classPractice.type: 翻译句子【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: 我不想这么说，但是他不在家里确实让我很轻松。（用 relief）
classPractice.answer: I hate to say it, but it was a relief to have him out of the house.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】it is a relief to do sth 做某事让人如释重负；relief 作名词表'宽慰'

classPractice.question: To everyone's great ____ (relieve), the missing child was found safe and sound before nightfall.
classPractice.note: 介词 to 后接名词，relieve 的名词形式为 relief；to one's relief 令某人宽慰的是

classPractice.question: We were all deeply ____ (relieve) to hear that every passenger had survived the crash.
classPractice.note: 形容词修饰人（表'感到宽慰的'）用 -ed 形式 relieved；be relieved to do sth

classPractice.question: 那位陌生人帮老太太拎下了沉重的行李。The stranger ____ the old lady ____ her heavy bags.
classPractice.note: relieve sb. of sth. 解除某人的负担/替某人拿走某物，介词固定用 of

original_sentence: Comfort food tastes good and by building an emotional bond with our happy memories, always makes us feel good.
readingExamples: Comfort food tastes good and by building an emotional bond with our happy memories, always makes us feel good.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a close connection or feeling that unites people or groups
(2) n. something that ties or fastens things together; a force that holds atoms together in chemistry
(3) n. an official document promising to repay borrowed money with interest; a financial security
(4) vt. & vi. to develop a close relationship, or to join two things firmly together

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 债券（金融）
uncommonMeanings.example: His grandfather had left him nothing but a bundle of yellowed government bonds — worthless now, the boy thought bitterly, until an old collector offered him a small fortune for them. （读后续写·遗产·意外转折）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 束缚，镣铐（常作复数 bonds）
uncommonMeanings.example: For years she had lived in the invisible bonds of others' expectations; the day she boarded that train alone, she felt them snap one by one. （读后续写·女性觉醒·挣脱束缚）

posExamples.sentence: Through countless shared hardships on the mountain, an unspoken bond had grown between the two climbers — the kind of trust that needs no words and never asks for repayment. （读后续写·患难与共·情谊）
I sincerely believe that the exchange programme will forge a lasting bond of friendship between students from our two schools. （应用文·交流信·友谊）
The bonds that hold a nation together are not merely laws and borders, but a shared memory and a common hope for the future. （议论文·民族认同）
As they bandaged each other's wounds in silence, the two former rivals bonded in a way that years of competition never could have allowed. （读后续写·对手和解·情感联结）

wordForms.other: bondage (n. 束缚，奴役)

idioms.example: 'Take the boat and go,' the old fisherman said, 'my word is my bond — I shall be waiting on this shore when you return.' （读后续写·守信·对话）

collocations.phrase: forge / establish / create / build a close / emotional bond with sb / between A and B
collocations.translation: 【课件】与某人 / 在……之间建立紧密的关系／情感纽带
collocations.example: Comfort food tastes good and by building an emotional bond with our happy memories, always makes us feel good. 治愈系食物味道可口，通过与我们快乐的回忆之间建立情感联系，它总是让我们心情不错。（课文原句）
Nothing could break the bond of friendship that had grown between them over the years. 多年来在他们之间形成的友谊纽带无可斩断。
Time must be given for the teacher to bond with her students. 老师和学生之间需要时间来培养师生情谊。（课件例句）
The two survivors forged a bond in those desperate days that no distance could ever weaken. （读后续写·患难情谊）
Comfort food builds an emotional bond with our happiest memories, and a single familiar taste can carry us home. （议论文·食物与情感）
The close bond between the guide dog and its blind owner moved everyone who watched them cross the busy street. （读后续写·人与动物）
There grew a quiet bond between the lonely widow and the stray cat that came to her window each dawn. （读后续写·孤独与陪伴）
Working side by side on the community project deepened the bond among the volunteers. （应用文·活动感悟）
No quarrel, however fierce, could sever the family bonds that had held them together through decades of hardship. （读后续写·亲情）
Over long evenings by the fire, the foster child slowly bonded with the couple who had opened their home to her. （读后续写·收养·情感建立）
Not even the ocean between them could sever the bond the two friends had built in childhood. （读后续写·友谊长存）

synonyms.example: The ties of loyalty that bound the old soldiers to one another had only grown stronger with the passing years. （读后续写·战友情）
synonyms.usage: tie 常用复数 ties，泛指人与人、人与地之间的联系（血缘、友谊、乡土）；bond 语气更深，强调情感或信任的牢固结合

synonyms.example: She felt an instant connection with the stranger, as though they had known each other in another life. （读后续写·奇妙缘分）
synonyms.usage: connection 泛指任何联系（含逻辑、网络、人际），中性；bond 特指双方之间牢固、亲密、带情感的联结

synonyms.example: His deep attachment to the old house made the thought of selling it almost unbearable. （读后续写·故土难离）
synonyms.usage: attachment 侧重单方面的依恋、眷恋之情（对人、地、物）；bond 强调双向、相互的联结

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·bond 名词与动词搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: form / forge a bond（缔结纽带）· an emotional / strong / close bond（情感的/牢固的纽带）· a bond between A and B（A 与 B 之间的纽带）· bond with sb.（v. 与某人建立亲密关系）
advancedExpressions.example: Comfort food builds an emotional bond with our happy memories; the foster child slowly bonded with the couple. （课本主题词：既可作名词 a bond between，也可作动词 bond with，构成'建立情感联结'语义群）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·bond 一词多义与词族
advancedExpressions.expression: bond n. 纽带/债券/(pl.)束缚镣铐 & v. 结合；bonding (n. 亲密关系的建立) · bonded (adj.) · bondage (n. 束缚，奴役)
advancedExpressions.example: An emotional bond (纽带) unites them; he inherited government bonds (债券); she broke free from the bonds (束缚) of others' expectations. （一词多义全枚举：纽带 / 金融债券 / 复数束缚）

advancedExpressions.expression: an unspoken bond had grown between ...
advancedExpressions.example: An unspoken bond had grown between them, forged not in words but in the silent understanding of two hearts that had weathered the same storm. （过去完成时+隐喻，续写点明情谊）

advancedExpressions.expression: will forge a lasting bond of ... between ...
advancedExpressions.example: This joint charity sale will forge a lasting bond of friendship between our two classes and remind us how much good we can achieve together. （交流/倡议信升华意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: the bonds that hold ... together are not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The bonds that hold a community together are not wealth or convenience, but mutual trust and a willingness to sacrifice. （否定并列，揭示本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The two boys became good friends.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Having survived that terrifying night in the flooded valley together, the two boys were no longer mere classmates; a bond had been sealed between them, unbreakable and wordless, the way only shared danger can forge. （读后续写·患难成友）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词短语(Having survived)作状语交代因果 + no longer...but结构递进 + 破折号补充比喻(the way...can forge)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Sports can bring students closer.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely on the sports field, amid sweat and cheers, that genuine bonds are forged among students — bonds that survive long after the final whistle and shape the friendships of a lifetime. （应用文/议论文·体育育人）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that强调句 + 插入语(amid sweat and cheers)增画面 + 破折号后同位语延伸(bonds that...)升华

classPractice.question: Comfort food tastes good and, by building an emotional ____ with our happy memories, always makes us feel good.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；an emotional bond 情感纽带；build/form/forge a bond 建立纽带

classPractice.question: Working side by side through those hard days, the two volunteers gradually ____ ____ each other and became lifelong friends.
classPractice.note: bond with sb. 与某人建立亲密关系（此处 bond 作动词，过去式 bonded）

classPractice.question: 共同的苦难在两名登山者之间缔结了一种不言而喻的纽带。Countless shared hardships had ____ an unspoken ____ between the two climbers.
classPractice.note: forge/form a bond between A and B 在 A 与 B 之间缔结纽带；bond 此处作名词

translation: 安全；保护措施；安全感；保障，保证
original_sentence: When we are in low spirits, we may (1) _________________ things that give us comfort and a sense of security.
readingExamples: When we are in low spirits, we may (1) _________________ things that give us comfort and a sense of security.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the state of being protected from danger, harm, or attack
(2) n. the feeling of being safe, free from anxiety, and confident about the future
(3) n. the measures, people, or organization that protect a place or person
(4) n. something valuable given as a guarantee that a loan will be repaid; (pl.) financial investments such as stocks and bonds

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 抵押品，担保物（金融/法律）
uncommonMeanings.example: Having no money left, the desperate merchant offered his ancestral house as security for the loan — a gamble that would either save or ruin his family. （读后续写·孤注一掷）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 证券（常作复数 securities）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old man had quietly invested in securities for forty years, and the fortune he left behind astonished the very relatives who had once dismissed him. （读后续写·意外遗产）

posExamples.sentence: Wrapped in her grandmother's worn quilt, the little girl felt a warmth and security she had not known since her parents left, and for the first time in weeks she slept through the night. （读后续写·祖孙·安全感）
I am writing to suggest that the school install more lighting and cameras in the car park in order to improve the security of students who leave after evening classes. （应用文·建议信·校园安全）
True security lies not in walls and weapons, but in mutual understanding among nations; only through cooperation can lasting peace be secured. （议论文·和平与合作）
When we are in low spirits, we may reach for the familiar tastes and objects that give us comfort and a quiet sense of security. （议论文/说明文·情感与食物）

definitionEn:

(2) vt. to produce energy or power, such as electricity or heat
(3) vt. to produce or create something, such as income, jobs, or ideas

posExamples.sentence: The moment the champion crossed the finish line, the roaring crowd generated a wave of energy so electric that even the tired volunteers leapt to their feet, cheering until their voices cracked. （读后续写·赛场·集体沸腾）
I firmly believe that a school-wide reading festival would generate great enthusiasm among students and cultivate a lasting love of literature. （应用文·倡议书·活动效果）

The teacher's vivid storytelling generated such interest that no one noticed the bell ring. （读后续写·课堂魅力）

Brainstorming freely, the group generated a dozen creative solutions within minutes. （应用文·活动感悟）
The proposal to shorten the summer holiday generated heated debate among parents and teachers alike. （议论文·教育政策）
Digesting high-calorie food generates heat, which is one reason it can make us feel warm and comforted. （说明文·科学解释）
Small acts of kindness generate positive emotions that ripple far beyond the moment they occur. （议论文·善意的力量）

synonyms.example: Her novel created a world so vivid that readers felt they could step into it. （读后续写·文学创作）
synonyms.usage: create 强调'从无到有的创造'（作品、机会、氛围）；generate 更侧重'引发、生成'某种结果或能量，常带自动产生之意

definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to change food in the stomach into substances that the body can absorb and use
(2) vt. to think about and fully understand new information or an idea after taking time to consider it
(3) n. a short piece of writing that contains the most important facts of a longer document or a collection of writings
(4) vt. to accept or come to terms with an unpleasant or shocking piece of news
