collocations.example: His latest novel is one of the most impressive novels of recent years. 他最新的小说是近年来最令人难忘的小说之一。

collocations.translation: 以某事给某人留下深刻印象
collocations.example: She impressed the judges with her fluent English. 她用流利的英语给评委留下深刻印象。
I was deeply impressed by his kindness. 我被他的善良深深打动。
My mother impressed on me the value of honesty. 母亲让我铭记诚实的价值。

collocations.phrase: leave / make a deep impression on sb.
collocations.example: The trip left a deep impression on me. 那次旅行给我留下了深刻印象。

collocations.translation: 令人印象深刻的表演／景色
collocations.example: The dancers gave an impressive performance. 舞者们的表演令人印象深刻。
I was under the impression that you had left. 我还以为你已经走了。

collocations.phrase: make / leave a good impression on sb.
collocations.example: A firm handshake and steady eye contact can make a lasting impression on your interviewer within the very first minute. （应用文·求职建议）
The old craftsman's devotion to his fading art left a lasting impression on every visitor who wandered into his tiny workshop. （读后续写·传统技艺）
First impressions may be powerful, yet they are often misleading, for true character reveals itself only over time. （议论文·以貌取人）

collocations.translation: 令人印象深刻的表演／成就
collocations.example: Her impressive performance on the national stage earned her a standing ovation that seemed to last forever. （读后续写·舞台高光）

synonyms.example: His courage inspired the whole class to try harder. 他的勇气激励全班更努力。
synonyms.usage: inspire 强调激发行动或情感,给人向上动力,常接 sb. to do;impress 强调令人敬佩、留下印象,不一定引发行动

synonyms.translation: 使突然注意到，给……深刻印象
synonyms.example: What struck me most was her calm. 最让我震动的是她的镇定。
synonyms.usage: strike 强调瞬间、突如其来的印象,常用 what struck sb. was...;impress 侧重持续的敬佩与影响

synonyms.example: The letter moved us to tears. 那封信让我们感动落泪。
synonyms.usage: move 侧重情感上的触动、感动;impress 侧重理智上的敬佩、欣赏,情感浓度较低

advancedExpressions.expression: impress sb. with sth. / be impressed by sth. / impress sth. on sb.
advancedExpressions.example: 同一个词根三种搭配:impress sb. with(以…打动某人)、be impressed by(被…打动)、impress sth. on sb.(使某人铭记),课堂一并记牢主动被动与介词。

advancedExpressions.expression: impress → impression(n.印象) → impressive(adj.令人印象深刻的) → impressed(adj.印象深刻的,修饰人)
advancedExpressions.example: The impressive scenery impressed everyone, and it left a lasting impression on me. 区分 impressive(物,令人印象深刻)与 impressed(人,感到印象深刻)。

advancedExpressions.expression: what impressed me most was not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What impressed me most was not her talent, but her humility. not...but... 对比句,凸显更可贵的品质。

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not ... but ... that truly impresses ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not eloquent promises but steadfast actions that truly impress the public. 强调句 it is...that + not...but 对比,论证有力。

advancedExpressions.expression: genuine ... often impresses far more deeply than ...
advancedExpressions.example: In any interview, genuine sincerity often impresses far more deeply than a polished rehearsal of one's accomplishments. （比较结构传递建议,说服力强）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her speech impressed everyone.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her speech, delivered with quiet conviction and heartfelt passion, impressed every listener so profoundly that a hush fell over the hall long after her final word had faded. （读后续写·演讲高光）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作后置定语(delivered with...) + so...that 结果状语从句 + 环境烘托(a hush fell over the hall)营造余韵

sentenceUpgrade.original: Teachers should teach students to be honest.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is the sacred duty of every educator to impress upon young minds that honesty, though sometimes costly, remains the surest foundation of a life well lived. （议论文·教育论述）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: it is the duty of...to 正式主句 + impress upon sb. that 固定搭配 + though 让步插入语 + 抽象升华(a life well lived)

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: We were impressed ____ the beautiful scenery of the small mountain village as well as the friendliness of the ____ (village).
classPractice.note: 【课件】be impressed with / by sth. 对……印象深刻；the friendliness of the villagers 村民们的友善，village 的名词复数（人）为 villagers

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: The lady always gives others an ____ (impress) of being very learned.
classPractice.note: 【课件】give sb. an impression of doing sth. 给某人……的印象；an 后接名词 impression

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: She was very ____ (impress) in the interview.
classPractice.note: 【课件】此处指'她表现得令人印象深刻/出彩'，用 impressive（令人钦佩的）；若表'她本人感到印象深刻'则用 impressed

classPractice.question: I was deeply ____ (impress) by the beautiful scenery of the bay.
classPractice.note: be impressed by/with sth. 对…印象深刻,人作主语用过去分词

classPractice.question: 用 impressed / impressive 填空:The ____ view from the tower ____ every visitor.
classPractice.note: impressive 修饰物(令人印象深刻的),impressed 表人的感受;此处第二空作谓语用 impressed 的动词过去式

classPractice.question: 老师努力使我们铭记诚实的价值。The teacher tried to ____ ____ us the value of honesty.
classPractice.note: impress sth. on/upon sb. 使某人铭记某事

original_sentence: B3 Imagine your friend has taken you out to dinner at Sky Buffet.
readingExamples: B3 Imagine your friend has taken you out to dinner at Sky Buffet.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a meal at which people serve themselves from a variety of dishes set out on a table
(2) n. a counter or bar where food and drinks are served, often in a station or on a train
(3) v. /ˈbʌfɪt/ (formal) to strike repeatedly and violently, especially of wind or waves

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （风、浪等）反复猛烈冲击，拍打（读音为 /ˈbʌfɪt/）
uncommonMeanings.example: All night long the fierce storm buffeted the little fishing boat, yet the old sailor gripped the wheel and refused to surrender to the raging sea. （读后续写·海上求生·意志力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （车站或列车上的）餐吧，小吃部
uncommonMeanings.example: We grabbed two sandwiches from the station buffet and boarded the train just as the whistle blew. （读后续写·旅途匆忙）

posExamples.sentence: The buffet stretched the length of the hall, its long tables groaning under platters of glistening seafood, colourful salads and desserts too tempting to resist. （读后续写·盛宴场景·视觉描写）
To celebrate the end of the term, our class will host a buffet dinner in the school hall this Friday, and everyone is warmly welcome to bring a homemade dish to share. （应用文·通知）
While an all-you-can-eat buffet may seem a bargain, it often tempts diners to pile their plates far beyond their appetite, resulting in shocking amounts of food waste. （议论文·反对浪费）
As a token of appreciation, the company treated its volunteers to a lavish buffet, where laughter and gratitude flowed as freely as the food. （读后续写·感恩回馈）

wordForms.other: 发音注意:作"自助餐"读 /ˈbʊfeɪ/(法语借词,末尾 t 不发音);作"冲击"义读 /ˈbʌfɪt/。易与 buffalo(水牛)、buff 混。

collocations.example: The hotel serves a buffet breakfast every morning. 酒店每天早上提供自助早餐。
We had lunch at an all-you-can-eat buffet. 我们在一家任食自助餐厅吃了午饭。
Please help yourself at the buffet. 请自便,自助取餐。

collocations.phrase: a buffet table / a buffet-style meal
collocations.example: Guests gathered around the buffet table. 客人们围在自助餐台旁。
The host laid on a splendid buffet. 主人摆设了一桌丰盛的自助餐。
Guests gathered around the buffet table, plates in hand, exchanging warm smiles and small talk. （读后续写·社交场合）
To reduce waiting time, the organisers arranged a buffet-style meal so that participants could eat whenever they wished. （应用文·活动安排）
A cold buffet of salads, cheeses and cured meats awaited the guests on the sunlit terrace. （读后续写·优雅场景）

synonyms.example: A grand banquet was held for the guests. 为宾客举行了盛大的宴会。
synonyms.usage: banquet 指正式、隆重、由人上菜的宴会,规格高;buffet 指自助取餐,形式随意、气氛轻松

synonyms.example: The reunion turned into a joyous feast. 团聚变成了一场欢乐的盛宴。
synonyms.usage: feast 强调食物丰盛、气氛欢庆,可正式可家常;buffet 特指自助取餐的用餐形式

advancedExpressions.expression: buffet /ˈbʊfeɪ/ 自助餐(法语借词,词尾 t 不发音,重音在前)
advancedExpressions.example: "自助餐"buffet 末尾 t 不读,类似 ballet /ˈbæleɪ/、café /ˈkæfeɪ/ 等法语借词;而动词 buffet /ˈbʌfɪt/(风浪冲击)按常规读出。

advancedExpressions.expression: a buffet dinner / help oneself at the buffet / an all-you-can-eat buffet
advancedExpressions.example: 描述聚餐场景:host a buffet dinner(办自助晚餐)、help yourself(自取)、all-you-can-eat(任食),应用文写活动安排常用。

advancedExpressions.expression: we will host a buffet ..., and everyone is warmly welcome to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We will host a buffet gathering, and everyone is warmly welcome to join us. 通知/邀请常用欢迎句式。

advancedExpressions.expression: while ... may seem a bargain, it often tempts ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: While an all-you-can-eat buffet may seem a bargain, it often tempts people to take far more than they can finish. 让步转折揭示隐患,论证节约主题。

advancedExpressions.expression: the buffet ..., its tables groaning under ...
advancedExpressions.example: The buffet ran the length of the hall, its tables groaning under mountains of food that dazzled the eye and stirred the appetite. （groan under 拟人夸张,渲染丰盛盛况）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was a lot of food at the buffet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: At the buffet, dish after dish stretched before us in a dazzling array of colours and aromas, and for a moment I simply stood there, overwhelmed by such generous abundance. （读后续写·感官冲击）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: dish after dish 重复强调丰盛 + array of colours and aromas 视嗅结合 + 破折号引出人物反应(overwhelmed by...)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Please do not waste food at the buffet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In view of the alarming food waste at buffets, we sincerely urge every diner to take only what he can finish, so that the spirit of thrift may be passed on to the next generation. （议论文/倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in view of 引出背景 + we sincerely urge 呼吁句式 + so that 目的状语升华主题(spirit of thrift)

classPractice.question: To celebrate the festival, our class will host a ____ (自助餐) dinner in the hall.
classPractice.note: buffet dinner 自助晚餐;注意拼写 -ff-,读 /ˈbʊfeɪ/

classPractice.question: 请自便,在自助餐台上自取食物。Please ____ ____ at the buffet.
classPractice.note: help oneself (at/to) 自取(食物),反身代词与主语一致

classPractice.question: 这家酒店提供任食自助餐。(用 all-you-can-eat buffet)
classPractice.answer: The hotel offers / serves an all-you-can-eat buffet.
classPractice.note: all-you-can-eat 作定语修饰 buffet,复合形容词用连字符

original_sentence: (1) _________________ (locate) at the top of Tower 88, it gives you an amazing view of the bay.
readingExamples: (1) _________________ (locate) at the top of Tower 88, it gives you an amazing view of the bay.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a part of the coast where the land curves inwards and the sea forms a wide sheltered area
(2) n. a section or compartment of a building, vehicle or aircraft set aside for a particular purpose (e.g. a loading bay, a parking bay)
(3) n. an evergreen tree or shrub whose aromatic leaves (bay leaves) are used in cooking
(4) v. (of a dog) to make a long, deep howling sound

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （建筑物、车辆中的）隔间，分区，专用区域
uncommonMeanings.example: The ambulance reversed into the emergency bay, and within seconds a team of nurses swarmed around the stretcher with practised urgency. （读后续写·急救现场·紧张节奏）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 月桂（树叶可作香料，即 bay leaf）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandmother dropped a single bay leaf into the simmering broth, and its subtle fragrance soon filled every corner of the humble kitchen. （读后续写·家常味道·嗅觉记忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用于短语 hold / keep sth. at bay）使……不能靠近，抵挡
uncommonMeanings.example: Clutching the faint flashlight, the boy tried desperately to hold his rising panic at bay as the darkness of the cave pressed in around him. （读后续写·独自探险·心理描写）

posExamples.sentence: From the cliff top we gazed down at the sweeping bay, where the sapphire water sparkled beneath the setting sun and fishing boats drifted lazily towards home. （读后续写·海滨风光·视觉描写）
Our seaside town, blessed with a tranquil bay and golden beaches, warmly welcomes tourists to enjoy its gentle waves and breathtaking sunsets. （应用文·景点介绍）
The pollution steadily choking the once-pristine bay reminds us that unchecked development, if left unregulated, will inevitably destroy the very beauty that draws people to it. （议论文·环境保护）
As our ship glided quietly into the sheltered bay, the raging storm we had endured all night suddenly felt like a distant, half-forgotten nightmare. （读后续写·历劫归来·情绪转折）

wordForms.other: bay leaf (n. 月桂叶,烹饪香料)。多义:①海湾 ②建筑/车辆隔间(loading bay) ③月桂 ④(犬)长嚎。习语 keep sth. at bay 中的 bay 源自"被围困处"。

idioms.translation: 控制住，防止（坏事）靠近；抵挡
idioms.example: A healthy diet helps keep illness at bay. 健康饮食有助于防病。

collocations.example: The boat found refuge in a sheltered bay. 小船在一处避风的海湾里找到了庇护。

collocations.phrase: a view of the bay / overlook the bay
collocations.example: Our hotel room overlooked the bay. 我们的房间俯瞰着海湾。
Fishing boats sailed out across the bay at dawn. 黎明时渔船驶出横渡海湾。
The van pulled into the loading bay. 货车驶入了装卸区。
She sat by the bay window reading. 她坐在飘窗旁读书。
Our hotel room overlooked the bay, and each morning I woke to the soft cry of seagulls and the shimmer of dawn on the water. （读后续写·晨间美景）
Perched at the top of the tower, the revolving restaurant offers a stunning view of the bay that leaves every visitor spellbound. （应用文·景点推介）
A lonely lighthouse stood at the mouth of the bay, its beam sweeping tirelessly across the treacherous rocks. （读后续写·海岸意象）

synonyms.example: The vast gulf stretched beyond the horizon, its waters linking distant nations through centuries of trade. （议论文·地理与交流）
synonyms.usage: gulf 指规模宏大、深入内陆的大海湾(如 the Persian Gulf);bay 一般较小、较浅,更贴近海岸生活

synonyms.example: Hidden behind the cliffs lay a secret cove, its silver sand untouched by any footprint but our own. （读后续写·秘境发现）
synonyms.usage: cove 指更小、更隐蔽的小海湾,常带私密、幽静之感;bay 范围较大,是通用的海湾概念

advancedExpressions.expression: keep / hold sth. at bay 控制住、防止…靠近
advancedExpressions.example: keep the cold / illness / fear at bay(挡住寒冷/疾病/恐惧),议论文谈健康、心理防线时地道又出彩。

advancedExpressions.expression: from ..., we gazed down at the ... bay, where ...
advancedExpressions.example: From the cliff, we gazed down at the glittering bay, where sunlight danced on the waves. 视角俯瞰 + where 定语从句铺陈画面。

advancedExpressions.expression: blessed with ..., our ... warmly welcomes ... to enjoy ...
advancedExpressions.example: Blessed with a crystal-clear bay, our hometown warmly welcomes visitors to enjoy its beauty. 过去分词开头 + 邀请句式。

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... choking the once-pristine ... reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The plastic waste choking the once-pristine bay reminds us that careless convenience has a price. 现在分词后置定语 + reminds us that 引出警示。

sentenceUpgrade.original: We looked at the beautiful bay.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Standing on the cliff at dusk, we lost ourselves in the beauty of the bay below, where the crimson sky melted into the tranquil water and the whole world seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·黄昏海景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语点明时空(Standing...at dusk) + lose oneself in 沉醉句式 + where 从句绘景 + 拟人收束(the world held its breath)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bay is polluted and should be protected.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we continue to turn a blind eye to the pollution creeping into our bay, we will one day awaken to find that the shimmering waters of our childhood have vanished beyond recall. （议论文·环保呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: if 引导虚拟警示句 + turn a blind eye to 习语 + 时间对照(childhood vs. vanished) + 情感化收尾(beyond recall)

classPractice.question: Regular exercise and a good diet can help keep illness ____ ____.
classPractice.note: keep/hold sth. at bay 控制住、防止…靠近,固定习语

classPractice.question: Located at the top of the tower, the restaurant gives you an amazing view ____ the bay.
classPractice.note: a view of sth. 某物的景致,介词用 of

classPractice.question: 我们的酒店房间俯瞰着宁静的海湾。(用 overlook, tranquil bay)
classPractice.answer: Our hotel room overlooked / overlooks the tranquil bay.
classPractice.note: overlook 俯瞰、可眺望;bay 可数名词,前加冠词

original_sentence: Since it takes about an hour (3) _________________ (turn) the full 360 degrees, you are unlikely to get bored with the scenery.
readingExamples: Since it takes about an hour (3) _________________ (turn) the full 360 degrees, you are unlikely to get bored with the scenery.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the natural features of an area, such as mountains, valleys, rivers and forests, especially when they are beautiful
(2) n. the painted backgrounds, structures and furniture used on a stage to represent the place where the action happens
(3) n. (uncountable) the general appearance of a landscape as a whole

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 舞台布景，(戏剧、电影的)场景装置
uncommonMeanings.example: As the curtain rose, the painted scenery of a moonlit forest transported the audience straight into a world of enchantment and quiet dread. （读后续写·舞台戏剧·氛围营造）

posExamples.sentence: As the train wound through the mountains, breathtaking scenery unfolded before us — silver waterfalls, terraced fields and villages nestled among the clouds. （读后续写·旅途风光·视觉铺陈）
Our county boasts some of the most spectacular scenery in the region, from misty peaks to crystal-clear lakes, and we sincerely invite you to come and experience its charm. （应用文·旅游推介信）
Some travellers rush from one scenic spot to another, snapping photos endlessly, yet never truly pausing to let the beauty of the scenery sink into their hearts. （议论文·快节奏旅游反思）
Lost in the majestic mountain scenery, I forgot for a while the worries that had weighed so heavily on my shoulders, and a deep sense of peace washed over me. （读后续写·自然疗愈·心理描写）

wordForms.noun: scenery (不可数,风景) / scene (可数,场景)
wordForms.other: 辨析四兄弟:scenery(不可数,自然风光总称) / scene(可数,一个场面) / sight(景象;sights名胜) / view(从某处所见的景色)。注意 scenery 无复数、不加 a。

collocations.translation: 美丽的／令人叹为观止的风景
collocations.example: We enjoyed the breathtaking scenery of the mountains. 我们欣赏着令人叹为观止的山景。

collocations.phrase: enjoy / admire / take in the scenery
collocations.example: We stopped to admire the scenery. 我们停下来欣赏风景。
The coastal scenery was simply stunning. 海岸风光美极了。
The village is surrounded by beautiful scenery. 那村庄被美景环绕。
You are unlikely to get bored with the scenery. 你不太可能对风景感到厌倦。

collocations.translation: 美丽的／绝美的／令人叹为观止的风景
collocations.example: The breathtaking scenery of the valley left the hikers speechless, their weariness melting away at the sight. （读后续写·登山感悟）
We slowed our pace to admire the scenery, unwilling to let a single golden moment of that autumn afternoon slip by. （读后续写·惜时惜景）
Reaching the summit at last, we paused to take in the sweeping scenery that rewarded every aching step of the climb. （读后续写·登顶奖赏）

collocations.translation: 壮观的／风景如画的景色
collocations.example: The picturesque scenery along the coastal road drew a steady stream of photographers eager to capture its charm. （应用文·旅游报道）

synonyms.example: The barren landscape stretched endlessly ahead. 荒凉的地貌向前无尽延伸。
synonyms.usage: landscape 指一片陆地整体的地形地貌,可美可荒,较中性、可数;scenery 特指美丽的自然景色,含赞美意味,且为不可数名词

synonyms.translation: 景色，视野（从某处望出去所见,可数）
synonyms.example: From the balcony we had a fine view of the city. 从阳台我们能看到城市的美景。
synonyms.usage: view 强调从特定位置望出去所见的画面,可数;scenery 强调一片区域整体的自然风光,不可数,不受观察点限制

synonyms.example: We visited all the famous sights of the city. 我们游览了城里所有著名景点。
synonyms.usage: sight 单数指眼前具体景象,复数 sights 指名胜古迹(可数);scenery 专指自然风光,不可数

synonyms.example: The joyful scene of children playing warmed my heart. 孩子们嬉戏的欢乐场面温暖了我的心。
synonyms.usage: scene 指某一具体场景、场面(可含人物、事件),可数;scenery 专指自然风光,不含具体事件,不可数

advancedExpressions.expression: scenery 不可数!不能说 a scenery / sceneries,量用 a piece of scenery 或 much/beautiful scenery
advancedExpressions.example: 误:The sceneries are beautiful. 正:The scenery is beautiful. / We enjoyed some beautiful scenery. 谓语用单数,高考易错点。

advancedExpressions.expression: scenery(自然风光,不可数) / scene(场面,可数) / view(眺望所见) / sight(名胜)
advancedExpressions.example: beautiful scenery(泛指美景)、a moving scene(动人的一幕)、a fine view of the bay(海湾美景)、the sights of Beijing(北京名胜),按可数性与语境选词。

advancedExpressions.expression: breathtaking scenery unfolded before us — ..., ... and ...
advancedExpressions.example: As we rounded the bend, breathtaking scenery unfolded before us — snow-capped peaks, emerald lakes and golden forests. 破折号 + 三项名词并列。

advancedExpressions.expression: ... boasts some of the most spectacular scenery ..., and we sincerely invite you to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our region boasts some of the most spectacular scenery in the country, and we sincerely invite you to come. boast 拟人夸赞 + 邀请句式。

advancedExpressions.expression: rather than merely ..., true travellers pause to let the scenery ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than merely racing to tick off famous landmarks, true travellers pause to let the scenery seep into their souls and reshape the way they see the world. （rather than 对比 + 提炼旅行的深层价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The scenery was very beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The scenery was so breathtaking that we fell into an awed silence, drinking in the golden fields, the winding river and the distant peaks bathed in the amber light of dusk. （读后续写·黄昏田园）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: so...that 结果状语从句 + drink in 沉醉动词 + 三项景物并列 + 光影渲染(amber light of dusk)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our town has nice scenery and you should visit.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With its ever-changing seasonal scenery and warm, welcoming people, our town promises every visitor an experience that will linger fondly in memory long after the journey ends. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 引导伴随状语开篇 + 双重亮点并列(scenery + people) + promise sb. an experience 承诺句式 + linger in memory 升华收尾

classPractice.question: 选 scenery / scene / view:We stopped to enjoy the beautiful ____ of the countryside.
classPractice.note: 泛指乡村自然风光,用不可数名词 scenery

classPractice.question: The mountain scenery ____ (be) so beautiful that we could hardly leave.
classPractice.note: scenery 不可数,谓语用单数;时态据语境

classPractice.question: 选 scenery / scenic:We drove along a ____ route with breathtaking views.
classPractice.note: 此处需形容词修饰 route,用 scenic(风景优美的)

translation: n. 打赌，赌注；断言，猜定 | vi. & vt. 打赌，赌（钱）；敢说
original_sentence: Food high in calories may also make us feel better.
readingExamples: Food high in calories may also make us feel better.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to risk money on the result of a race, game, competition or other future event
(2) v. (informal) to be certain that something is true or that something will happen
(3) n. an arrangement to risk money on the result of an event; the money that you risk in this way
(4) n. (informal) a choice or course of action that is likely to be successful

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 明智之选，可取的做法
uncommonMeanings.example: With the storm closing in and the last bus long gone, taking shelter in the old library seemed the safest bet — a decision that, unknown to them, would change everything. （读后续写·困境抉择）

posExamples.sentence: "I bet you can't finish the marathon," his brother teased, and something inside Tom hardened into quiet resolve — he laced up his shoes and swore he would prove every doubter wrong. （读后续写·激将立志）
As a monitor, I would advise every classmate against the temptation to bet on online games, for a single reckless wager can spiral into a habit that drains both our savings and our focus. （应用文·倡议书）
Placing a bet on an uncertain outcome may bring a fleeting thrill, yet the losses it inflicts on families and futures far outweigh any momentary excitement it promises. （议论文·赌博危害）
"I bet she'll come back for us," the little girl whispered, clutching the faded photograph as the rescue boat drew near — and against all odds, her faith proved right. （读后续写·亲情坚守）

wordForms.noun: bet (赌注) / betting (赌博) / bettor (下注者)
wordForms.other: 不规则动词:bet - bet - bet(过去式、过去分词同形,类似 cut/put/hit)。注意别写成 betted(赛马语境偶见,考试统一用 bet)。

idioms.translation: 我敢说，我肯定（表推测确信）
idioms.example: I bet you were nervous before the exam. 我敢说你考试前很紧张。
"Will you help me?" "You bet!" “你会帮我吗？”“当然！”

idioms.translation: 十拿九稳的事，稳妥之选
idioms.example: It's a safe bet that they'll win. 他们几乎肯定会赢。
I bet many of us have felt too shy to speak up in class, yet it is precisely by overcoming that hesitation that real growth begins. （议论文·成长话题）

collocations.example: Don't bet on the weather being fine. 别指望天气会好。
We made a friendly bet on the match. 我们就那场比赛友好地打了个赌。
He lost the bet and bought us all ice cream. 他输了赌,请我们所有人吃冰淇淋。

collocations.translation: 十拿九稳／稳妥可取之选
collocations.example: The train is a safe bet if you want to be on time. 想准时的话,坐火车最稳妥。

collocations.translation: 你最好的选择，最保险的办法
collocations.example: Your best bet is to leave early. 你最好的办法就是早点出发。
I would bet my life on her honesty — in all the years I have known her, she has never once broken a promise. （应用文·推荐信）

collocations.translation: 最佳选择，最保险的办法
collocations.example: If you hope to improve your spoken English quickly, joining an English corner is your best bet, for nothing rivals real conversation for building fluency. （应用文·建议信）
Investing in short-term gains at the cost of long-term health is a bet against your own future that no sensible person should be willing to take. （议论文·长远眼光）
Rather than committing fully to a single dream, some students hedge their bets, spreading their energy so thin that no goal is ever truly reached. （议论文·专注与目标）
Whether the fragile seedling would survive the frost was an even bet, yet the old gardener tended it every dawn as though its life depended on him alone. （读后续写·坚持与希望）

synonyms.example: He wagered ten pounds on the horse. 他在那匹马上押了十英镑。
synonyms.usage: wager 较正式、书面,常指郑重下注;bet 更口语、日常,可用于随口打赌

synonyms.example: Studying abroad alone was a gamble. 独自出国留学是一场冒险。
synonyms.usage: gamble 强调结果不确定、风险高,可指赌博也可比喻人生冒险;bet 更侧重具体的下注动作

synonyms.example: I can guarantee that you'll enjoy the trip. 我保证你会喜欢这次旅行。
synonyms.usage: 表"我敢说、一定"时可替换 I bet,但语气更正式、更负责任,多用于书面承诺

advancedExpressions.expression: bet - bet - bet(过去式、过去分词均为 bet)
advancedExpressions.example: 与 cut/put/hit/cost/let 同类,时态变化不变形:Yesterday I bet him a coke that our team would win. 昨天我和他打赌赢一瓶可乐。

advancedExpressions.expression: I bet ... / You bet! / a safe bet / your best bet
advancedExpressions.example: I bet(我敢说,表推测)、You bet!(当然,回应)、a safe bet(稳妥之选)、your best bet(最佳办法),口语与应用文建议信都好用。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. would bet everything that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Watching her rise trembling to her feet, I would have bet everything that she would cross that finish line. 突出信念应验,续写高潮。

advancedExpressions.expression: to bet on ... is to gamble away ...
advancedExpressions.example: To bet on instant fame while neglecting real ability is to gamble away the foundation of lasting success. 排比 + 隐喻,揭示短视之害。

advancedExpressions.expression: your safest / best bet is to ...
advancedExpressions.example: If you wish to make the most of the summer camp, your best bet is to step out of your comfort zone and volunteer for every challenge that comes your way. （建议信主体，实用口吻拉近距离）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was sure she would win.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Even as the others shook their heads in doubt, I would have staked everything on her victory — for I had seen the quiet fire in her eyes long before the starting gun ever sounded. （读后续写·心理描写+让步）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步状语 Even as... 制造对比 + stake everything on 替换 be sure 增强信念张力 + 破折号补充心理伏笔 + 时间从句拉长画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Gambling is a bad choice.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a shortcut to fortune, placing one's hopes on a reckless bet is a self-destructive gamble that erodes not only one's savings but, more insidiously, one's sense of responsibility. （议论文·危害论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being... 否定前置强调 + not only...but more insidiously... 递进结构 + self-destructive/erodes 高级动词与形容词提升论证力度

classPractice.question: Last week we ____ (bet) a small sum on whose model would fly the highest.
classPractice.note: bet 为不规则动词,过去式仍是 bet(bet-bet-bet)

classPractice.question: 想快速提高口语,你最好的办法就是加入英语角。If you want to improve your spoken English, your ____ ____ is to join an English corner.
classPractice.note: your best bet 最佳选择、最保险的办法,应用文建议常用

classPractice.question: “你会一直支持我吗？”“当然！”(用 you bet 回应)
classPractice.note: you bet 表强烈肯定“当然、一定”,口语应答

translation: 大气，大气层；气氛，氛围；空气
original_sentence: The atmosphere is lively and modern, with its walls (5) _________________ (paint) white and light blue.
readingExamples: The atmosphere is lively and modern, with its walls (5) _________________ (paint) white and light blue.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth or another planet
(2) n. the air in a particular place, especially with regard to how clean or pleasant it is
(3) n. the feeling or mood that a place, situation or piece of work gives you
(4) n. the general character or tone of a book, film, event or relationship

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 气氛，氛围（场所、场合给人的感觉）
uncommonMeanings.example: The restaurant has a cosy and welcoming atmosphere. 这家餐厅气氛温馨宜人。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 大气，大气层（围绕地球或行星的气体）
uncommonMeanings.example: The spacecraft re-entered the earth's atmosphere. 航天器重新进入地球大气层。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （书籍、影片等所营造的）情调，感染力
uncommonMeanings.example: The novel's haunting atmosphere stayed with me for days. 这部小说令人难忘的情调萦绕了我数日。

posExamples.sentence: The moment we pushed open the creaking door, a warm atmosphere of laughter and cinnamon wrapped around us, and the loneliness of the long journey melted away in an instant. （读后续写·归家温情）

To create a welcoming atmosphere for the exchange students, I suggest we decorate the classroom with both Chinese lanterns and their national flags, so that everyone feels at home from the very first day. （应用文·建议信）

A relaxed and encouraging atmosphere in the classroom does far more than any strict rule to nurture creativity, for students dare to voice bold ideas only when they no longer fear ridicule. （议论文·教育环境）
Every year, tonnes of harmful gases are pumped into the atmosphere, and unless we curb our reckless emissions now, future generations will inherit a planet gasping for clean air. （议论文·环境保护）

wordForms.adjective: atmospheric (大气的;有情调的,渲染气氛的)
wordForms.other: 词根 atmo-(气,水汽) + sphere(球,层)。一词两义:具体义"大气层"、抽象义"气氛",高考两义都考。形容词 atmospheric pressure(大气压)。

collocations.example: Soft music helped create a relaxing atmosphere. 轻柔的音乐帮助营造了轻松的氛围。

collocations.translation: 热烈的／紧张的／轻松的气氛
collocations.example: The classroom had a lively atmosphere. 教室里气氛热烈。
The host family gave us a warm atmosphere. 寄宿家庭给了我们温暖的氛围。
Greenhouse gases build up in the earth's atmosphere. 温室气体在地球大气层中积聚。

collocations.translation: 污染大气／排放到大气中
collocations.example: Factories release harmful gases into the atmosphere. 工厂把有害气体排放到大气中。
Every idling engine and every burning heap of rubbish quietly pollutes the atmosphere we all depend on for survival. （应用文·环保倡议）

collocations.phrase: an atmosphere of trust / tension / mystery
collocations.example: In an atmosphere of mutual trust, team members shared their failures as freely as their triumphs, and the project flourished. （议论文·团队合作）
When forests are set ablaze, vast amounts of carbon dioxide are released into the atmosphere, accelerating the very warming we struggle to reverse. （议论文·生态保护）
Sensing the awkward silence, Grandpa cracked an old joke to lighten the atmosphere, and soon the whole table was shaking with laughter. （读后续写·家庭聚会）
Red lanterns swayed overhead and the aroma of freshly baked mooncakes filled the streets, wrapping the entire town in a festive atmosphere. （读后续写·中秋节日）

synonyms.example: A sombre mood settled over the room. 房间里弥漫着一种沉郁的气氛。
synonyms.usage: mood 侧重人或场合当下的情绪状态,可指个人心情;atmosphere 更强调环境整体散发的感觉,范围更广

synonyms.example: The café had a cosy ambience. 这家咖啡馆情调温馨。
synonyms.usage: ambience 较文雅、书面,专指某场所的格调情调,多用于餐厅、场馆;atmosphere 更通用,也可指自然大气

synonyms.example: In a climate of trust, people share freely. 在互信的风气中,人们畅所欲言。
synonyms.usage: climate 比喻义指长期存在的社会或心理"风气",较宏观抽象;atmosphere 更偏具体场合当下的氛围

advancedExpressions.expression: atmosphere ①气氛(a lively atmosphere) ②大气层(the earth's atmosphere)
advancedExpressions.example: 同一个词两义都高频:写"环境氛围"用 create a warm atmosphere;写"环保"用 gases in the atmosphere,读文时看搭配定义。

advancedExpressions.expression: create / lighten / ease the atmosphere
advancedExpressions.example: create a relaxed atmosphere(营造轻松氛围)、lighten/ease the atmosphere(缓和气氛),读后续写与建议信描写场景常用。

advancedExpressions.expression: an atmosphere of ... hung / settled over ...
advancedExpressions.example: An atmosphere of hushed anticipation settled over the hall. 拟物化环境烘托紧张情绪。

advancedExpressions.expression: the atmosphere in which ... shapes ...
advancedExpressions.example: The atmosphere in which children are raised silently shapes their character. in which 定语从句 + 突出环境的塑造力。

advancedExpressions.expression: in order to create a ... atmosphere, we could ...
advancedExpressions.example: In order to create a harmonious atmosphere between the two schools, we could organise joint games and a shared meal, allowing genuine friendships to take root naturally. （建议信主体，目的状语前置）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The room felt warm and friendly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant I stepped inside, a warm and welcoming atmosphere enveloped me — the crackle of the fire, the scent of pine, the soft murmur of familiar voices — and every trace of the cold night outside was forgotten. （读后续写·多感官描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant... 时间状语开篇 + envelop 拟人化替换 feel + 破折号内三组多感官细节（听觉/嗅觉/听觉）铺陈 + 首尾冷暖对比

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good atmosphere helps students learn.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is beyond doubt that a supportive and open atmosphere does more to unlock a student's potential than the strictest discipline, for genuine learning blossoms only where curiosity is met with encouragement rather than fear. （议论文·教育环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is beyond doubt that... 强调句开篇 + do more...than 比较结构立论 + for 引导原因状语从句 + blossom 隐喻+ where 从句收束

classPractice.question: To welcome the exchange students, we tried to create a friendly ____ (气氛) in the classroom.
classPractice.note: 此处为"气氛"义,create a friendly atmosphere 营造友好氛围

classPractice.question: Every year tonnes of harmful gases are pumped into the ____ (atmosphere), warming the planet.
classPractice.note: 此处为"大气层"义,the atmosphere 指地球大气

classPractice.question: The restaurant is famous for its ____ (atmosphere) setting, with candles and soft jazz.
classPractice.note: 需形容词修饰 setting,atmospheric 有情调的、渲染气氛的

original_sentence: I hardly eat out any more.
readingExamples: I hardly eat out any more.
definitionEn:
(1) idiom (informal) extremely good, impressive or enjoyable; so wonderful that it seems almost unreal
(2) idiom used to emphasize that the quality of something (especially food, a performance or an experience) is far beyond the ordinary

posExamples.sentence: When Grandma lifted the lid, the aroma that drifted out was out of this world, and for one suspended moment the whole family fell silent, spoons hovering in the air. （读后续写·家庭美食）

If you have not yet tried the dumplings at our school food festival, you are missing something truly out of this world — every bite bursts with flavours you will remember long after the plate is empty. （应用文·美食推荐）
While some dismiss street food as unrefined, the humble noodle stall on our corner serves bowls so out of this world that even famed chefs have been spotted queuing at dawn. （议论文·平凡中的不凡）
The view from the summit was simply out of this world; a sea of clouds rolled beneath our feet and the rising sun set the whole sky ablaze, leaving us speechless with wonder. （读后续写·登山震撼）

idioms.example: The moment the choir's final note soared and faded, the audience sat frozen — the performance had been out of this world, and no applause seemed grand enough to answer it. （读后续写·演出震撼）

collocations.phrase: taste / smell out of this world
collocations.example: The freshly baked bread smelled out of this world. 刚出炉的面包香得不得了。

collocations.phrase: be absolutely out of this world
collocations.example: The sunrise was absolutely out of this world. 那日出简直妙不可言。
It was an out-of-this-world experience. 那是一次绝妙的体验。

collocations.phrase: sound / look out of this world
collocations.example: "A week under the stars?" "That sounds out of this world!" “在星空下待一周？”“听起来棒极了！”
"A whole week camping under the stars?" she gasped. "That sounds out of this world!" （读后续写·惊喜对话）
Draped in silk and lit by a hundred lanterns, the festival stage looked out of this world, and the crowd's chatter hushed into awed whispers. （读后续写·节日盛景）

synonyms.example: The dedication of our teacher was simply amazing. 老师的敬业精神令人惊叹。
synonyms.usage: amazing 最通用的褒义词,语气可强可弱;out of this world 语气更夸张、更口语,强调"好到不真实"

synonyms.example: Her extraordinary courage won everyone's respect. 她非凡的勇气赢得众人尊敬。
synonyms.usage: extraordinary 较正式书面,强调超出寻常;out of this world 偏口语,多用于感叹美食、体验、表演之妙

synonyms.example: We had a fantastic time at the festival. 我们在节日玩得非常开心。
synonyms.usage: fantastic 口语常用褒义词,程度强;out of this world 更加夸张,带"如不在人间"的强调意味

synonyms.example: The young pianist's phenomenal talent left the seasoned judges exchanging astonished glances. （读后续写·才华惊艳）
synonyms.usage: 语气极强，多形容成就、才能、程度之惊人；out of this world 更侧重主观感受上的绝妙享受

advancedExpressions.expression: out of this world = amazing / fantastic / extraordinary / beyond compare
advancedExpressions.example: 口语盛赞美食、演出、体验时,out of this world 比 very good 生动得多:The dumplings were out of this world. 饺子好吃得不得了。

advancedExpressions.expression: 作定语时加连字符 an out-of-this-world experience
advancedExpressions.example: 习语作表语不加连字符(The view is out of this world);放在名词前作定语要连写:an out-of-this-world dish 一道绝妙的菜。

advancedExpressions.expression: so ... that it was out of this world
advancedExpressions.example: The cake was so light, so delicately sweet, that it was out of this world. so...that 递进,感官升华。

advancedExpressions.expression: trust me, ... is out of this world
advancedExpressions.example: Trust me, the handmade ice cream at our stall is out of this world. 宣传口吻,拉近距离。

advancedExpressions.expression: what seems ordinary can prove out of this world
advancedExpressions.example: What seems ordinary at first glance can prove utterly out of this world once we pause long enough to truly appreciate it. （对比 ordinary vs out of this world，揭示用心观察之美）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The food was very delicious.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One bite was all it took: the flavours bloomed on my tongue in waves I had no words for — this was food out of this world, and suddenly every long mile of the journey home felt worth it. （读后续写·美食+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 冒号引出细节 + bloom in waves 隐喻味觉 + 破折号衔接因果 + out of this world 替换 very delicious，语气更饱满，末句情感升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: The concert was really good.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From the first trembling note to the last, the concert was quite simply out of this world, an evening so luminous that the audience rose as one, unwilling to let the magic end. （读后续写·演出）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: From...to... 时间跨度铺陈 + quite simply 强调 + so luminous that 结果状语 + rose as one 群体动作特写替换 really good

classPractice.question: 外婆做的饺子好吃得不得了。The dumplings Grandma made were ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: out of this world 习语,作表语意为"好得不得了"

classPractice.question: The performance was absolutely amazing. → The performance was absolutely ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: out of this world 语气比 amazing 更夸张,替换盛赞表演

classPractice.question: Volunteering at the shelter turned out to be an out-____-this-world experience.
classPractice.note: 习语 out of this world 作定语需连字符,固定介词 of

original_sentence: There are many versions of mooncakes from different places around China.
readingExamples: There are many versions of mooncakes from different places around China.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a form of something that is slightly different from other forms of the same thing
(2) n. a particular person's description of an event or account of what happened
(3) n. a copy of something, such as a book, film or song, that exists in a particular form
(4) n. an adaptation of a work of art, music or literature into another form or language

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 版本，变体（同一事物略有不同的形式）
uncommonMeanings.example: There are many versions of mooncakes across China. 中国各地有许多种月饼。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对事件的）说法，看法，叙述
uncommonMeanings.example: The two boys each told a different version of the quarrel. 两个男孩对争吵各执一词。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （作品的）改编版，译本
uncommonMeanings.example: We watched the film version of the novel. 我们看了那部小说的电影版。

posExamples.sentence: The mooncakes Grandma made were a humbler version of the fancy ones in shop windows, yet no glossy box could ever match the love baked into her crooked little cakes. （读后续写·亲情烘焙）

definitionEn:

(2) n. a small amount of metal or other material that a dentist puts into a hole in a tooth to repair it
(3) n. any substance or material used to fill a hole, gap or container
(4) adj. (of food) making your stomach feel full

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （牙齿的）补料，补牙填充物

posExamples.sentence: She bit into the mooncake and closed her eyes as the sweet red-bean filling melted on her tongue, carrying her back to childhood autumns she thought she had forgotten. （读后续写·味觉记忆）
For our charity bake sale, I suggest we prepare dumplings with a variety of fillings — meat, vegetable and sweet — so that every visitor, whatever their taste, can find a favourite. （应用文·活动方案）
It is often said that the true worth of a pastry lies not in its golden crust but in its filling, just as a person's real value is measured not by appearance but by what lies within. （议论文·内在价值·比喻）
A hearty, filling breakfast fuels both body and mind, which is why no student hoping to focus in morning class should ever skip it. （议论文·健康饮食）

collocations.example: She mashed the sweet red beans into a smooth filling for the mooncakes. 她把红豆压成细腻的馅，用来做月饼。（固定搭配 a filling for sth）

The lotus seed filling was so smooth and fragrant that even my picky little brother asked for a second mooncake. 莲蓉馅又滑又香，连挑食的弟弟都要了第二块月饼。
What set her pies apart was the generous filling that spilled over at the first cut. 她的派与众不同之处在于一切开就溢出来的满满馅料。

After hours in the cold, a warm, filling meal did more to lift our spirits than any speech. 在寒冷中待了几个小时后，一顿热乎顶饱的饭比任何话都更能提神。

synonyms.example: The aroma of the herb stuffing drifting from the oven told us, better than any clock, that the feast was almost ready. （读后续写·节日大餐）

advancedExpressions.expression: the worth lies not in the crust but in the filling
advancedExpressions.example: As with a pie, the worth of a person lies not in the golden crust of appearance but in the filling of character hidden within. 正如一块派，人的价值不在于外表的金黄脆皮，而在于内里深藏的品格之馅。

original_sentence: My elderly grandmother still bakes mooncakes for the whole family every year.
readingExamples: My elderly grandmother still bakes mooncakes for the whole family every year.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (of a person) old or rather old; a polite word for old
(2) n. (the elderly) old people considered as a group
(3) adj. (formal or humorous) (of a thing) rather old or old-fashioned

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （物品，谐谑用法）老旧的，陈旧的
uncommonMeanings.example: We rattled down the mountain road in Grandpa's elderly truck, its engine coughing like an old man yet somehow never once letting us down. （读后续写·怀旧·老物件拟人）

posExamples.sentence: An elderly woman stood alone at the crowded crossing, her thin hand trembling on her cane, and without a word I stepped forward to guide her gently to the other side. （读后续写·助人为乐）
This Sunday, our volunteer team will visit the elderly residents of the local care home, and I sincerely hope every one of you will join us in bringing them warmth and company. （应用文·倡议书）
A society that truly cares for the elderly reveals its deepest humanity, for how we treat those who can no longer repay us is the surest measure of our character. （议论文·尊老敬老）
My elderly grandfather, though his back had long since bent under the weight of years, still rose before dawn to water the garden he had planted half a century ago. （读后续写·祖辈坚守）

wordForms.noun: elder（长者，前辈）; elderliness（年老）; the elderly（老年人，群体）
wordForms.adjective: elderly（上了年纪的，委婉）; elder（年长的，同族中较年长）; older/eldest（较年长/最年长）

collocations.example: A society that truly cares for the elderly reveals its deepest humanity. 一个真正关爱老年人的社会，展现出最深切的人性。（the + adj. 表一类人，谓语用复数）

collocations.translation: 一位老年男子／女子／老夫妇
collocations.example: An elderly couple sat quietly on the park bench, hands entwined, watching the sunset. 一对老夫妇静静地坐在公园长椅上，双手相握，望着落日。

collocations.phrase: care for / look after the elderly
collocations.example: Caring for the elderly should be seen not as a burden, but as a debt of love we gladly repay. 照顾老人不应被视为负担，而应是我们乐意偿还的爱的债。
Torn between his career in the city and his elderly parents in the village, he finally chose the road home. 在城里的事业与乡下年迈的父母之间挣扎，他最终选择了回家的路。

collocations.phrase: help the elderly cross the road

synonyms.example: The aged monk had witnessed a century of change, yet his eyes still shone with a child's curiosity. 那位高龄的僧人见证了一个世纪的变迁，双眼却仍闪着孩童般的好奇。

synonyms.translation: 年长的；老年的（较委婉，尤美式）

synonyms.usage: 辨析·ageing 强调“正在变老”的动态过程，常用于 ageing society 老龄化社会；elderly 是静态描述已然年长的状态。

advancedExpressions.expression: the elderly / senior citizens / the aged / old people

advancedExpressions.expression: seeing an elderly ... struggle to ..., sb. rushed forward to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Seeing an elderly woman struggle to lift her heavy basket, I rushed forward without a second thought. 看到一位老妇人吃力地提着沉重的篮子，我毫不犹豫地冲上前去。

advancedExpressions.expression: let us reach out to the elderly among us, for ...

advancedExpressions.expression: how a society treats the elderly reveals ...
