collocations.example: To surprise her mother, Lucy secretly baked a lopsided cake. 为了给妈妈惊喜，露西偷偷烤了一个歪歪扭扭的蛋糕。
She baked the pastries in the oven until their surfaces turned a crisp, tempting brown. 她把点心放进烤箱烤，直到表面变成诱人的酥脆金褐色。
The aroma of freshly baked bread wrapped around me like a blanket. 刚出炉面包的香气像毯子一样将我裹住。（baked 作过去分词表被动、修饰名词）
It was a baking hot afternoon, and even the stray dogs had retreated into the shadows. 那是个酷热的下午，连流浪狗都躲进了阴影里。

collocations.phrase: bake at a high / low temperature
collocations.example: The recipe advises baking the cake at a low temperature so that it rises evenly. 食谱建议低温烤蛋糕，好让它均匀膨起。

collocations.translation: 不成熟的、考虑不周的主意／计划
collocations.example: Rushing in with a half-baked plan, the team soon found themselves floundering. 带着不成熟的计划贸然行动，团队很快陷入困境。
Our class held a bake sale, and the queue of eager customers stretched down the corridor. 我们班办了场烘焙义卖，热切的顾客排队一直排到走廊尽头。

synonyms.example: The whole family gathered as Father roasted a turkey until its skin crackled and glistened with golden fat. （读后续写·节日聚餐）
synonyms.usage: roast 多指用干热烤大块的肉、蔬菜或坚果，常与转动、油脂相关；bake 侧重面点、面包等需成型定型的食物

synonyms.example: We grilled skewers of vegetables over the open fire, laughing as the sparks danced up into the night sky. （读后续写·露营·氛围）
synonyms.usage: grill 指在铁网或明火上直接炙烤，火力集中于表面；bake 靠烤箱四周的干热均匀加热

synonyms.translation: 烤（面包片使其变脆变焦）
synonyms.example: She toasted two slices of bread until they were golden and crunchy at the edges. （读后续写·早餐日常）
synonyms.usage: toast 专指把已成品的面包片等烤脆烤黄；bake 指从生面团开始将其烤熟

advancedExpressions.expression: bake（烤）→ baker（面包师，-er 指人）→ bakery（面包房，-ery 指地点）
advancedExpressions.example: The baker at the corner bakery bakes fresh bread every dawn. 街角面包房的面包师每天黎明都烤新鲜面包。（一句串起动词、人、地点）

advancedExpressions.expression: the aroma of freshly baked ... wafted / drifted through ...
advancedExpressions.example: The aroma of freshly baked mooncakes wafted through the little kitchen, carrying a lifetime of memories. 刚出炉月饼的香气飘满了小厨房，带着一辈子的记忆。

advancedExpressions.expression: we warmly invite you to ... where students will bake ... in support of ...
advancedExpressions.example: We warmly invite you to our weekend fair, where students will bake and sell handmade treats in support of underprivileged children. 我们诚挚邀您参加周末义卖，学生们将烘焙并出售手工点心，以帮助贫困儿童。

advancedExpressions.expression: just as ... cannot be baked in haste, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as good bread cannot be baked in haste, true success is the fruit of slow, patient effort rather than of overnight shortcuts. 正如好面包无法仓促烤成，真正的成功也是缓慢耐心努力的果实，而非一夜捷径。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Grandma baked mooncakes for us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With flour dusting her wrinkled hands and a smile softening her tired eyes, Grandma baked our mooncakes just as she had for forty autumns, each golden crust pressed with the tenderness that words could never hold. （读后续写·细节+情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 独立结构补充动作细节 + just as 从句拉出时间纵深(forty autumns) + each ... 分句以物寄情收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Making bread teaches us patience.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is a quiet wisdom in the act of baking bread: it cannot be hurried, it demands our patience, and it rewards us, in the end, with something honest and warm that no machine could ever counterfeit. （议论文·哲理升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There is ... in 抽象名词化开头 + 冒号引出三分句排比(cannot/demands/rewards) + 对比收尾(no machine could counterfeit)

classPractice.question: The smell of ____ (freshly / bake) bread greeted us the moment we opened the door.
classPractice.note: bread 与 bake 是被动关系，用过去分词 baked 作定语；副词 freshly 修饰分词。

classPractice.question: 用 bake 家族词填空：The ____ at the corner ____ gets up before dawn to ____ fresh bread.（baker / bakery / bake）
classPractice.note: 考构词链：baker 人 / bakery 地点 / bake 动作，按语境对号入座。

classPractice.question: 每年中秋，年迈的奶奶仍为全家烤月饼。（bake / elderly）
classPractice.answer: Every Mid-Autumn Festival, my elderly grandmother still bakes mooncakes for the whole family.
classPractice.note: bake for sb 为某人烤；一般现在时表反复习惯，主语第三人称单数用 bakes。

original_sentence: She can turn the flour and red beans into wonderful mooncakes like magic.
readingExamples: She can turn the flour and red beans into wonderful mooncakes like magic.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a fine soft powder made by grinding wheat or other grain, used for making bread, cakes, pastry, etc.
(2) n. any similar powder made from a starchy plant or seed, such as rice flour or corn flour
(3) v. (technical) to cover or sprinkle something with flour before cooking or baking

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 在（某物）上撒面粉；把……裹上面粉
uncommonMeanings.example: She floured the wooden board and her rolling pin, then set to work on the dough with the practised ease of one who had done it ten thousand times. （读后续写·手艺·动作娴熟）

posExamples.sentence: In Grandma's skilled hands, a humble mound of flour and a bowl of red beans were transformed, as if by magic, into mooncakes that carried the very taste of home. （读后续写·亲情·化平凡为神奇）
To make our class party a success, could you please bring two kilograms of flour and a packet of yeast, since we plan to bake bread together on Friday afternoon. （应用文·活动分工/请求信）
The soaring price of flour this year reminds us that even the humblest staple on our table is bound to a vast, fragile web of harvests, weather and human labour. （议论文·粮食安全·联系万物）
A cloud of flour burst into the air as the little boy clapped his hands, and for a moment the whole kitchen seemed to snow, drawing peals of laughter from us all. （读后续写·童趣·画面感）

wordForms.other: 同音辨析·flour /ˈflaʊə(r)/ 面粉 与 flower /ˈflaʊə(r)/ 花，读音完全相同（同音异形词homophone），拼写不同，靠语境区分：Grandma bought some flour to bake, then picked a flower for the vase. 奶奶买了面粉来烘焙，又摘了一朵花插瓶。有趣的是二者同源——面粉是谷物“最精华的部分（the flower of grain）”。

collocations.example: He hoisted a heavy sack of flour onto his shoulder and trudged up the stairs. 他把一大袋面粉扛上肩，吃力地上楼。

collocations.translation: 普通面粉／小麦粉／米粉／玉米粉
collocations.example: The recipe calls for plain flour rather than self-raising. 食谱要用普通面粉，而非自发粉。
Patiently, she sifted the flour into the bowl, watching it settle like the first snow. 她耐心地把面粉筛进碗里，看它像初雪般落下。

collocations.translation: 把面粉和水混合／揉在一起
collocations.example: We mixed the flour with warm water and kneaded the dough until it turned smooth. 我们把面粉和温水混合，揉面团直到它变得光滑。
She can turn the flour and red beans into wonderful mooncakes like magic. 她能像变魔术般把面粉和红豆变成美味的月饼。（课文原句）
Before shaping the buns, she dusted her hands with flour. 在做馒头之前，她往手上撒了点面粉。

collocations.phrase: roll out the dough on a floured surface
collocations.translation: 在撒了面粉的台面上擀开面团
collocations.example: Roll out the dough on a floured surface until it is thin enough to see the light through. 在撒了面粉的台面上擀开面团，直到薄得能透光。
Add a spoonful of flour at a time, stirring constantly, so that the sauce thickens without forming lumps. （应用文·操作指南）

synonyms.example: The mysterious powder in the ancient jar turned out to be nothing more than ground rice. 古罐里神秘的粉末，结果不过是磨碎的大米。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·powder 泛指任何细粉末（药粉、化妆粉、粉尘）；flour 特指粮食磨成、用于烹饪烘焙的谷物粉。

synonyms.example: Once the dough had risen to twice its size, the children pressed their fingers into its soft surface. 面团发到两倍大后，孩子们把手指按进它柔软的表面。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·dough 是 flour 加水揉成的湿面团，是半成品；flour 是尚未加水的干粉原料，二者是原料与半成品的关系。

advancedExpressions.expression: flour 面粉 / flower 花，读音相同，靠语境分辨
advancedExpressions.example: She sprinkled flour on the board, humming beside a vase of fresh flowers. 她在案板上撒面粉，在一瓶鲜花旁哼着歌。（一句并置两词，凸显同音异义）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·把原料化为成品
advancedExpressions.expression: turn / transform flour (and ...) into ...
advancedExpressions.example: In Grandma's hands, mere flour and water became small edible miracles. 在奶奶手中，仅仅面粉和水就变成了可以入口的小小奇迹。

advancedExpressions.expression: could you please bring ... of flour, so that we can ... together
advancedExpressions.example: Could you please bring a kilogram of flour and some sugar, so that we can bake festival treats together. 你能带一公斤面粉和一些糖来吗，好让我们一起烤些节日点心。

advancedExpressions.expression: even the humblest ... such as flour reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Even the humblest staple such as flour reminds us that our comfortable lives rest upon the unseen toil of countless farmers. 即便是面粉这般最寻常的主食，也提醒我们舒适的生活建立在无数农民看不见的辛劳之上。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·化平凡为神奇
advancedExpressions.expression: in sb.'s hands, mere flour and ... became ...
advancedExpressions.example: In Grandma's hands, mere flour and water became small edible miracles, each one shaped by love and seasoned with memory. （以对比凸显手艺与情感，物象升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Grandma made mooncakes from flour and beans.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From nothing more than a mound of soft flour and a handful of red beans, Grandma conjured, year after year, mooncakes so tender and fragrant that the mere memory of them could summon home to my mind from a thousand miles away. （读后续写·思乡）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: From nothing more than ... 前置强调原料之朴素 + conjured 拟魔术化动词 + so ... that 结果状语 + 夸张(a thousand miles away)寄托思乡

sentenceUpgrade.original: Flour is a basic food that many people depend on.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Flour may seem the most ordinary thing on our shelves, yet behind each snowy grain lie golden fields, patient farmers and the turning of the seasons — a quiet reminder of how deeply our daily bread is woven into the labour of the land. （议论文·由小见大）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: may seem ... yet 让步转折 + behind ... lie 倒装句凸显背后价值 + 破折号总结升华(daily bread 双关)

classPractice.question: 用 flour / flower 填空：Grandma needs a bag of ____ to bake mooncakes, while the vase needs a fresh ____.
classPractice.note: 两词同音，靠语境区分：bake 用 flour 面粉，vase 插 flower 花。

classPractice.question: She can turn the ____ (面粉) and red beans into wonderful mooncakes like magic.
classPractice.note: 面粉是 flour（不可数），注意勿误拼成 flower。

classPractice.question: 请你带一公斤面粉来，好让我们一起烤面包。（flour / so that）
classPractice.answer: Could you please bring a kilogram of flour, so that we can bake bread together?
classPractice.note: flour 不可数，用 a kilogram of 计量；so that 引导目的状语从句。

original_sentence: When she places them on the table, they look adorable—small, round and shiny golden-brown.
readingExamples: When she places them on the table, they look adorable—small, round and shiny golden-brown.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. very attractive and easy to love, especially because of being sweet, charming or cute
(2) adj. (of people, animals or things) delightful and lovable in a way that inspires great affection
(3) adj. (informal) extremely charming and pleasing in appearance or manner

posExamples.sentence: The moment Grandma lifted the lid, the mooncakes lay there looking utterly adorable — small, round and glowing a shiny golden-brown, as if they were smiling up at us. （读后续写·美食·拟人）
I am writing to recommend a stray kitten for adoption; she is the most adorable little creature, with eyes so bright and a purr so gentle that anyone would fall for her at first sight. （应用文·推荐/领养信）
We should be wary of judging character by appearance alone, for an adorable face may conceal an unkind heart, while a plain one may hide a soul of gold. （议论文·外表与本质）
As the toddler took his first wobbly steps and then plopped down with a giggle, the whole room melted at the adorable sight, and even Grandpa's stern face broke into a grin. （读后续写·亲情·童趣）

wordForms.verb: adore（v. 热爱，非常喜欢；崇拜）
wordForms.adjective: adorable（可爱的，讨人喜爱的）; adoring（充满爱慕的）
wordForms.other: 构词法·adore（v. 热爱）+ -able（可……的）→ adorable（值得被爱的→可爱的）。注意主动被动：adorable = 可被爱的（令人疼爱）；adoring = 满怀爱慕的（主动去爱，如 an adoring fan 狂热粉丝）。词族：adore v. / adoration n. / adorable a. / adorably adv.

collocations.example: An adorable puppy bounded up to the lonely old man, and a warm light returned to his weary eyes. 一只可爱的小狗蹦到孤独老人面前，他疲惫的眼里重现暖光。
When she places them on the table, they look adorable—small, round and shiny golden-brown. 当她把它们摆到桌上时，它们看起来很可爱——小小的、圆圆的、闪着金褐色的光。（课文原句）
The kitten curled up in my palm was utterly adorable. 蜷在我掌心的小猫可爱极了。
Everyone in the class found the new exchange student adorable. 全班都觉得新来的交换生很可爱。（find + 宾语 + 宾补 adorable）
She flashed an adorable smile, and the tension in the room instantly dissolved. 她绽出一个可爱的笑容，房间里的紧张顿时化解。
On the windowsill sat an adorable little clay figure, moulded by a child's loving hands. 窗台上摆着一个可爱的小泥人，是孩子满含爱意的手捏出来的。

synonyms.example: With his charming manners and ready wit, the young man soon won over even the doubtful. 凭着迷人的举止和敏捷的机智，那年轻人很快赢得了连怀疑者的心。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·charming 侧重举止谈吐上的迷人魅力，可用于成人；adorable 侧重外表天真可爱、令人疼爱，多用于孩子、小动物或小巧之物。

synonyms.example: It was a lovely spring morning, with birdsong spilling over the dewy hedges. 那是个美好的春日清晨，鸟鸣洒过带露的树篱。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·lovely 用途最广，可形容景色、天气、人和物，程度较温和；adorable 情感更强烈，突出“惹人怜爱、想抱一抱”的可爱。

synonyms.translation: 惹人喜爱的，讨人喜欢的
synonyms.example: There was something endearing about the way he blushed whenever he was praised. 他每受夸奖就脸红的样子有种惹人喜爱的地方。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·endearing 强调因某种特质或举动而逐渐赢得好感，常修饰行为、习惯；adorable 更直接形容整体的可爱外观。

advancedExpressions.expression: adore v. 热爱 → adorable a. 可爱的（被爱）/ adoring a. 爱慕的（去爱）→ adorably adv.
advancedExpressions.example: The children adore the adorable puppy, gazing at it adoringly. 孩子们热爱那只可爱的小狗，满怀爱慕地凝望着它。（一句串起动词、两种形容词、副词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·find/look + adorable 作宾补/表语
advancedExpressions.expression: sth looks adorable（系表）/ find sth adorable（宾补）
advancedExpressions.example: The mooncakes looked adorable, and everyone found them adorable. 月饼看起来很可爱，人人都觉得它们可爱。（look 后作表语，find 后作宾补）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth looked adorable — ..., ... and ..., as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The mooncakes looked adorable — small, round and shiny golden-brown, as if each were beaming with the kitchen's warmth. 月饼看起来很可爱——小巧、圆润、闪着金褐色的光，仿佛每一个都洋溢着厨房的暖意。

advancedExpressions.expression: an adorable exterior does not always guarantee ...
advancedExpressions.example: An adorable exterior does not always guarantee an admirable character. 可爱的外表并不总能保证令人敬佩的品格。

advancedExpressions.expression: she is the most adorable ..., with ... so ... that anyone would ...
advancedExpressions.example: She is the most adorable little kitten, with a purr so gentle that anyone who holds her would instantly wish to take her home. （最高级 + with 独立结构 + so ... that 结果状语，情感感染力强）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The mooncakes on the table looked adorable.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Nestled on the porcelain plate, the mooncakes looked utterly adorable — plump, round and glazed a shiny golden-brown, each one seeming to smile back at me the way Grandma always did. （读后续写·美食+亲情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Nestled 过去分词状语开头营造画面 + 破折号三形容词白描(plump/round/glazed) + each one seeming to smile 拟人并勾连亲情

sentenceUpgrade.original: Do not judge people only by their cute looks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We would do well to remember that an adorable face is no certificate of a noble heart, for beauty may fade in a season, while kindness of character endures a lifetime. （议论文·外表与品格）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: We would do well to remember that 委婉劝诫句式 + is no certificate of 隐喻否定 + for 引原因 + while 对比(fade in a season / endures a lifetime)

classPractice.question: The children ____ (adore) the puppy so much that they gazed at it ____ (adore).
classPractice.note: 第一空作谓语动词“热爱”；第二空作方式副词修饰 gazed，用 adoringly。

classPractice.question: 用 adorable / adoring 填空：The ____ baby smiled up at his ____ mother.
classPractice.note: 宝宝“可爱的”被爱用 adorable；妈妈“满怀爱慕的”主动去爱用 adoring。

classPractice.question: 月饼摆到桌上时看起来很可爱。（look / adorable）
classPractice.answer: When (they were) placed on the table, the mooncakes looked adorable.
classPractice.note: look 为系动词，后接形容词 adorable 作表语。

translation: 不浓的，清淡的；温和的，柔和的；不严重的
original_sentence: As I take each bite, the sweet and mild flavour of the red bean filling slowly fills my mouth.
readingExamples: As I take each bite, the sweet and mild flavour of the red bean filling slowly fills my mouth.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (of taste, flavour or smell) not strong, sharp or bitter; gentle and delicate
(2) adj. (of a person or their manner) gentle and kind; not severe or harsh
(3) adj. (of weather) fairly warm, especially warmer than usual for the time of year; not cold
(4) adj. (of illness, punishment, etc.) not serious or severe in effect

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （味道、气味）清淡的，不浓的，不刺激的
uncommonMeanings.example: The cheese had a mild taste, quite unlike the sharp, pungent kinds my father loved. 这奶酪味道清淡，与父亲爱吃的那些浓烈刺鼻的很不一样。（本单元核心义·美食）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人、举止）温和的，和善的，不严厉的
uncommonMeanings.example: Despite her authority, she is remarkably mild in manner, always correcting our mistakes with patience. 尽管她很有威严，举止却格外温和，总是耐心地纠正我们的错误。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （天气）温暖宜人的，暖和的
uncommonMeanings.example: That winter was unusually mild, and by February shy green buds were already peeping out. 那年冬天异常暖和，二月里害羞的绿芽就已探出头来。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （病情、程度、惩罚）轻微的，不严重的
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctor reassured the anxious mother that it was only a mild fever. 医生安慰焦虑的母亲，说这只是轻微的发烧。

posExamples.sentence: As I took each careful bite, the sweet and mild flavour of the red bean filling spread slowly across my tongue, and with it came a flood of childhood memories I thought I had long forgotten. （读后续写·味觉·思乡）
I would recommend our new geography teacher without hesitation; despite her authority, she is remarkably mild in manner, always correcting our mistakes with patience rather than blame. （应用文·推荐信）
While some insist that only harsh punishment can deter wrongdoing, history suggests that mild and reasoned discipline often reforms the heart more lastingly than fear ever could. （议论文·教育方式·论证）
The mild breeze of the early evening brushed against our faces as we strolled along the riverbank, carrying the faint fragrance of blossoming osmanthus. （读后续写·环境·感官）

wordForms.adjective: mild（清淡的；温和的；轻微的）; milder（较……）; mildest（最……）
wordForms.other: 构词法·mild（a.）+ -ly → mildly（adv.）；mild + -ness → mildness（n.）。一词多义是本词重点：①味道清淡 ②性情温和 ③天气暖和 ④病情/程度轻微，四义都由“不强烈、不剧烈”这一核心引申而来。

idioms.translation: 说得婉转些，说得客气点（暗示实际更严重）
idioms.example: His so-called 'plan', to put it mildly, was a reckless gamble. 他所谓的“计划”，说得客气点，是一场鲁莽的赌博。（插入语，委婉反讽）

collocations.example: The soup had a mild, comforting flavour that reminded me of childhood dinners. 那汤有种清淡而慰藉人心的味道，让我想起童年的晚饭。（对应味觉义）

collocations.translation: 温和的天气／暖冬／温和的气候
collocations.example: Blessed with a mild climate all year round, the little coastal town has become a haven for travellers. 常年气候温和，这座海滨小镇成了旅人的乐土。（对应天气义）
Beneath his mild manner lay a will of iron. 在他温和的举止之下，藏着钢铁般的意志。（对应性情义）

collocations.phrase: a mild cold / fever / case of sth
collocations.translation: 轻微的感冒／发烧／某病的轻症
collocations.example: Fortunately, it proved to be only a mild cold, and within days she was back on her feet. 幸好只是轻微的感冒，几天她就康复了。（对应病情义）
As I take each bite, the sweet and mild flavour of the red bean filling slowly fills my mouth. 每咬一口，红豆馅香甜清淡的味道便缓缓充满我的口腔。（课文原句）
He raised an eyebrow, mildly surprised that a boy so young could speak with such conviction. 他挑了挑眉，略感惊讶，这么小的男孩竟能讲得如此笃定。
The old teacher's voice was mild and gentle, yet every word he spoke seemed to settle deep in our hearts. （读后续写·师长·感染力）

collocations.phrase: a mild case / form of sth
collocations.example: Fortunately, it proved to be only a mild case of the flu, and within days she was back on her feet. （读后续写·转危为安）
To put it mildly, the results fell far short of what we had all been hoping for. （议论文·委婉表达）

synonyms.example: With a gentle pat on my shoulder, she told me that failure was simply the first draft of success. 她轻拍我肩，告诉我失败不过是成功的初稿。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·gentle 侧重动作、态度上的轻柔体贴，常修饰 touch/voice/breeze；mild 侧重程度或强度上“不强烈、不刺激”，也可修饰味道、天气、病情。

synonyms.example: A tender smile crossed her face as she watched her grandson sleep. 看着熟睡的孙子，她脸上掠过一丝温柔的微笑。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·tender 强调充满温情与关爱，或指肉质细嫩，情感浓度高；mild 更中性，泛指程度的温和适中。

synonyms.example: Moderate exercise, rather than exhausting workouts, best sustains our long-term health. 适度的运动，而非精疲力竭的锻炼，最能维持我们的长期健康。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·moderate 侧重“不走极端、适中”，多用于程度、数量、态度；mild 更常用于感官（味道、气候）和性情。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·mild 一词多义（一核四义）
advancedExpressions.expression: mild taste 清淡 / mild manner 温和 / mild weather 暖和 / mild cold 轻微
advancedExpressions.example: A mild-mannered doctor said that in such mild weather even a mild cold, like a mild flavour, would soon fade. 一位性情温和的医生说，在这般暖和的天气里，即便是轻微的感冒，也会像清淡的味道一样很快消退。（一句集齐四义，凸显核心“不强烈”）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·味觉引发回忆
advancedExpressions.expression: the mild flavour of ... spread across my tongue, and with it came ...
advancedExpressions.example: The mild sweetness of the filling spread slowly across my tongue, and with it came a flood of memories. 馅料清淡的甜味在舌尖缓缓漫开，随之涌来的是潮水般的回忆。

advancedExpressions.expression: despite ..., sb. is remarkably mild in manner, always ... rather than ...
advancedExpressions.example: Despite her seniority, she is remarkably mild in manner, always encouraging us rather than scolding us. 尽管她资历深，举止却格外温和，总是鼓励我们而非责骂我们。

advancedExpressions.type: 议论文·教育/治理方式对比
advancedExpressions.expression: mild ... often achieves more than harsh ... ever could
advancedExpressions.example: Mild persuasion often achieves more than harsh coercion ever could. 温和的劝导往往比严厉的强迫更能奏效。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The red bean filling tasted sweet and mild.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the sweet, mild filling melted on my tongue, the years seemed to fall away, and I was once more a small child perched on Grandma's knee, waiting for the first mooncake of autumn. （读后续写·味觉+回忆）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 引导时间状语从句 + melted on my tongue 通感 + the years seemed to fall away 时间意象 + once more 拉回童年画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Being gentle is often better than being harsh.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History teaches us, again and again, that a mild word spoken in kindness can move a heart which no threat could ever bend; gentleness, far from being weakness, is a quieter and more enduring form of strength. （议论文·哲理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: History teaches us that 权威化开头 + which 定语从句对比(word vs threat) + 分号后重新定义(far from being weakness)提升立意

classPractice.question: 用 mild 填入并判断词义：The doctor said it was only a ____ cold; the soup had a ____ flavour; the winter was surprisingly ____.
classPractice.note: 同一词 mild 分别表“轻微的（病）/清淡的（味）/温和暖和的（天气）”，一词多义。

classPractice.question: He was only ____ (mild) surprised, and answered the question calmly.
classPractice.note: 此处修饰形容词 surprised，需用副词 mildly “略微地”。

classPractice.question: 红豆馅香甜而清淡的味道慢慢充满我的口腔。（sweet and mild / fill）
classPractice.answer: The sweet and mild flavour of the red bean filling slowly fills my mouth.
classPractice.note: mild 在此表味道“清淡的”；固定表达 fill one's mouth 充满口腔。

original_sentence: My favourite food is a popular Italian dessert called tiramisu.
readingExamples: My favourite food is a popular Italian dessert called tiramisu.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an Italian cold dessert made of layers of sponge cake or biscuits soaked in coffee and liqueur, with a rich creamy mixture of mascarpone cheese, eggs and sugar, dusted with cocoa powder
(2) n. a serving or portion of this dessert

posExamples.sentence: The first spoonful of tiramisu I ever tasted melted on my tongue in soft layers of coffee and cream, and in that single moment I understood why my parents had smiled so knowingly across the table. （读后续写·初体验·亲情）
I am writing to warmly recommend the little café on Willow Street, whose homemade tiramisu is, without exaggeration, the finest I have ever had the pleasure of tasting. （应用文·推荐信）
That a humble Italian dessert like tiramisu is now savoured in cafés from Beijing to Buenos Aires reminds us how food, more than almost anything, dissolves the borders between cultures. （议论文·文化交流）
On my birthday, my best friend surprised me with a homemade tiramisu, its cocoa-dusted surface lopsided and imperfect, yet to me it was worth more than any dessert money could buy. （读后续写·友情·真心）

wordForms.noun: tiramisu（提拉米苏，专有名词，通常不可数或视份数可数）
wordForms.other: 专有名词·tiramisu 源自意大利语，字面意为“带我上去/让我振作（pick me up）”，因含咖啡而得名。属外来食物词，无词形变化；同类食物专名还有 pizza 披萨、pasta 意面、spaghetti 意大利面。

collocations.phrase: a popular Italian dessert called tiramisu
collocations.translation: 一款叫提拉米苏的意大利甜点
collocations.example: My favourite food is a popular Italian dessert called tiramisu. 我最爱的食物是一款叫提拉米苏的意大利甜点。（课文原句；called 过去分词作后置定语）
She ordered a single slice of tiramisu and shared it, spoon for spoon, with an old friend. 她点了一块提拉米苏，一勺一勺地和老友分着吃。
The homemade tiramisu carried a warmth that no fancy restaurant could ever match. 那自制的提拉米苏带着任何高档餐厅都无法比拟的暖意。
We spent the whole rainy afternoon learning to make tiramisu. 我们花了整个下雨的午后学做提拉米苏。
Each layer of the tiramisu revealed a new delight — coffee-soaked sponge, then silky cream. 提拉米苏的每一层都揭开一份新的惊喜——浸咖啡的海绵蛋糕，接着是丝滑的奶油。

collocations.translation: 撒了可可粉的提拉米苏
collocations.example: A tiramisu dusted with cocoa sat at the centre of the table, glinting under the candlelight. 一份撒着可可粉的提拉米苏摆在桌子中央，在烛光下微微发亮。
The chef prided himself on serving a classic Italian tiramisu, prepared strictly according to his grandmother's handwritten recipe. （应用文·美食介绍）

synonyms.example: After the main course, the waiter wheeled over a trolley laden with tempting desserts. 主菜之后，服务员推来一辆满载诱人甜点的小车。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·dessert 是泛称，指餐后各类甜品；tiramisu 是其中一种具体的意式甜点，属“上下义”关系。注意拼写 dessert（甜点，双 s）≠ desert（沙漠）。

synonyms.example: For pudding, Mother had prepared a warm apple crumble. 作为餐后甜点，妈妈准备了热苹果酥。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·pudding 在英式英语中泛指餐后甜点，也可指具体布丁类软甜品；tiramisu 特指冷藏、分层的意式咖啡奶油甜点。

synonyms.example: The fair offered delicacies from a dozen nations. 集市上有来自十几个国家的美味佳肴。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·delicacy 强调难得、精致的美味，褒义浓；tiramisu 是具体食物名，本身不含评价意味。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·called + 名词 作后置定语
advancedExpressions.expression: a dessert called tiramisu = a dessert (which is) called tiramisu
advancedExpressions.example: My favourite food is an Italian dessert called tiramisu. 我最爱的食物是一款叫提拉米苏的意大利甜点。（过去分词 called 替代定语从句，介绍名称的高频结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: the first spoonful of ... melted on my tongue, and in that moment ...
advancedExpressions.example: The first spoonful of tiramisu melted on my tongue, and in that moment the noise of the café seemed to fade. 提拉米苏的第一勺在我舌尖化开，那一刻咖啡馆的喧闹仿佛都消退了。

advancedExpressions.expression: I warmly recommend ..., whose ... is, without exaggeration, the finest I have ever ...
advancedExpressions.example: I warmly recommend the corner café, whose tiramisu is, without exaggeration, the finest I have ever tasted. 我诚挚推荐街角那家咖啡馆，它的提拉米苏毫不夸张地说是我尝过最好的。

advancedExpressions.expression: that a dish like ... is now savoured across ... reminds us how food dissolves ...
advancedExpressions.example: That a dish like tiramisu is now savoured across every continent reminds us how food dissolves the borders between peoples. 提拉米苏这样一道菜如今在各大洲被人品味，提醒着我们食物如何消融民族间的界限。

sentenceUpgrade.original: My favourite dessert is tiramisu.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Of all the desserts I have ever tasted, none has won my heart quite like tiramisu, for in its soft layers of coffee, cream and cocoa lingers the memory of the very first afternoon my parents let me choose a treat entirely my own. （读后续写·记忆）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Of all ... none has ... quite like 最高级式强调 + for 引原因 + in ... lingers 倒装凸显意象 + 以'第一次'寄托情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Tiramisu from Italy is now popular all over the world.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Once confined to the trattorias of Italy, tiramisu now graces dessert menus from Shanghai to São Paulo — living proof that a truly good thing, like a truly good idea, refuses to be held prisoner by any border. （议论文·文化传播）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Once confined to ... now ... 时空对比 + from A to B 地域跨度 + 破折号引出比喻升华(good thing / good idea 类比)

classPractice.question: My favourite food is a popular Italian dessert ____ (call) tiramisu.
classPractice.note: dessert 与 call 是被动关系，用过去分词 called 作后置定语，相当于 which is called。

classPractice.question: 用 dessert / desert 填空：We ended the meal with a rich Italian ____, while camels crossed the endless ____.
classPractice.note: 甜点 dessert（双 s，重音在后）；沙漠 desert（单 s，重音在前），易混拼写。

classPractice.question: 我最喜欢的食物是一种叫提拉米苏的意大利甜点。（a dessert called ...）
classPractice.answer: My favourite food is an Italian dessert called tiramisu.
classPractice.note: 用 called + 名称 作后置定语介绍事物名称，符合课文表达。

original_sentence: I first tried it about two years ago, when I visited a bakery with my parents.
readingExamples: I first tried it about two years ago, when I visited a bakery with my parents.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a place where bread, cakes, pastries and similar goods are made
(2) n. a shop where bread, cakes and pastries are sold, often on the same premises where they are baked
(3) n. (collective) the range of baked goods produced or offered by such a place

posExamples.sentence: I first tasted that dessert two years ago, when my parents took me into a tiny corner bakery whose warm, buttery air seemed to wrap around us the moment we stepped inside. （读后续写·回忆·嗅觉画面）
I am writing to recommend the new bakery on Green Road, where every loaf is baked fresh at dawn and where the friendly owner always slips a free biscuit to the children. （应用文·推荐信）

The survival of small family bakeries, in an age dominated by supermarket chains, shows that people still crave not only good bread but the human warmth that mass production can never knead in. （议论文·传统与现代）
Every morning on my way to school, I would linger for a moment outside the little bakery, drinking in the smell of fresh bread as if it alone could give me courage for the day ahead. （读后续写·校园日常·温情）

wordForms.noun: bakery（面包房）; baker（面包师）; baking（烘焙）
wordForms.other: 构词法·bake（烤）→ baker（+ -er 指人：面包师）→ bakery（+ -ery 表地点：面包房）。后缀 -ery 常表“场所/行当”：cook→cookery 烹饪、brew→brewery 啤酒厂、nurse→nursery 托儿所。

collocations.example: I first tried it about two years ago, when I visited a bakery with my parents. 大约两年前我第一次尝到它，那时我和父母去了一家面包房。（课文原句）
The corner bakery had been part of the neighbourhood for three generations. 那家街角面包房已在这个街区存在了三代人。
It was a small family-run bakery, where the daughter kneaded dough beside her father. 那是一家小小的家族面包房，女儿在父亲身旁揉着面团。
After years of hardship, they finally saved enough to run a bakery of their own. 历经多年艰辛，他们终于攒够钱开了一家自己的面包房。

collocations.phrase: the smell / aroma from a bakery
collocations.example: The aroma from the bakery drifted down the whole street, luring hungry commuters to its door. 面包房的香气飘满整条街，把饥肠辘辘的上班族引到门口。
He arrived carrying a paper bag of buns fresh from the bakery, still warm. 他拎着一纸袋刚出炉、还热乎的面包卷到了。
Though a giant bakery chain had opened nearby, loyal customers still queued at the old shop. 尽管附近开了家大型连锁面包店，忠实顾客仍在那家老店排队。
She pressed her nose against the bakery window, gazing at the golden pastries she could not yet afford. （读后续写·渴望·细节）

synonyms.example: The elegant patisserie in the old quarter was famous for pastries almost too beautiful to eat. 老城区那家雅致的西点店以美得几乎让人不忍吃的糕点闻名。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·patisserie 源自法语，特指专做精致法式甜点、蛋糕的店铺，格调更高；bakery 范围更广，主打面包，也卖普通糕点。

synonyms.example: Mum sent me round to the baker's for a fresh loaf before the guests arrived. 客人来之前，妈妈打发我去面包铺买一条新鲜面包。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·baker's 是口语中“面包店”的说法（源自 baker's shop），偏英式日常口语；bakery 更书面通用，也可指生产面包的作坊。

synonyms.example: The window of the confectionery glittered with chocolates and sugared almonds. 糖果店的橱窗里巧克力和糖杏仁熠熠生辉。
synonyms.usage: 辨析·confectionery 侧重糖果、巧克力等甜食及其店铺；bakery 侧重烘焙的面包、糕点，二者所售品类不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: bake → baker（人）→ bakery（地点）；-ery 常表“……的场所”
advancedExpressions.example: The baker opened his own bakery, where he had once only dreamed of baking. 那面包师开了自己的面包房，曾几何时他只敢梦想在那里烘焙。（对比 bakery / brewery / nursery 同后缀）

advancedExpressions.expression: the warm, buttery air of the bakery seemed to wrap around ... the moment ...
advancedExpressions.example: The warm, buttery air of the bakery seemed to wrap around us the moment we pushed open the door. 一推开门，面包房里温热、带着黄油香的空气仿佛就把我们裹住了。

advancedExpressions.expression: I highly recommend the bakery on ..., where ... and where ...
advancedExpressions.example: I highly recommend the bakery on Green Road, where the bread is baked fresh each dawn and where the owner greets every customer by name. 我极力推荐绿路上那家面包房，那里的面包每天黎明新鲜烘烤，店主还能叫出每位顾客的名字。

advancedExpressions.expression: the survival of small ... shows that people still crave ... that ... can never provide
advancedExpressions.example: The survival of small neighbourhood bakeries shows that people still crave a human warmth which no faceless supermarket can ever provide. 街坊小面包房得以存续，表明人们仍渴望一种冷冰冰的超市永远无法提供的人情温暖。

sentenceUpgrade.original: I visited a bakery with my parents and tried the dessert.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was on a lazy Sunday, in a tiny bakery tucked away down a cobbled lane, that my parents first bought me that dessert — and though years have passed, the buttery warmth of that little shop still lingers, untouched, in a quiet corner of my heart. （读后续写·回忆·强调句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It was ... that 强调句突出时间地点 + tucked away 过去分词状语 + 破折号引出情感延续(still lingers, untouched)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Small bakeries still survive even though there are big supermarkets.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age when towering supermarket chains seem to swallow everything in their path, the quiet endurance of the corner bakery is a gentle reminder that people hunger not merely for bread, but for the warmth, the familiarity and the human touch that no assembly line has ever managed to bake in. （议论文·传统与现代）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In an age when ... 时代背景状语从句 + endurance is a reminder that 抽象名词化 + not merely ... but 递进 + 三名词排比(warmth/familiarity/human touch) + double 双关收尾(bake in)

classPractice.question: 用 bake 家族词填空：The ____ works in a ____, where he ____ bread every morning.（baker / bakery / bakes）
classPractice.note: 构词链：baker 人 / bakery 地点 / bake 动作，注意主语单数谓语用 bakes。

classPractice.question: I first tried it two years ago, when I visited a ____ (面包房) with my parents.
classPractice.note: 面包房为 bakery（可数名词），由 bake + -ery 构成。

classPractice.question: 我极力推荐绿路上那家面包房，那里的面包每天清晨新鲜出炉。（recommend / bakery / where）
classPractice.answer: I highly recommend the bakery on Green Road, where the bread is baked fresh every morning.
classPractice.note: where 引导定语从句修饰 bakery；bread 与 bake 为被动关系，用 is baked。

original_sentence: There are three layers of the cake and the cheese is between the layers, making the dessert feel soft and smooth.
readingExamples: There are three layers of the cake and the cheese is between the layers, making the dessert feel soft and smooth.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an amount or sheet of a substance that covers a surface or that lies between two surfaces
(2) n. a level or part within a system or set of ideas that has many parts
(3) v. to arrange something in layers, one on top of another
(4) n. a level of importance or responsibility within an organization

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （一批中）某一层次的人/机构；某一阶层
uncommonMeanings.example: Beneath the polished surface of the family lay layer upon layer of unspoken resentment, and only that night, over the steaming dumplings, did the deepest one finally break open. （读后续写·家庭和解·情感层次）

posExamples.sentence: She peeled back the crisp golden layer of pastry, and a wisp of fragrant steam curled upward, carrying with it the warm memory of her grandmother's kitchen on snowy winter mornings. （读后续写·美食回忆·感官描写）
To keep the freshly baked mooncakes intact during shipping, please wrap each one in a soft layer of paper and place a sheet of foam between every two rows in the box. （应用文·说明/通知）

A truly nutritious diet, experts argue, is much like a well-built cake: it depends on a balanced layer of proteins, carbohydrates and vitamins, none of which can be sacrificed without weakening the whole. （议论文·健康饮食·类比论证）
The chef layered the thinly sliced beef, the crisp cabbage and the melting cheese with such patient precision that the dish looked less like food than like a small work of art. （读后续写·人物专注·动作描写）

wordForms.other: multi-layered (adj. 多层的)

idioms.example: Layer upon layer of morning mist settled over the terraced rice fields, until the whole valley seemed to float, dreamlike, above the waking world. （读后续写·自然景物·氛围渲染）

collocations.phrase: three layers of / a layer of
collocations.example: There are three layers of the cake, and the cheese is between the layers. 蛋糕有三层，奶酪夹在层与层之间。（课文原句·美食描写）
Scientists warn that damage to the ozone layer threatens all life on Earth. 科学家警告，臭氧层受损威胁地球上的一切生命。（议论文·环境保护高频词）
On a cold day, dressing in layers keeps you warmer than one thick coat. 天冷时，分层穿衣比一件厚外套更保暖。（应用文·活动须知）
A thin layer of frost had crept across the windowpane overnight. 一夜之间，薄薄的一层霜爬上了窗玻璃。（读后续写·冬日细节）
The onion's papery outer layer crackled as she peeled it away. 她剥去洋葱纸一样的外层时，它发出沙沙声。（读后续写·下厨场景）
The top layer of the cake was dusted with cocoa. 蛋糕的顶层撒上了一层可可粉。（应用文·食谱介绍）
The artist built up the oil painting in layers, letting each coat dry first. 画家一层层地叠画油画，每涂一层都先让它干透。（读后续写·艺术创作）

collocations.phrase: a layer of dust / snow / paint
collocations.example: A soft layer of snow had wrapped the sleeping village in silence. 一层软雪把沉睡的村庄裹进了寂静里。（读后续写·环境烘托）
The reporter gently peeled back the layers of the champion's story. 记者轻轻揭开了这位冠军故事的层层内里。（读后续写·揭示内心）

synonyms.example: At every level of the competition she encountered stronger rivals, yet each defeat only sharpened her resolve. （读后续写·竞赛励志）

posExamples.sentence: Trembling with excitement, the little boy knelt by the riverbank and gently let the rescued turtle loose, watching it paddle into the green depths until not a single ripple remained. （读后续写·放生·动作与画面）

I am writing to suggest that we set aside one afternoon each term when students may let their imagination loose, painting whatever colours their hearts desire on the blank walls of the old corridor. （应用文·建议信·校园活动）

Once fear is let loose in a crowd, reason is often the first casualty; a single panicked shout can drive hundreds toward the exits before anyone pauses to ask whether the danger is real. （议论文·群体心理·从众效应）
The moment the cage door swung open, the birds were let loose into the morning sky, and for a heartbeat the air was thick with beating wings and the pure, reckless joy of freedom. （读后续写·自由主题·环境描写）

idioms.translation: 突然发出（喊声、大笑等）；尽情释放
idioms.example: Unable to hold back any longer, she let loose with a peal of laughter so bright and unguarded that the whole waiting room turned to smile at her. （读后续写·情绪释放）
For years he had felt trapped in his father's shadow, but the day he broke loose and boarded that train north, he finally began to write his own story. （读后续写·成长与独立）

collocations.phrase: let sth loose / let loose sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】释放；放任（to free sb/sth from whatever holds them/it in place）
collocations.example: The hot flavour is enough to let loose rivers of sweat on a summer afternoon. 那火辣的味道足以在夏日午后让人汗流浃背。（课件·课文原句·四川火锅）
Don't let your dog loose on the beach. 不要让你的狗在沙滩上乱跑。（课件·slide 1）

collocations.phrase: loosed a tide of sth（loose vt.）
collocations.translation: 【课件】（loose 作动词）表露、释放出一股……（release）
collocations.example: His speech loosed a tide of nationalist sentiment. 他的讲话表露出一种强烈的民族主义情绪。（课件·slide 1）
He loosed the straps that bound her arms. 他松开了绑在她手臂上的带子。（课件·slide 1）

collocations.translation: 释放；放开；放任（使不再受约束地自由活动）
collocations.example: The hot flavour is enough to let loose rivers of sweat on a summer afternoon. 那火辣的味道足以在夏日午后让人大汗淋漓。（课文原句·四川火锅）
The volunteers let the wounded eagle loose after weeks of care. 精心照料数周后，志愿者把受伤的鹰放归山林。（读后续写·动物救助）
Give children scrap paper and let their imagination loose. 给孩子们一些废纸，放飞他们的想象力。（议论文·创造力教育）
Only when the door closed did she let her feelings loose. 直到门关上，她才任情感尽情宣泄。（读后续写·压抑后的释放）

collocations.translation: 让某人放手去做某事（常含调侃）
collocations.example: The teacher let us loose on the school garden with seeds and spades. 老师放手让我们去打理校园的花圃，给了种子和铁锹。（读后续写·信任与责任）
When the news was let loose on social media, it spread like wildfire. 消息一在社交媒体上放出，便像野火般蔓延。（应用文·新闻报道）
One careless remark let all hell loose in the online forum. 一句不慎的话在网络论坛里掀起一片混乱。（议论文·网络舆论）

collocations.translation: 挣脱束缚；放开手脚（尽情做）
collocations.example: After the exams were over, we finally cut loose, dancing barefoot on the beach until the stars came out. （读后续写·青春·释放）

synonyms.example: With a deep breath, she released the paper lantern into the night. 她深吸一口气，把纸灯笼放进夜色里。（读后续写·祈愿场景）
synonyms.usage: release 更正式、中性，可用于释放动物、情感、能量、信息，及物动词直接跟宾语；let sth loose 更口语，强调"不再受约束地任其自由活动"

synonyms.example: The old fisherman set the giant carp free. 老渔夫把那条大鲤鱼放走了。（读后续写·善念）
synonyms.usage: set sth free 强调赋予自由、解除囚禁，情感色彩偏正面；let sth loose 有时带"放任、失控"的中性甚至贬义

synonyms.example: The typhoon unleashed its full fury on the coast. 台风向海岸倾泻出全部的狂暴。（读后续写·自然之力）
synonyms.usage: unleash 书面、力度极强，多搭配 force/anger/potential 等抽象强力事物，比 let loose 更具冲击感与文学性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·loose 作宾语补足语（let sb/sth + loose）
advancedExpressions.expression: let + 宾语 + loose（形容词 loose 作宾语补足语，别误拼成动词 lose）
advancedExpressions.example: Don't let your dog loose on the beach. 不要让你的狗在沙滩上乱跑。（课件原句；loose 是宾补，非 lose）

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·loose 作动词 vs let ... loose
advancedExpressions.expression: loose vt.（=loosen 松开／=release 表露、释放）· let sth loose（放开某物任其自由）
advancedExpressions.example: He loosed the straps (松开); his speech loosed a tide of sentiment (表露); he let his dog loose (放开). （课件三义对比：loose 单独作动词 vs let ... loose 短语）

advancedExpressions.expression: let sth/sb loose（放开）· let one's imagination loose（放飞想象）· let one's feelings loose（宣泄情感）· be let loose（被放出）· let all hell loose（掀起混乱）
advancedExpressions.example: 从"放生动物"到"放飞想象"再到"宣泄情感"，let...loose 由具体到抽象都能用。（课堂·搭配归纳）

advancedExpressions.expression: let + 宾语 + loose（形容词作宾语补足语）
advancedExpressions.example: She opened her hands and let the sparrow loose. 她张开手，把麻雀放走。（loose 在此是宾补，不是动词 lose，别拼错）

advancedExpressions.expression: no longer able to hold it back, sb. let ... loose
advancedExpressions.example: No longer able to hold it back, he let a decade of grief loose in a single, shuddering sob. （分词状语前置铺垫 + let...loose 情绪爆发）

advancedExpressions.expression: once ... is let loose, ...; therefore ...
advancedExpressions.example: Once a rumour is let loose, it can no longer be recalled, however sincere the later apology; therefore we must weigh every word. （条件让步 + 因果推论，论证不可逆性）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us let our ... loose and ...
advancedExpressions.example: During the festival, let us let our creativity loose and turn every dull corner of the campus into a canvas of colour and imagination. （倡议信号召句,let us + let...loose 双重呼应,富有感染力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She let the bird go.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Cupping the tiny sparrow in her palms one last time, she opened her hands and let it loose, and as it vanished into the blue she felt an unexpected lightness, as though she too had been set free. （读后续写·放生·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语开头(Cupping...)营造画面 + let it loose 关键动作 + as引导时间/因果 + as though比喻,将'放走鸟'升华为'自我解脱'

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should let students be more creative.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that, rather than confining pupils to rigid templates, we should let their creativity loose, for it is in the freedom to err and explore that true originality is born. （议论文·教育观点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + rather than 对比结构 + let...loose 核心主张 + for 引导原因 + it is...that 强调句收尾

classPractice.note: let one's imagination loose = 放飞想象力；loose 作宾补，别误写成 lose

classPractice.note: let 的过去分词仍是 let；be let loose 被放出、被泄露

original_sentence: In the beginning, the delicious dish was made simply by boiling vegetables, chillies and Sichuan peppers in water.
readingExamples: In the beginning, the delicious dish was made simply by boiling vegetables, chillies and Sichuan peppers in water.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a small, thin, red or green vegetable with a very hot taste, used in cooking to add spiciness (also spelt chili / chile)
(2) n. (also chilli powder) the dried, ground form of this vegetable used as a spice
(3) n. (informal, short for chilli con carne) a spicy dish of meat, beans and chillies

posExamples.sentence: The moment I bit into the dumpling, a fiery chilli caught the back of my throat, and tears sprang to my eyes even as I reached, helplessly, for another. （读后续写·美食体验·味觉冲击）
Fresh chillies, ginger and a handful of Sichuan peppers are essential if you wish to recreate the authentic flavour of a home-made hot pot. （应用文·食谱/说明文）
To many foreign visitors, the searing chilli of Sichuan cuisine is not merely a taste but a rite of passage into a bolder, more adventurous way of eating. （议论文·饮食文化）

wordForms.other: chili / chile (美式拼写)；★拼写特例：单数 chilli，复数 chillies（辅音+y 变 ies）；别与 chilly (adj. 寒冷的) 混淆——chilli 是名词"辣椒"，chilly 是形容词"冷飕飕的"

collocations.example: In the beginning, the dish was made simply by boiling vegetables, chillies and Sichuan peppers in water. 起初，这道菜只是把蔬菜、辣椒和花椒放进水里煮。（课文原句·四川火锅由来）
A few slices of red chilli scattered over the white fish made the dish look festive. 几片红辣椒撒在白鱼上，让这道菜看着喜庆。（读后续写·家宴场景）
She drizzled a spoonful of chilli oil over the noodles. 她往面上淋了一勺辣椒油。（读后续写·家常美食）
The fiery chilli left my lips burning long after the meal. 那火辣的辣椒让我嘴唇在饭后好久还在发烫。（读后续写·味觉体验）
Remember to wash your hands after you chop the chillies. 切完辣椒记得洗手。（应用文·食谱提醒）
Grandma always added a few extra chillies to the soup on cold days. 天冷时奶奶总往汤里多加几个辣椒。（读后续写·温暖记忆）

synonyms.example: A pinch of ground pepper and a single fresh chilli transformed the plain broth into something unforgettable. （读后续写·烹饪）
synonyms.usage: pepper 含义更宽,既指胡椒也泛指辣椒类;chilli 特指味道辛辣的小辣椒,更具体

synonyms.example: The market stalls overflowed with spices of every colour, and the air itself seemed to tingle on the tongue. （读后续写·集市场景）
synonyms.usage: spice 是香料的统称(含辣椒、花椒、胡椒等);chilli 只是其中一种,不能互换

advancedExpressions.expression: the chilli set sb.'s ... ablaze / on fire
advancedExpressions.example: The chilli set my tongue ablaze, yet with each mouthful I found myself craving more, as if the heat itself had become a strange kind of joy. （感官夸张 + yet 转折,写'越辣越想吃'的矛盾体验）

advancedExpressions.expression: no ... would be complete without the fiery bite of chilli
advancedExpressions.example: No visit to Sichuan would be complete without the fiery bite of chilli, a flavour woven deep into the region's spirit. （no...would be complete without 强调不可或缺,介绍地方饮食）

advancedExpressions.expression: chilli is more than a flavour; it is ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The soup was very spicy.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: so...that 结果状语 + 具体身体反应(sweat, eyes watered)代替抽象'spicy' + yet 转折 + 分词短语收尾(utterly conquered)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Chilli is important in Sichuan food.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Chilli lies at the very heart of Sichuan cuisine, lending its dishes not only their unmistakable fire but also a warmth that mirrors the openness of the people who created them. （议论文/说明文·文化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: lie at the heart of 替换 be important + not only...but also 递进 + 用 warmth 双关(既指辣的温热,又指人情温暖)升华

definitionEn:
(1) n. a powder made from dried berries, used to give a hot taste to food (black / white pepper)

For a healthier lunch, why not fill a colourful red pepper with rice, sweetcorn and diced chicken, then bake it until it softens? （应用文·健康食谱/建议）

original_sentence: Sichuan hot pots are perfect for the damp, foggy climate in which they were invented.

definitionEn:

(2) adj. (of glass or a surface) covered with tiny drops of water so that you cannot see through it

definitionEn:

posExamples.sentence: As the young emperor gazed at the crumbling palace walls, he understood with a heavy heart that the once-glorious dynasty founded by his ancestors was now slipping quietly into history. （读后续写·历史·兴衰）

original_sentence: Over time, it has expanded to include multiple options of soups, vegetables, meats and sauces, appealing to people of different tastes.

definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to become larger in size, number or amount, or to make something larger
(2) vt. & vi. to develop and become more successful, or to make a business, activity, etc. develop

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 详述，展开说明（expand on/upon）
