classPractice.note: chef 指餐厅专业厨师(尤指厨师长)；cook 泛指做饭的人，不含级别

classPractice.question: 十五年后，她终于被提拔为厨师长。After fifteen years, she was finally promoted to ____ ____ (厨师长).
classPractice.note: head chef 主厨/厨师长；be promoted to 被提拔为

classPractice.question: 这只小老鼠梦想成为一名餐厅厨师。（用 dream of becoming）
classPractice.answer: The little rat dreams of becoming a chef in a restaurant.
classPractice.note: dream of doing sth 梦想做某事；of 后接动名词

translation: 性质，属性；私有财产，房产；不动产
definitionEn:
(1) n. a thing or things that are owned by someone; possessions collectively
(2) n. a building or piece of land, especially one that someone owns; real estate
(3) n. a quality or characteristic that something has, especially a natural one
(4) n. (in law) the right to own and use something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （事物的）性质，属性，特性（尤指科学的，常用复数 properties）
uncommonMeanings.example: Scientists are studying the physical and chemical properties of the new material. 科学家正在研究这种新材料的物理和化学性质。（课堂·多义·科学）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 房产，不动产，地产
uncommonMeanings.example: House prices are rising, so many see property as a safe investment. 房价在上涨，许多人把房产视为稳妥的投资。（课堂·多义·房产）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 财产，所有物（不可数，泛指所拥有之物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The thief was caught trying to sell the stolen property. 那名窃贼在企图变卖赃物时被抓。（课堂·多义·财物）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （戏剧、电影中的）道具（常缩写为 prop）
uncommonMeanings.example: Backstage, she checked every property one last time — the fake sword, the paper crown, the letter that would break the audience's heart in the final act. （读后续写·舞台幕后）

posExamples.sentence: When the old man passed away, he left no fortune, no grand property — only a worn notebook whose pages, they would soon discover, were worth more than gold. （读后续写·遗产悬念）
I am writing to report that some public property in our community park, including two benches and a lamp, has been damaged and urgently needs repair. （应用文·报告/投诉信）
Traditionally, duck is believed to have cooling properties, which is precisely why it becomes a favourite dish during the sweltering months of summer. （议论文/说明文·文化习俗）
It is a truth widely acknowledged that respecting others' property is one of the earliest and most essential lessons a civilised society can teach its young. （议论文·公德教育）

wordForms.noun: property (n. 财产；房产；性质); proprietor (n. 业主，所有者); appropriation (n. 拨款；挪用)
wordForms.other: 复数特例·property 的复数 properties（去 y 加 ies）；作“性质、属性”时几乎总用复数 properties。词族联系：property—proper（恰当的）—appropriate（挪用；恰当的）同源于拉丁 proprius（自己的）

collocations.example: A sign reading 'Private Property — No Trespassing' hung on the gate. 大门上挂着一块写着“私人领地，禁止入内”的牌子。（课堂·标识常见语）

collocations.phrase: cooling / medicinal properties （课文原句改写）
collocations.example: Traditionally, duck is considered to have cooling properties. 传统上认为鸭肉具有清凉的属性。（课文原句·选择性必修一U1）
As responsible citizens, we should treat public property as carefully as we treat our own. （应用文·倡议书）
Protecting intellectual property is essential if we wish to reward creativity and encourage genuine innovation. （议论文·创新与保护）
The storm damaged property across the whole coastal town, yet not a single life was lost, thanks to the timely warning. （读后续写·灾难）
In the laboratory, the students carefully recorded the physical properties of each unknown substance. （应用文·实验报告）
For centuries, this humble herb has been prized for its healing properties. （议论文·传统医学）
Each property owner along the river was asked to contribute to the cost of the new flood barrier. （应用文·社区通知）
The family had owned that piece of property for three generations, and no offer, however tempting, could persuade them to sell. （读后续写·家族坚守）

synonyms.example: As the fire spread, she grabbed her most treasured possession — a faded photograph of her late mother — and fled into the night. （读后续写·灾难取舍）
synonyms.usage: possession 强调'被拥有的具体物品',常用复数(belongings);property 更抽象、更正式,可指房产、财产总称或事物的属性

synonyms.example: The lawyer explained that the entire estate would pass to the youngest daughter. （读后续写·遗产）
synonyms.usage: estate 特指大片地产、庄园或某人去世后遗留的全部财产;property 范围更广,可指任何被拥有之物或事物的'性质'

synonyms.example: Patience was the defining characteristic that set the old teacher apart. （议论文·品质）
synonyms.usage: 作'性质'解时,characteristic 泛指人或物的显著特征;property 特指物质本身固有的(尤指科学)属性,如化学、物理性质

advancedExpressions.expression: private/public property 私有/公共财产 / intellectual property 知识产权 / medicinal properties 药用属性 / property prices 房价
advancedExpressions.example: Respecting others' property is one of the earliest lessons a civilised society teaches. 尊重他人财产是文明社会最早教给人的一课。（议论文·公德）

advancedExpressions.expression: proprius(自己的)→ property 财产/属性、proper 恰当的、appropriate 挪用/恰当、proprietor 业主
advancedExpressions.example: The proprietor of the small shop refused to sell his family property at any price. 这家小店的业主无论如何都不肯卖掉家族的地产。（读后续写）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：财产与属性
advancedExpressions.expression: 作“财产”：property / possession(s) / belongings / estate；作“性质”：property / quality / characteristic / feature
advancedExpressions.example: As the fire spread, she grabbed her most treasured possession and fled. 火势蔓延时，她抓起最珍贵的财物逃了出去。（辨析·possession vs property）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth was more than mere property to sb.; it was ...
advancedExpressions.example: The old violin was more than mere property to him; it was the last living voice of a father he could no longer hear. （破折号/分号 + 递进定义,赋予物件情感重量）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us take it upon ourselves to safeguard public property
advancedExpressions.example: Let us take it upon ourselves to safeguard public property, for a clean and orderly community is the shared achievement of us all. （倡议信结尾号召,we-意识强烈）

advancedExpressions.expression: owing to its unique properties, sth ...
advancedExpressions.example: Owing to its unique properties of durability and lightness, this new material is set to revolutionise the way we build. （原因状语前置 + be set to 表趋势,说明文/议论文说明特性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The herb is good for cooling the body in summer.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Prized for its natural cooling properties, this unassuming herb has, for generations, offered weary farmers a small measure of relief against the merciless heat of midsummer. （说明文·文化习俗）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语前置(Prized for...) + properties 专业化表达 + for generations 时间纵深 + against the merciless heat 形象化

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should not damage things that belong to everyone.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It should go without saying that damaging public property is not merely a careless act but a quiet betrayal of the trust that binds a community together. （议论文·公德）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It should go without saying that... 正式引入 + not merely...but 递进 + a quiet betrayal 抽象化提升道德分量

classPractice.question: Scientists are studying the physical and chemical ____ (property) of this new material.
classPractice.note: 作“性质、属性”解时几乎总用复数 properties；property 去 y 加 ies

classPractice.question: 选词填空：property / possession。① Do not enter — this is private ____. ② She saved only one ____ from the fire: her mother's photograph.
classPractice.note: property 财产/房产/领地(较抽象正式)；possession 具体的“所有物”，常指随身珍视之物

classPractice.question: 作为负责任的公民，我们应当爱护公共财产。（用 public property）
classPractice.answer: As responsible citizens, we should take good care of / protect public property.
classPractice.note: public property 公共财产，通常不可数，不加 s

original_sentence: Traditionally, duck is considered to have cooling properties, so it is appropriate for the hot summer months.
readingExamples: Traditionally, duck is considered to have cooling properties, so it is appropriate for the hot summer months.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. suitable or right for a particular situation, purpose, or person
(2) adj. correct or acceptable according to the customs or standards of a society
(3) vt. (formal) to take something for one's own use, usually without permission
(4) vt. (formal) to set aside money or resources for a specific purpose

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 挪用，占用（他人之物，常含未经许可之意）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was accused of quietly appropriating the ideas of his junior colleagues and presenting them as his own. （读后续写·职场冲突·揭露真相）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拨（款），划拨（资金作特定用途）
uncommonMeanings.example: The committee agreed to appropriate a generous sum for the restoration of the ancient library. （应用文·会议决议）

posExamples.sentence: Sensing that laughter would be entirely out of place, she chose the more appropriate response — a gentle hand on his shoulder and a silence that said everything words could not. （读后续写·情感·恰当反应）
Please ensure that you wear appropriate clothing and bring adequate water, as the mountain trail can be both steep and unexpectedly cold. （应用文·活动须知）
It is only through choosing the appropriate means, rather than the most convenient one, that a society can pursue progress without sacrificing its values. （议论文·手段与目的）
Traditionally, duck is considered to have cooling properties, so it is regarded as appropriate for the hot summer months. （说明文·饮食文化）

wordForms.noun: appropriateness (n. 恰当，适宜); appropriation (n. 拨款；挪用)
wordForms.other: 反义词·inappropriate (adj. 不恰当的) / inappropriately (adv. 不恰当地)。读音区分：形容词 appropriate 末尾读 /-iət/（弱读），动词“挪用/拨款”末尾读 /-ieɪt/（强读）。近义 suitable/proper/fitting

collocations.example: Which dress is more appropriate for the party? 哪件衣服更适合这个聚会？（课件·Extended·核心搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（对某人来说）做……是（不）合适的
collocations.example: It is not appropriate to ask such personal questions in an interview. 在采访中问这样的私人问题是不合适的。（课件·Extended·句型）

collocations.translation: 【课件】……是合适的（that 从句用 should + 动词原形，should 可省）
collocations.example: It's appropriate that we should be present at the meeting. 我们出席会议是合适的。（课件·Extended·虚拟should）
The government took an appropriate measure to control the crowd. 政府采取了一项恰当的措施来控制人群。（课件·Extended·名词搭配）

collocations.phrase: appropriately (adv.) 恰当地，合适地 / inappropriate (adj.) 不适当的
collocations.translation: 【课件】派生词：appropriately 恰当地；inappropriate 不合适的
collocations.example: Her new job started, appropriately enough, on January 1st. 她的新工作，很恰当地，正好从1月1日开始。（课件·Extended·派生词）
This film is not appropriate for young children. 这部电影不适合小孩子看。（课堂·核心结构）

collocations.phrase: appropriate for the hot summer months （课文原句）
collocations.example: Duck is considered to have cooling properties, so it is appropriate for the hot summer months. 鸭肉被认为有清凉的属性，因此适合炎热的夏季。（课文原句·选择性必修一U1）
Faced with the child's tears, the teacher searched for an appropriate response that would comfort without embarrassing him. （读后续写·师生）
The government urged citizens to take appropriate measures to protect themselves during the heatwave. （应用文·公告）
Volunteers may adjust the schedule as appropriate, provided the safety of the elderly is never compromised. （应用文·志愿指南）
Learning what counts as appropriate behaviour in different cultures is an essential part of studying abroad. （议论文·跨文化）
The headmaster did not consider it appropriate to announce the news before the families had been informed. （读后续写·分寸）
Candidates are advised to use appropriate language throughout the interview. （应用文·面试提示）
Add examples where appropriate to make your argument more convincing. （议论文·写作指导）

synonyms.example: After hours of searching, she finally found a gift suitable for a man who claimed to want nothing at all. （读后续写·选礼物）
synonyms.usage: suitable 是最常用的'合适的',强调符合需求或场合;appropriate 更正式,更强调符合'礼仪、身份或道德标准'的恰当性

synonyms.example: Without proper training, even the bravest volunteer may do more harm than good in a rescue. （议论文·专业性）
synonyms.usage: proper 强调'正确、规范、符合规矩';appropriate 强调'与特定情境相称',二者常可互换,但 appropriate 语域更书面

synonyms.example: A moment of silence seemed a fitting tribute to the hero who had given his life for strangers. （读后续写·致敬）
synonyms.usage: fitting 多用于'恰如其分、相称'的场合(尤指仪式、纪念),文学色彩较浓;appropriate 适用范围更广、更中性

advancedExpressions.expression: appropriate for/to sth 适合于 / take appropriate measures 采取适当措施 / as appropriate 酌情 / where appropriate 在适当情况下
advancedExpressions.example: The school will take appropriate measures to keep every student safe during the storm. 学校将采取适当措施在暴风雨期间保障每名学生的安全。（应用文·公告）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·appropriate 一词两性（词性变义）
advancedExpressions.expression: adj. 合适的 /əˈprəʊpriət/ ↔ vt. 挪用、拨款 /əˈprəʊprieɪt/，同形不同读、意义相反语境
advancedExpressions.example: It is not appropriate to appropriate others' work and call it your own. 挪用他人成果并称为己有是不恰当的。（辨析·一词两性）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表示“合适、恰当”
advancedExpressions.expression: appropriate / suitable / proper / fitting / apt；反义 inappropriate / unsuitable
advancedExpressions.example: After hours of searching, she found a gift suitable for a man who wanted nothing. 找了几个小时，她终于找到一件适合“什么都不想要”的人的礼物。（辨析·suitable vs appropriate）

advancedExpressions.expression: sensing that ... , sb. chose the more appropriate ...
advancedExpressions.example: Sensing that empty comfort would only sting, she chose the more appropriate gift of silence, letting him grieve in his own time. （现在分词状语 + 心理揣摩,续写细腻刻画人物的分寸感）

advancedExpressions.expression: it would be appropriate to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It would be appropriate to arrive fifteen minutes early, so as to show both respect and readiness. （委婉建议句式,语气得体不生硬）

advancedExpressions.expression: the appropriate approach is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The appropriate approach to a stubborn problem is not to force a hasty solution, but to understand its roots with patience and care. （not...but 对比框架,凸显'恰当'方法的理性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She said the right thing at the right time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: At the very moment when a careless word could have shattered him, she said exactly the appropriate thing — quiet, kind, and perfectly timed — and something in his eyes softened at last. （读后续写·对话+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: At the very moment when 状语从句设置张力 + 破折号插入三形容词(quiet, kind, perfectly timed) + 结果句(something softened)刻画转变

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use suitable ways to solve problems.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that lasting solutions arise not from the quickest methods, but from the most appropriate ones — those that respect both the problem's complexity and the people it affects. （议论文·方法论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that... 正式主句 + not...but 对比 + 破折号引出同位语从句补充定义,提升论证深度

classPractice.type: 【语境应用】翻译句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: 每个场合都穿着得体。
classPractice.note: 课件Extended原题；appropriately 作副词修饰动词 dress，表“得体地”

classPractice.type: 【语境应用】翻译句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: 问问你的医生是否这些治疗手段都适合你。
classPractice.answer: Ask your doctor whether these treatments are appropriate to / for you.
classPractice.note: 课件Extended原题；be appropriate to / for sb 适合某人

classPractice.question: This kind of behaviour is quite ____ (appropriate) at a formal dinner and may offend the host.
classPractice.note: 句意“会冒犯主人”暗示否定，需反义词 inappropriate；前缀 in- 表否定

classPractice.question: 鸭肉有清凉的属性，因此适合炎热的夏季。Duck has cooling properties, so it is ____ ____ (适合) the hot summer.
classPractice.note: be appropriate for/to sth 适合于……；for 后接名词

classPractice.question: 选词填空：appropriate / suitable。In such a solemn ceremony, loud laughter would be entirely ____.
classPractice.note: 语境需“不得体、不合礼仪”，appropriate 更强调符合礼仪身份，其否定 inappropriate 最贴切

translation: vt. 估计，估价 | n. 估计；估价的成本
original_sentence: Nowadays, people eat salted duck all year round and it is estimated that tens of thousands of ducks are consumed every day in Nanjing!
readingExamples: Nowadays, people eat salted duck all year round and it is estimated that tens of thousands of ducks are consumed every day in Nanjing!
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to judge or calculate the amount, size, value, or cost of something, especially roughly
(2) vt. to form an opinion about something after considering the available facts
(3) n. an approximate calculation or judgement of a number, amount, or value
(4) n. a written statement of the likely cost of doing a piece of work

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对人或事的）评价，看法
uncommonMeanings.example: Her cowardly retreat that night lowered him greatly in her estimate, and no apology afterwards could quite restore what had been lost. （读后续写·人物评价·信任崩塌）

posExamples.sentence: Gazing at the raging river, the old ferryman estimated the danger in a single glance and, without a word, turned the frightened children back toward the safety of the shore. （读后续写·危急判断）
It is estimated that more than three hundred students will take part in the charity walk, so we kindly ask all volunteers to prepare sufficient water in advance. （应用文·活动通知）
According to a rough estimate, the volunteers planted over two thousand saplings that weekend, transforming the barren hillside into a promise of future green. （读后续写·公益成果）
While no estimate can capture the true worth of a good education, one thing is beyond dispute: its returns extend far beyond any figure on a page. （议论文·教育价值）

wordForms.noun: estimate (n. 估计；估价单); estimation (n. 估计；评价)
wordForms.other: 反义构词·前缀 over-（过度）/ under-（不足）：overestimate 高估、underestimate 低估；estimator (n. 估算者)。发音变位：动词 estimate 末尾读 /-meɪt/，名词读 /-mət/。近义 calculate（精算）/ assess（评定）/ reckon（口语估计）

idioms.translation: 在某人看来;依某人的评价
idioms.example: In her estimation, no act of kindness, however small, was ever truly wasted. （议论文·价值观）

collocations.example: Police estimate the crowd at / to be 30,000. 警方估计聚集的人有3万。（课件·Extended·动词搭配）
The gardener estimated that it would take him four hours to weed the garden. 园丁估计他给花园除草需要四个小时。（课件·Extended·句法）
I can give you a rough estimate of the amount of wood you will need. 我可以给你粗略估计一下你需要的木料量。（课件·Extended·名词搭配）

collocations.phrase: a conservative estimate / an optimistic estimate （课件）
collocations.translation: 【课件】保守的估计／乐观的估计（our best estimate 最佳估计）
collocations.example: Even by a conservative estimate, the project will cost over a million yuan. 即便保守估计，这个项目也要花费一百多万元。（课件·Extended·名词搭配对比）
official estimates of traffic growth over the next decade 对今后十年交通增长的官方估计（课件·Extended·名词搭配）

collocations.phrase: it is estimated that ... （课文原句）
collocations.example: It is estimated that tens of thousands of ducks are consumed every day in Nanjing! 据估计，南京每天要消耗成千上万只鸭子！（课文原句·选择性必修一U1）
Experts estimate that the population will double within thirty years. 专家估计人口将在三十年内翻一番。（课堂·句法）
The builder gave us an estimate of the total cost. 承建商给了我们一份总费用的估价。（课堂·名词搭配）
By a conservative estimate, the flood had left over a thousand families in urgent need of shelter. （应用文·灾情报告）
Before the trip, we carefully estimated the cost so that no member would be caught short of money. （应用文·活动计划）
Never underestimate the quiet strength of a person who has already survived their darkest hour. （读后续写·人物韧性）
The builder promised to provide a detailed estimate before any work on the school library began. （应用文·工程沟通）
Without accurate estimates of demand, even the best-planned event can end in chaos. （议论文·计划的重要性）
Experts estimate the age of the ancient tree at more than a thousand years. （说明文·科普）

collocations.translation: 据一切估计,无论怎么估算
collocations.example: By all estimates, the young company had far exceeded what anyone had dared to hope. （读后续写·创业成功）

synonyms.example: She quickly calculated how many hours of daylight remained before the storm reached the valley. （读后续写·紧迫）
synonyms.usage: calculate 强调'精确运算',依据数据得出确切结果;estimate 强调'粗略估算',结果是近似值而非精确数

synonyms.example: The teacher paused to assess how much the struggling boy had truly understood. （读后续写·教学）
synonyms.usage: assess 侧重经过分析后'全面评定'价值、质量或程度,过程更审慎;estimate 侧重对数量、大小的'大致判断'

synonyms.example: I reckon we have just enough time to reach the summit before nightfall. （读后续写·口语判断）
synonyms.usage: reckon 偏口语,表'估计、认为',带主观推测;estimate 更中性、更书面,常用于数字与正式语境

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·it is estimated that + 从句（形式主语）
advancedExpressions.expression: It is estimated / reported / believed / said that ... —— it 作形式主语，that 从句为真正主语，避免头重脚轻
advancedExpressions.example: It is estimated that over 60% of students skip breakfast on busy mornings. 据估计，超过60%的学生在忙碌的早晨不吃早餐。（应用文·调查报告）

advancedExpressions.expression: overestimate 高估 / underestimate 低估；写作常用“don't underestimate ...”警醒句
advancedExpressions.example: We must not underestimate the power of small, consistent efforts. 我们绝不能低估微小而持续努力的力量。（议论文·警醒式论点）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表示“估计、判断”
advancedExpressions.expression: estimate 粗略估算(数字) / calculate 精确计算 / assess 全面评定 / reckon 口语估计认为 / gauge 揣度
advancedExpressions.example: She quickly calculated the hours of daylight left, then estimated how far they could still travel. 她迅速算出剩余的日照时间，再估算他们还能走多远。（辨析·calculate vs estimate）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a single glance, sb. estimated ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a single glance, the veteran estimated the distance, the wind, and the fading light — and knew he had but one chance to make the leap. （三项并列宾语 + 破折号转折,续写渲染当机立断的紧张感）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is estimated that ..., which suggests ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is estimated that over 60% of students skip breakfast, which suggests an urgent need to raise awareness of healthy eating on campus. （数据 + which 引导评论,调查报告说服力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: we must not underestimate the ... of ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must not underestimate the power of small, consistent efforts, for it is precisely these that, over time, reshape a life. （否定祈使强调 + for 引导论证,警醒式论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He guessed how far away the shore was.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Narrowing his eyes against the glare, he estimated the distance to the shore, and his heart sank as the cold truth settled in: it was farther than any of them could hope to swim. （读后续写·绝境判断）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Narrowing his eyes)营造画面 + estimated 替换 guessed 更精准 + 冒号引出心理反应(his heart sank)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people eat salted duck in Nanjing.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is estimated that tens of thousands of ducks are consumed in Nanjing every single day — a staggering figure that testifies to how deeply this humble dish is woven into the city's daily life. （说明文·数据升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is estimated that... 被动数据句 + 破折号引出评论(a staggering figure) + be woven into 隐喻文化渗透

classPractice.type: 【语境应用】完成句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: The tree ____ (被估计至少有七百年了).
classPractice.answer: is estimated to be at least 700 years old
classPractice.note: 课件Extended原题；be estimated to be ... 被估计为……；此处 to be 后接年龄

classPractice.type: 【语境应用】完成句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: ____ (他们估计) the journey will take at least two weeks.
classPractice.note: 课件Extended原题；estimate that + 从句，that 可省略

classPractice.type: 【语境应用】完成句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: We got ____ (三家公司的估价) and accepted the lowest.
classPractice.note: 课件Extended原题；estimate 作名词=估价（单），此处复数指多份估价单

classPractice.question: It ____ (estimate) that tens of thousands of ducks are consumed in Nanjing every day.
classPractice.note: It is estimated that... 据估计；形式主语 it + 被动语态，主句用一般现在时

classPractice.question: 选词填空：underestimate / overestimate。Don't ____ how hard this exam is — many strong students have failed it before.
classPractice.note: 语境“很多优等生都挂过”提示“别低估难度”，用 underestimate(低估)

classPractice.question: 承建商在动工前给了我们一份总费用的估价。（用 an estimate of）
classPractice.answer: The builder gave / provided us (with) an estimate of the total cost before the work began.
classPractice.note: an estimate of sth 对……的估价；estimate 此处作名词，读 /ˈestɪmət/

translation: 吃，喝，饮；消耗，耗费（燃料、能量或时间）
original_sentence: Nowadays, people eat salted duck all year round and it is estimated that tens of thousands of ducks are consumed every day in Nanjing!
readingExamples: Nowadays, people eat salted duck all year round and it is estimated that tens of thousands of ducks are consumed every day in Nanjing!
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to eat or drink something
(2) vt. to use fuel, energy, time or resources, especially in large amounts
(3) vt. (of a fire) to destroy something completely
(4) vt. (of a feeling) to affect someone so strongly that it fills all their thoughts

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （强烈情感）使沉浸，使无法自拔
uncommonMeanings.example: For weeks after the accident, guilt consumed him — it gnawed at his mind in the classroom, followed him home like a shadow, and stole the sleep from his restless nights. （读后续写·心理煎熬·被愧疚吞噬）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （火焰）焚毁，吞没
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time the firefighters arrived, the flames had already consumed half the ancient library, and centuries of irreplaceable manuscripts were curling into ash before their helpless eyes. （读后续写·灾难场景·火焰吞没）

posExamples.sentence: The old cobbler consumed his meagre supper in silence, savouring every crumb of bread as though it were a feast, for in his humble world contentment was a dish far richer than any banquet. （读后续写·人物刻画·知足惜福）

I am writing to urge every resident to reflect on how much electricity we consume each day, for small habits like switching off idle lights can, collectively, make a remarkable difference to our carbon footprint. （应用文·倡议书·环保）

It is undeniable that modern societies consume natural resources at an alarming rate; unless we curb this reckless appetite, future generations may inherit a planet stripped bare of the very wealth we take for granted. （议论文·可持续发展）
Absorbed in her painting, the young artist scarcely noticed how the afternoon had been consumed, hour by hour, until the fading light finally forced her to lay down her brush. （读后续写·专注沉浸·时光流逝）

wordForms.noun: consumption (消耗量，消费；用不可数) / consumer (消费者)
wordForms.adjective: consuming (强烈的) / time-consuming (耗时的) / consumable (可消耗的)
wordForms.other: 构词法·consume(v.)→consumption(n.消耗/消费,注意拼写ump)→consumer(n.消费者)→consumerism(n.消费主义)；合成词 time-consuming(耗时的)、energy-consuming(耗能的)

idioms.translation: 被（某种强烈情感）所吞噬
idioms.example: She was consumed with curiosity when a mysterious parcel, bearing no sender's name, appeared on her doorstep at dawn. （读后续写·悬念铺陈·好奇难耐）

collocations.example: He consumes large quantities of chips with every meal. 他每一餐都要吃掉大量的薯条。（课件·Extended·吃喝义）

collocations.translation: 【课件】消耗时间／能量／燃料（尤指燃料、能量或时间）
collocations.example: Only 27% of the paper we consume is recycled. 我们消耗的纸张只有27%得到回收利用。（课件·Extended·消耗义）

collocations.phrase: consumption (n.) 消费，消耗量 —— the average daily consumption of ... （课件）
collocations.translation: 【课件】……的平均每日消费量／消耗量（consumption 用不可数）
collocations.example: the average daily consumption of fruit and vegetables 水果和蔬菜的平均每日消费量（课件·Extended·派生名词）

collocations.phrase: consumer (n.) 消费者，顾客 / consumerism (n.) 消费主义 （课件）
collocations.translation: 【课件】派生词：consumer 消费者；consumerism 消费主义
collocations.example: Modern technology has impacted consumerism dramatically. 现代科技极大地影响了消费主义。（课件·Extended·派生词）
Data centres consume vast amounts of electricity around the clock. 数据中心昼夜消耗大量电力。
Copying the report by hand was slow and time-consuming. 手抄这份报告又慢又耗时。

collocations.phrase: consume large quantities of food / drink
collocations.example: Athletes consume large quantities of protein during training. 运动员训练期间摄入大量蛋白质。

collocations.translation: 被（愧疚、好奇等强烈情感）吞噬
collocations.example: He was consumed with guilt after telling the lie. 撒谎后他被愧疚吞噬。
Air conditioners consume an enormous amount of energy in summer, so setting the temperature just one degree higher can spare the grid a heavy burden. （应用文·节能倡议）
Preparing the charity gala consumed weeks of our spare time, yet not a single volunteer complained, for the joy on the orphans' faces made every lost hour worthwhile. （读后续写·志愿服务·付出与回报）
Within minutes the wooden barn was consumed by fire, and the family could only watch, arms around one another, as their livelihood turned to smoke. （读后续写·灾难·无力挽回）
Doctors warn that the sugary drinks teenagers consume in such quantities are quietly undermining their health, one sweet sip at a time. （议论文·青少年健康）

collocations.phrase: be consumed with guilt / grief / anger
collocations.translation: 被愧疚／悲伤／愤怒所吞噬
collocations.example: Consumed with grief, the old man visited the same bench every dusk, whispering to a wife who would never answer again. （读后续写·丧亲之痛）
The report reveals that the fashion industry consumes vast quantities of water, a hidden cost few shoppers ever pause to consider. （议论文·可持续消费）
Though hand-copying the manuscript proved painfully time-consuming, the monk regarded each stroke as an act of devotion rather than a chore. （读后续写·匠心·虔诚）
During the festival, families consume large quantities of sticky rice dumplings, each parcel wrapped with a story handed down through generations. （应用文·文化介绍）

synonyms.example: The famished travellers devoured the simple meal in seconds, and the innkeeper smiled, knowing that hunger had made his humble stew taste like gold. （读后续写·饥饿·感激）
synonyms.usage: 语气更强，强调贪婪、迅速地吃光或吞没；也可比喻被情感或火焰吞没，画面感强于 consume

synonyms.example: By noon the hikers had used up their last drop of water, and the sun beat down mercilessly on the endless dunes ahead. （读后续写·绝境）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，侧重把资源全部用光；consume 更正式，可指持续性的消耗过程

synonyms.example: Overfishing has severely depleted the region's once-abundant marine stocks, threatening a way of life that has endured for centuries. （议论文·生态危机）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面语，特指使储备／资源逐渐减少至危险水平，常用于生态、经济语境

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·as 引导状语从句（时间/原因/让步倒装/方式/比较）
advancedExpressions.expression: as 引导五类状语从句：① 时间“正当……时”(as 后跟持续性动词可换 while/when，非持续性动词换 when) ② 原因“因为，由于” ③ 让步“尽管”(从句多用倒装 Happy as they were) ④ 方式“按……方式”(Do as I say) ⑤ 比较“正如，和……一样”(as ... as 结构，从句常省略)
advancedExpressions.example: ① As I finished my first helping, my host told me more about the dish.（时间：正当……时，课文原句）② As you were out, I left a message.（原因）③ Happy as they were, there was something missing.（让步倒装）④ Do as I say!（方式）⑤ It's not as hard as I thought.（比较）（课件·Extended·as 五类状语从句总归纳，挂 consume 记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·as 词性词义辨析（课件原题·指出下列各句中 as 的词性和词义）
advancedExpressions.expression: 同一 as 在不同从句中词性/词义不同：conj. 正如 / conj. 当……的时候 / adv.如同 + conj.像……一样(as...as) / conj. 因为 / conj. 尽管 / conj. 随着
advancedExpressions.example: 1) She lost it, just as I said she would.（conj. 正如）2) As I was a child, I was interested in singing.（conj. 当……的时候）3) He doesn't earn as much as I do.（第一个 as 为 adv.如同；第二个 as 为 conj.像……一样）4) As he was ill, he stayed home for a good rest.（conj. 因为，由于）5) Young as she was, she was equal to the task.（conj. 尽管，虽然·倒装）6) As it grew darker it became colder.（conj. 随着）（课件·Extended·as 词性词义原题）

advancedExpressions.expression: consume energy/fuel/resources 消耗 | consume food/drink 吃喝 | time-consuming 耗时的 | be consumed with/by 被情感吞噬
advancedExpressions.example: This machine consumes less fuel yet the redesign was extremely time-consuming. 这台机器更省油，但重新设计极为耗时。（把'消耗'与派生形容词一并记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: consume(消耗)→consumption / assume(假定) / presume(推定) / resume(重新开始)：同源词根 -sume(取)
advancedExpressions.example: We consume, we assume, we resume — 记住这组 -sume 词根有助于扩大词汇。（词根联想记忆法）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. be consumed by an emotion so overwhelming that ...
advancedExpressions.example: He was consumed by a longing so overwhelming that even the bustling street around him seemed to dissolve into silence. （被动+程度状语从句，将抽象情感具象为吞噬感）

advancedExpressions.expression: reflect on how much ... we consume, and take steps to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us reflect on how much water we thoughtlessly consume, and take small yet steadfast steps to protect this precious resource. （反思+呼吁的经典倡议句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: at the rate we are consuming ..., it is only a matter of time before ...
advancedExpressions.example: At the rate we are consuming fossil fuels, it is only a matter of time before the earth exacts a heavy price for our shortsightedness. （速率+必然后果，警示性论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was very sad and could not think of anything else.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Consumed by a sorrow he could neither name nor escape, he drifted through the days like a leaf on dark water, every thought bending back, inevitably, towards the loss he could not undo. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语 Consumed by... 作状语开头，情感前置 + 比喻(a leaf on dark water) + every thought bending back 具象化萦绕不去的思绪

sentenceUpgrade.original: We use too much energy and should save it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Given the alarming rate at which our society consumes energy, it is imperative that each of us cultivate the habit of conservation before our reckless appetite drains the very resources on which our future depends. （议论文·呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Given...介词短语铺陈背景 + it is imperative that + 虚拟语气 + before引导后果状语从句，层层递进强化紧迫感

classPractice.type: 【语境应用】指出下列各句中 as 的词性和词义（课件原题·挂 consume 记 as 从句）
classPractice.question: 1) She lost it, just as I said she would. 2) As I was a child, I was interested in singing. 3) He doesn't earn as much as I do. 4) As he was ill, he stayed home for a good rest. 5) Young as she was, she was equal to the task. 6) As it grew darker it became colder.
classPractice.answer: 1) conj. 正如 2) conj. 当……的时候 3) 第一个 as 为 adv. 如同；第二个 as 为 conj. 像……一样 4) conj. 因为，由于 5) conj. 尽管，虽然（倒装）6) conj. 随着
classPractice.note: 课件Extended原题；as 一词多义，需按从句类型判断词性词义——正如/时间/比较as...as/原因/让步倒装/随着

classPractice.question: It is estimated that tens of thousands of ducks are ____ (consume) every day in Nanjing.
classPractice.note: 课文原句变式；ducks 与 consume 为被动关系，故用一般现在时被动 are consumed

classPractice.question: Reducing energy ____ (consume) has become a top priority for the whole city.
classPractice.note: 冠词/形容词后需名词；consume 的名词是 consumption（注意拼写为 -sumption）

classPractice.question: 手抄整份手稿是一项极其耗时的工作。Copying the whole manuscript by hand was an extremely ____ task.
classPractice.note: 合成形容词 time-consuming 作定语，意为'耗时的'

original_sentence: It definitely hit the spot when I tried it, and it has become one of my personal favourites.
readingExamples: It definitely hit the spot when I tried it, and it has become one of my personal favourites.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. (of food or drink) to be exactly what is wanted and therefore very satisfying
(2) phr. (informal) to be exactly right for a particular situation or need; to do exactly what is required

posExamples.sentence: After hours of trudging through the biting wind, the steaming bowl of noodles his grandmother set before him truly hit the spot, and warmth spread through his frozen fingers as gratitude welled up in his chest. （读后续写·归家·温暖治愈）

On behalf of the whole class, I want to say that the ice-cold lemonade you prepared for us after the sports meet really hit the spot — nothing could have refreshed us more on such a scorching afternoon. （应用文·感谢信）
A good film need not dazzle with special effects; sometimes a simple, honest story hits the spot precisely because it speaks to the quiet longings we all carry within. （议论文·艺术评论）

The old cook wiped his hands on his apron and grinned as the customer sighed with delight — after forty years behind the stove, he could still make a dish that hit the spot every single time. （读后续写·匠人·满足）

wordForms.other: 习语，动词 hit 为不规则变化：hit - hit - hit（三态同形），故过去式仍写 hit the spot

collocations.translation: 真是恰到好处，正合口味／正是所需
collocations.example: After the long hike, a hot bowl of noodles really hit the spot. 长途徒步后，一碗热面正合口味。
It definitely hit the spot when I tried it, and it has become one of my personal favourites. 我一尝就觉得正合口味，它已成了我个人最爱之一。（课文原句·comfort food）

collocations.translation: 真是恰到好处，特别解馋／解渴
collocations.example: After the long climb, that cup of hot cocoa really hit the spot, chasing away the mountain chill in a single, comforting sip. （读后续写·登山·慰藉）
Her encouraging words just hit the spot at the moment I was about to give up, and something inside me quietly rekindled. （读后续写·鼓励·重燃斗志）

collocations.phrase: hit the spot on a hot / cold day
collocations.translation: 在炎热／寒冷天气里正合需要
collocations.example: A tall glass of iced tea hits the spot on a sweltering summer day, when even the cicadas seem too weary to sing. （读后续写·夏日·环境描写）

synonyms.example: A few days of rest by the quiet lake were just what she needed to mend a heart worn thin by months of striving. （读后续写·疗愈）
synonyms.usage: 更中性、正式，可用于任何需求；hit the spot 更口语、生动，尤指饮食或即时的满足感

synonyms.example: When the engine refused to start, a gentle tap in just the right place did the trick, and the old truck rumbled back to life. （读后续写·机智解决）
synonyms.usage: 口语，侧重成功解决了某个问题或达到目的；hit the spot 侧重带来满足感，尤其身心的舒适

synonyms.example: Nothing could satisfy the weary soldiers more than the sight of home glimmering on the horizon. （读后续写·归乡）
synonyms.usage: 正式、通用动词；hit the spot 是习语，画面感和口语色彩更浓

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「正合心意/令人满足」
advancedExpressions.expression: hit the spot（口语·尤指饮食）| be just what sb. needs（中性）| do the trick（奏效）| really satisfy sb.
advancedExpressions.example: That warm soup really hit the spot — it was just what I needed on such a cold night. 那碗热汤正合口味——正是这寒夜里我所需要的。（口语习语与正式表达配套记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·hit 的不规则变化
advancedExpressions.expression: hit - hit - hit（原形/过去式/过去分词同形），故过去时也写 hit the spot
advancedExpressions.example: The cold lemonade hit the spot yesterday. 昨天那杯冰柠檬水正解渴。（hit 过去式不加 -ed，易考）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., and it hit the spot in a way that ... could never quite ...
advancedExpressions.example: The rough peasant bread hit the spot in a way that the finest pastries of the city never quite could. （对比结构，突出朴素之物的独特慰藉）

advancedExpressions.expression: your ... really hit the spot, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Your thoughtful care package really hit the spot, for it arrived on the very day homesickness weighed heaviest on my heart. （感谢信中融入情境，具体而真诚）

advancedExpressions.expression: sometimes it is the simplest ... that hits the spot
advancedExpressions.example: In an age obsessed with the grand and the dazzling, sometimes it is the simplest kindness that hits the spot and lingers longest in memory. （以小见大，点明朴素之力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The soup was very good and I was satisfied.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The soup hit the spot the instant it touched my lips — rich, fragrant and impossibly comforting, it seemed to melt away not only the cold in my bones but the loneliness in my chest. （读后续写·感官+情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 习语 hit the spot 替代平淡的 good + the instant 引导时间状语从句 + 三个并列形容词铺陈感官 + 从身体到情感的递进(cold in my bones → loneliness in my chest)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The advice was helpful at the right time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Coming when my resolve hung by a thread, his quiet words of faith hit the spot, and I found the courage to take one more step where moments before I had seen only defeat. （读后续写·转折）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Coming when...现在分词短语作时间状语铺垫情境 + 习语 hit the spot 精准点题 + where 引导对比从句，凸显心境的逆转

classPractice.question: 我一尝这道菜，就觉得它正合我的口味。When I tried the dish, it definitely ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；hit the spot 表'正合口味/使人满意'，此处叙述过去，hit 不变形

classPractice.question: After the exhausting match, an ice-cold drink really ____ (hit the spot / took the place)。
classPractice.note: hit the spot 正合需要/解渴；take the place 取代，语境不符

classPractice.question: 在这么冷的天里，一碗热汤正是我所需要的。
classPractice.answer: On such a cold day, a bowl of hot soup really hit the spot. / ...was just what I needed.
classPractice.note: 可用习语 hit the spot 或 be just what sb. needs 表达'正合需要'

translation: adj. 广东人（或文化）的，粤语的 | n. (pl. Cantonese) 广东人；粤语
original_sentence: The Cantonese do not hurry over their breakfasts, as I found when I visited a restaurant in Guangzhou’s old city centre this morning.
readingExamples: The Cantonese do not hurry over their breakfasts, as I found when I visited a restaurant in Guangzhou’s old city centre this morning.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to Guangdong (Canton) province in southern China, its people, culture, or the language spoken there
(2) n. (uncountable) the variety of Chinese spoken chiefly in Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao
(3) n. (plural: Cantonese) a person from Guangdong province

posExamples.sentence: As the old grandmother chattered away in rapid Cantonese, the boy — raised far from his ancestral home — caught only fragments, yet in her lively tones he felt the pulse of a heritage he had almost forgotten. （读后续写·寻根·文化认同）

I would warmly recommend our city's Cantonese restaurant to any overseas visitor, for its steaming baskets of dim sum offer not merely a meal but a genuine taste of southern Chinese hospitality. （应用文·推荐信）

Cantonese cuisine, with its emphasis on freshness and subtle seasoning, illustrates a broader truth: that true culinary artistry lies not in disguising ingredients but in revealing their natural essence. （议论文·饮食文化）

The Cantonese, unhurried and warm-hearted, lingered over their morning tea, turning a simple breakfast into a leisurely ritual that outsiders often found both puzzling and enchanting. （读后续写·地方风情·生活方式）

wordForms.noun: Cantonese (广东人／粤语，单复数同形) / Canton (广州/广东旧称)
wordForms.other: 构词法·地名/民族形容词后缀：Canton→Cantonese(粤); China→Chinese; Japan→Japanese; Portugal→Portuguese。此类词形容词与名词同形，且单复数同形（one Cantonese / two Cantonese）。'the + 形容词化的国民名'表整体（the Cantonese 广东人）时谓语用复数。首字母须大写。

collocations.example: The waiters greeted every guest warmly in Cantonese. 服务员用粤语热情地招呼每位客人。
Cantonese cuisine is famous for its fresh ingredients and light flavours. 粤菜以食材新鲜、口味清淡闻名。

collocations.translation: 广东人（总称，谓语用复数）
collocations.example: The Cantonese do not hurry over their breakfasts, as I found when I visited a restaurant in Guangzhou's old city centre this morning. 广东人吃早餐从不匆忙，今早我到广州老城区一家餐馆时便发现了这一点。（课文原句）
Though she could speak Cantonese fluently, she deliberately slowed her words so that her northern friend might follow the melody of each rising and falling tone. （读后续写·体贴·文化交流）
A tray of Cantonese dim sum arrived, each translucent dumpling folded so exquisitely that it seemed a pity to disturb such quiet craftsmanship. （读后续写·美食·工艺之美）
The old theatre came alive with Cantonese opera, and the shimmering costumes and soaring voices transported the audience into a world of ancient heroes and forbidden love. （读后续写·传统艺术·沉浸）
The Cantonese are famous for their entrepreneurial spirit, venturing far from home yet never severing the ties that bind them to their roots. （议论文·地域文化）
He sang the lullaby in Cantonese, and though I understood not a single word, the tenderness in his voice needed no translation. （读后续写·跨越语言的情感）

synonyms.example: In the crowded Guangzhou market, Mandarin and Cantonese wove together into a lively tapestry of sound that captured the diversity of modern China. （读后续写·市井·文化交融）
synonyms.usage: 指以北京语音为标准的现代标准汉语（普通话）；Cantonese 是粤方言，与之在语音、词汇上差异显著

synonyms.example: Every region cherishes its own dialect, a living archive in which the memories and wisdom of generations quietly reside. （议论文·语言与文化）
synonyms.usage: 泛指方言，是上位概念；Cantonese 是粤方言这一具体的方言

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the + 国民名表整体
advancedExpressions.expression: the Cantonese / the Chinese / the Japanese 作主语指'……人（总称）'，谓语用复数
advancedExpressions.example: The Cantonese are known for their love of morning tea. 广东人以爱喝早茶闻名。（此类 -ese 结尾国民名单复数同形，需大写）

advancedExpressions.expression: Cantonese cuisine 粤菜 | Cantonese opera 粤剧 | Cantonese dim sum 广式点心 | speak/in Cantonese 说/用粤语
advancedExpressions.example: From Cantonese cuisine to Cantonese opera, the province's culture delights visitors from afar. 从粤菜到粤剧，这个省的文化让远道而来的游客欣喜。（美食主题成组积累）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the lively cadence of Cantonese, sb. sensed / felt ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the lively cadence of Cantonese drifting from the tea house, she sensed a warmth that no map or guidebook could ever chart. （以语言的韵律唤起文化归属感）

advancedExpressions.expression: to truly appreciate ..., one must experience Cantonese ...
advancedExpressions.example: To truly appreciate the soul of southern China, one must experience Cantonese tea culture first-hand, where every unhurried sip tells a story. （推荐信中引导对方亲身体验）

advancedExpressions.expression: the survival of Cantonese ... reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The vibrant survival of Cantonese opera in a fast-changing world reminds us that tradition endures not by resisting change, but by touching the timeless chords of human feeling. （以具体文化现象引出普遍道理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The people from Guangdong ate breakfast slowly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The Cantonese, in no haste whatsoever, savoured their morning tea one leisurely sip at a time, transforming what elsewhere was a rushed necessity into an unhurried celebration of the day's quiet beginning. （读后续写·风俗描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the Cantonese 作总称主语 + in no haste whatsoever 插入语强化悠闲 + transforming...into...现在分词短语点明习俗背后的生活哲学，形成对比

sentenceUpgrade.original: Cantonese food is fresh and tasty, so I recommend it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is with genuine enthusiasm that I recommend Cantonese cuisine, whose insistence on freshness and delicate seasoning offers not merely a satisfying meal but an authentic window into the refined food culture of southern China. （应用文·推荐信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is with...that 强调句开头显真诚 + whose 引导非限制性定语从句 + not merely...but...递进结构，把美食升华为文化体验

classPractice.answer: Although she could speak Cantonese fluently, she deliberately slowed down.

original_sentence: So, how to reveal this hidden dimension?
readingExamples: So, how to reveal this hidden dimension?
definitionEn:
(1) n. (uncountable) a Chinese dish, associated especially with Cantonese cuisine, consisting of a variety of small savoury or sweet items such as steamed dumplings, buns and rolls, traditionally served in bamboo baskets with tea
(2) n. the meal or dining occasion at which such small dishes are eaten, usually as a leisurely brunch

posExamples.sentence: The moment the bamboo baskets of dim sum were lifted from the steamer, fragrant clouds rose into the air, and the grandmother smiled to see three generations gathered, at last, around one crowded table. （读后续写·团圆·亲情）

I would like to invite all exchange students to a dim sum brunch this Saturday, where you can taste dozens of delicate delicacies and experience the unhurried warmth of Cantonese dining culture. （应用文·邀请函）

Dim sum is more than a meal; it is a social ritual in which conversation flows as freely as the tea, reminding us that food, at its best, nourishes not only the body but the bonds between us. （议论文·饮食与人情）

For the homesick student abroad, a single plate of dim sum in a corner restaurant was enough to summon a flood of memories — Sunday mornings, clinking teapots, and the laughter of a family now oceans away. （读后续写·思乡·味觉记忆）

wordForms.other: 拼写与用法·dim sum 为源自粤语的外来专有名词，通常小写、不可数，无复数形式（不作 dim sums）；数量用 a basket/plate/piece of dim sum 表示。近似的英语饮食外来词：sushi 寿司、tofu 豆腐、wonton 云吞。

collocations.example: On Sundays the whole family gathers to have dim sum together. 周日全家人聚在一起吃点心。
The waiter set a steaming basket of dim sum on the table. 服务员把一笼热气腾腾的点心放到桌上。

collocations.phrase: dim sum and tea（一盅两件）
collocations.example: Over dim sum and tea, the old friends chatted the whole morning away. 就着点心和茶，老友们聊了整个上午。
The old dim sum house, with its clatter of trolleys and hum of morning gossip, had faithfully served the neighbourhood for over half a century. （读后续写·老字号·岁月）
Making traditional dim sum by hand demands patience and skill, for each fold and pleat is the fruit of years of quiet apprenticeship. （议论文·匠人精神）

synonyms.example: She packed a few homemade snacks for the journey, small tokens of love tucked between the folds of her son's luggage. （读后续写·母爱）
synonyms.usage: 泛指两餐之间吃的小食，范围很广；dim sum 特指粤式点心这一具体品类，含浓厚文化色彩

synonyms.example: The banquet overflowed with delicacies from every province, yet the emperor reached first for a humble bowl of rice porridge. （读后续写·返璞归真）
synonyms.usage: 指精致或珍贵的美食，强调其美味珍稀；dim sum 是具体的点心种类，可以是 delicacy 的一种

advancedExpressions.expression: have/eat dim sum 吃点心 | a basket of dim sum 一笼点心 | dim sum and tea 一盅两件 | dim sum house 茶楼
advancedExpressions.example: We had dim sum and tea at a traditional dim sum house downtown. 我们在市中心一家老茶楼吃点心、喝茶。（美食主题成组记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: the taste of dim sum brought back / summoned ...
advancedExpressions.example: The taste of dim sum summoned a rush of childhood mornings, when the world was small, safe and forever smelling of steamed buns. （以味觉触发回忆，唤起温情）

advancedExpressions.expression: come and share dim sum with us, and you will discover ...
advancedExpressions.example: Come and share dim sum with us this weekend, and you will discover that a shared table is the shortest bridge between two cultures. （邀请信中以美食搭起文化桥梁）

advancedExpressions.expression: dim sum is not merely ... but a symbol of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Dim sum is not merely a collection of tiny dishes but a symbol of togetherness, where the leisurely act of sharing food weaves strangers into friends and families into one. （由具体食物升华至人情象征）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We ate dim sum together and were happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Around the steamer's rising warmth we shared basket after basket of dim sum, and amid the clink of teacups and the ripple of easy laughter, I understood at last that happiness needs no grand occasion — only a full table and the people you love. （读后续写·团圆·感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境细节开头(steamer's rising warmth) + amid 引导氛围铺陈(clink of teacups, ripple of laughter) + I understood at last that... 心理升华 + 破折号点题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Dim sum is a traditional food that many people like.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far more than a beloved traditional food, dim sum embodies a philosophy of dining in which time slows, conversation deepens, and the simple sharing of small dishes becomes a quiet celebration of human connection. （议论文·文化阐释）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far more than...倒装开头提升气势 + embodies a philosophy 抽象升华 + in which 引导定语从句 + 三个并列短句(time slows, conversation deepens, sharing becomes)排比收束

classPractice.note: have dim sum 吃点心（饮茶），最地道搭配；此处指'享用'而非'制作'

classPractice.answer: Dim sum is not merely a meal but a symbol of togetherness / reunion.

translation: 必不可少的；本质的，基本的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. completely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation or for a particular activity
(2) adj. connected with the most important or basic quality or nature of something; fundamental
(3) n. (usually plural) something that is absolutely necessary and cannot be done without

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用复数 essentials）必需品，要素，要领
uncommonMeanings.example: The travel checklist covered all the essentials: passport, tickets and medicine. 这份旅行清单涵盖了所有要素：护照、票和药品。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 本质的，实质的，根本的（＝fundamental）
uncommonMeanings.example: There is no essential difference between the two plans. 这两个方案没有本质区别。

posExamples.sentence: As the storm raged and the power failed, the old lighthouse keeper realised that the flickering lamp was not merely useful but absolutely essential — the single thread of hope on which the sailors' lives now hung. （读后续写·危难·关键时刻）
In my view, cultivating a habit of daily reading is essential for every student, for it not only broadens the mind but also lays the firm foundation upon which lifelong learning is built. （应用文·建议信）
It is essential to recognise that genuine progress springs not from technology alone but from the wisdom and restraint with which humanity chooses to wield it. （议论文·科技与人文）
Patience, she came to understand, was the essential quality that separated the master craftsman from the eager amateur — a virtue no shortcut could ever replace. （读后续写·成长·品格领悟）

wordForms.noun: essence (本质，精髓；不可数) / essentials (必需品，要素；复数)
wordForms.other: 构词法·essence(n.本质)→essential(adj.必不可少的/本质的)→essentially(adv.本质上)→essentials(n.复数,必需品)。essential 后接介词多为 to / for（be essential to/for sth）。

collocations.example: Regular exercise is essential to good health. 规律锻炼对健康至关重要。

collocations.phrase: it is essential that sb. (should) do sth
collocations.translation: 至关重要的是……（从句用虚拟语气）
collocations.example: It is essential that every student (should) be treated fairly. 至关重要的是每个学生都要被公平对待。
She packed only the bare essentials for the trip. 她这趟只带了最基本的必需品。

collocations.phrase: it is essential (for sb.) to do sth
collocations.example: In an emergency, it is essential to remain calm, for a clear head can often accomplish what panic never could. （应用文·安全须知）

collocations.translation: 必不可少的一部分／要素
collocations.example: Failure, far from being shameful, is an essential ingredient of success, seasoning our triumphs with the depth that only struggle can provide. （议论文·成败观）
Water, so ordinary that we scarcely notice it, is essential to survival, and the traveller lost in the desert learns this truth with a desperation the rest of us are spared. （读后续写·绝境·顿悟）
Having lost his home to the flood, the farmer clung to the bare essentials — a photograph, a blanket, and an unbroken determination to rebuild. （读后续写·灾后·坚韧）
Communication and teamwork are essential skills that no textbook alone can teach, for they are forged only in the crucible of real cooperation. （议论文·能力培养）

synonyms.translation: 至关重要的，性命攸关的
synonyms.example: The doctor's swift decision proved vital, and by dawn the fever had broken, drawing the child back from the very edge of danger. （读后续写·生死·抢救）
synonyms.usage: 语气强烈，常含生死攸关之意，比 essential 更具紧迫感和情感张力；句法多作表语 be vital to/for，或作前置定语（a vital role）。

synonyms.example: This crucial moment would determine everything: one word, spoken or withheld, could either mend the rift or widen it forever. （读后续写·抉择·转折）
synonyms.usage: 侧重在关键节点上起决定性作用，常用于转折、抉择的语境；essential 侧重必不可少。常作定语（a crucial factor）或 be crucial to/for。

synonyms.example: Over the years the quiet gardener had become indispensable to the estate, though few ever paused to thank the hands that kept its beauty alive. （读后续写·默默奉献）
synonyms.usage: 强调无可替代、离开则不行，语气比 essential 更绝对，多用于人或事物的不可替代性；常搭配 be indispensable to sb./sth。

advancedExpressions.expression: be essential to/for sth 对……必不可少 | it is essential (for sb.) to do | it is essential that sb. (should) do（虚拟）| the bare essentials 基本必需品
advancedExpressions.example: It is essential that we (should) act now, for clean water is essential to every living thing. 我们必须现在就行动，因为清洁的水对一切生物都必不可少。（表语搭配+虚拟从句一并掌握）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·essential 引导的虚拟语气
advancedExpressions.expression: It is essential / important / necessary that + sb. + (should) + 动词原形
advancedExpressions.example: It is essential that every volunteer (should) arrive on time. 至关重要的是每位志愿者都要准时到达。（表'重要/必要'的形容词从句用 should+动原，should 可省）

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. grasp what was truly essential
advancedExpressions.example: Stripped of everything he owned, only then did he grasp what was truly essential — not the possessions he had lost, but the people who had never left his side. （倒装+对比，续写结尾的价值观升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is essential that we ..., otherwise ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is essential that we act now to protect our shared heritage, otherwise these ancient streets may vanish before the next generation ever knows their worth. （虚拟语气+否则从句，加重呼吁的分量）

advancedExpressions.expression: what is essential is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What is essential is not how many times we fall, but the quiet resolve with which we rise each time to try again. （对比句式，凸显本质所在）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It is very important to stay calm in an emergency.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In moments of crisis, remaining calm is not merely helpful but absolutely essential, for a steady mind can navigate through chaos where panic would only steer us onto the rocks. （议论文·危机应对）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not merely...but absolutely essential 递进强调 + for 引导原因从句 + navigate/steer onto the rocks 航海隐喻，使抽象道理具象生动

sentenceUpgrade.original: She finally understood what really mattered.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the last of her worldly comforts slipped away, she finally understood what was truly essential in life — and it was nothing that money could buy, nor misfortune could take. （读后续写·失去中的领悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 引导背景状语从句烘托情境 + what was truly essential 名词性从句点题 + nothing that...nor... 双重否定并列，收束有力

classPractice.question: Mutual trust is essential ____ any lasting friendship.
classPractice.note: be essential to/for sth 对……必不可少；两个介词均可

classPractice.question: It is essential that every volunteer ____ (arrive) on time so that the event can begin smoothly.
classPractice.note: essential 表'重要/必要'，that 从句谓语用 (should+)动词原形虚拟语气

classPractice.question: Before the trip she packed only the bare ____ (essential): a torch, some water and a map.
classPractice.note: the bare essentials 最基本的必需品；此处 essential 作名词，用复数 essentials

translation: 创造，创新；新思想，新方法
definitionEn:
(1) n. (uncountable) the introduction of new ideas, methods, or ways of doing things; the act of innovating
(2) n. (countable) a new idea, method, product, or invention
(3) n. the ability to think creatively and produce original solutions

posExamples.sentence: In the dusty corner of his workshop, the young inventor tinkered late into the night, driven by a restless spirit of innovation that refused to accept 'impossible' as an answer. （读后续写·发明·执着追梦）

I strongly recommend that our school establish a science club to encourage innovation, for a space where students dare to experiment and fail is precisely where tomorrow's inventors are born. （应用文·建议信）
History teaches us that innovation, though often met with doubt in its infancy, is the very engine that propels civilisation forward from one age to the next. （议论文·创新与进步）
When the old master saw the apprentice's bold innovation transform a centuries-old craft, his frown slowly melted into a smile — tradition, he realised, need not fear renewal. （读后续写·传承与革新）

wordForms.noun: innovation (创新，新方法) / innovator (创新者)
wordForms.other: 构词法·innovate(v.)→innovation(n.创新)→innovative(adj.创新的)→innovator(n.创新者)。词根 nov- ＝ new（新）：novel(新颖的)、novelty(新奇)、renovate(翻新)、innovate(创新)。

collocations.example: Technological innovation has transformed the way we live and work. 科技创新改变了我们的生活与工作方式。
A good school fosters innovation by rewarding curiosity. 好学校通过奖励好奇心来培养创新。
It was their fearless spirit of innovation that carried them past failure. 正是无畏的创新精神带他们越过失败。
A wave of innovation swept through the sleepy town when the returning graduate opened its first digital workshop, breathing fresh life into weary old trades. （读后续写·乡村振兴）
Healthy competition can drive innovation, spurring rivals to reach for heights that comfort alone would never inspire them to attempt. （议论文·竞争的价值）
The exhibition celebrated innovation and creativity, showcasing how young minds could turn discarded materials into works of striking imagination. （应用文·活动报道）
The vaccine was a groundbreaking innovation that turned the tide against a disease which had haunted humanity for generations. （议论文·科学成就）
Those who embrace innovation rather than cling to old certainties are the ones who shape the future instead of merely watching it unfold. （议论文·变革态度）

synonyms.example: The printing press was an invention so profound that it placed knowledge, once the treasure of a privileged few, into the hands of ordinary people. （议论文·发明的意义）
synonyms.usage: 侧重创造出的具体新事物（发明品）；innovation 更强调革新的过程或理念，可以是对已有事物的改进

synonyms.example: Her boundless creativity turned an empty stage and a single spotlight into an entire universe of wonder. （读后续写·艺术·想象力）
synonyms.usage: 指产生新颖想法的能力或品质（内在特质）；innovation 侧重把创意付诸实践、带来实际变革

synonyms.example: The bold reform swept away outdated regulations and opened the door to an era of unprecedented opportunity. （议论文·社会变革）
synonyms.usage: 多指对制度、体系的改革（尤指社会、政治层面）；innovation 更偏技术、方法、产品的创新

advancedExpressions.expression: technological innovation 科技创新 | foster/drive/stimulate innovation 培养/推动/激发创新 | a spirit of innovation 创新精神 | embrace innovation 拥抱创新
advancedExpressions.example: To drive technological innovation, we must first foster a spirit of innovation among the young. 要推动科技创新，我们须先在年轻人中培养创新精神。（动名词搭配成组积累）

advancedExpressions.expression: innovate(v.)—innovation(n.)—innovative(adj.)—innovator(n.)：一动一名一形一人

definitionEn:

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (产品/设计的) 初步构想，样品概念

posExamples.sentence: For years the idea of forgiveness had been an abstract concept to him, until the night his estranged father knocked on the door, trembling and grey, and something inside his chest quietly gave way. （读后续写·亲情和解·情感转变）

I am writing to introduce a brand-new concept for our school's charity fair, one that combines traditional handicrafts with digital fundraising so that every stall can reach donors far beyond the campus gates. （应用文·倡议信·活动方案）

The concept that hard work alone guarantees success is, in my view, dangerously incomplete, for it quietly ignores the roles that opportunity, guidance and sheer chance play in shaping any achievement. （议论文·成功与努力·观点辨析）

wordForms.noun: concept (概念) / conception (概念，构想，理解)

collocations.example: Many children find the concept of time hard to grasp. 许多孩子觉得时间这个概念难以理解。
Only with a diagram did the students finally grasp the concept. 直到有了示意图，学生们才终于理解了这个概念。

Respect for others is a fundamental concept that should be instilled in children long before they memorize a single formula. （议论文·品德教育·观点句）
Justice remained an abstract concept to me until I watched a stranger return a lost wallet, refusing even a word of thanks. （读后续写·陌生善意·主题升华）
The professor introduced a bold new concept that challenged everything the class had assumed about memory and learning. （议论文·学术创新·论证）
Once volunteers grasped the concept behind the recycling drive, they threw themselves into it with surprising enthusiasm. （应用文·环保活动·感悟）
It is one thing to praise the concept of teamwork on paper, and quite another to put it into practice when personal glory is at stake. （议论文·团队合作·对比论证）

synonyms.example: The romantic notion that talent needs no discipline collapsed the moment she watched the champion train before dawn, day after silent day. （读后续写·励志成长·认知颠覆）

advancedExpressions.expression: the concept of sth ……的概念 | grasp/master a concept 掌握概念 | have no concept of 毫无概念 | put a concept into practice 将理念付诸实践
advancedExpressions.example: It is one thing to grasp the concept of fairness, and quite another to put it into practice. 理解公平这个概念是一回事，将其付诸实践又是另一回事。（名词短语成组积累）

advancedExpressions.expression: conceive(v.)—concept/conception(n.)—conceptual(adj.)：由动词到名词到形容词

advancedExpressions.expression: what had once been a mere concept now became ...

advancedExpressions.expression: the concept behind ... is simple yet powerful: ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: She finally understood the concept.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: click into place 动态动词 + with the astonishment of... 状语补足心理 + locked door/key 隐喻具象化抽象顿悟

original_sentence: The concept took off, and today Guangzhou’s restaurants stimulate customers’ appetite with over a thousand offerings, each more delicate and delicious than the last.
readingExamples: The concept took off, and today Guangzhou’s restaurants stimulate customers’ appetite with over a thousand offerings, each more delicate and delicious than the last.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to encourage or excite something so that it becomes more active or develops faster
(2) vt. to make someone feel enthusiastic and eager to do something, especially by giving them new interest or energy
(3) vt. to cause a physical reaction or activity in the body or a living thing

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (经济上) 刺激，拉动 (需求、增长)
uncommonMeanings.example: The government cut taxes in a bid to stimulate spending, and within months the sleepy little town's shops were once again busy with weekend crowds. （读后续写·经济复苏·小镇复兴场景）

posExamples.sentence: The old craftsman's stories, told by the flickering firelight, stimulated in the boy a curiosity so fierce that he could hardly wait for dawn to try the wheel himself. （读后续写·师徒传承·激发兴趣）
I firmly believe that setting up a debating club would greatly stimulate students' interest in current affairs and sharpen their ability to think on their feet. （应用文·建议信·活动倡议）
Reading widely does more than fill idle hours; it stimulates the imagination, broadens the mind, and quietly nurtures the empathy on which a civilized society depends. （议论文·阅读的价值·排比论证）
Bright colours and open-ended toys stimulate a child's brain far more effectively than any screen, awakening a natural hunger to explore, build and imagine. （议论文·儿童教育·对比论证）

wordForms.noun: stimulation (刺激，激励；不可数) / stimulus (刺激物，激励因素；复数 stimuli)
wordForms.adjective: stimulating (令人振奋的，启发思维的) / stimulative (起刺激作用的)
wordForms.other: 构词法·stimulate(v.)→stimulation(n.)→stimulating(adj.)→stimulus(n.,复数stimuli)。注意可数名词 stimulus 的不规则复数为 stimuli（拉丁词尾 -us→-i，如 focus→foci）。stimulating 表'令人振奋/启迪思维的'（a stimulating discussion）。

collocations.phrase: stimulate one's appetite / interest / imagination / innovation / thinking【课件】
collocations.translation: 激发食欲／兴趣／想象力／创新／思维【课件】
collocations.example: Her interest in art was stimulated by her father. 她对艺术的兴趣是被父亲激发的。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: stimulate economic growth / production / consumption / development【课件】
collocations.translation: 刺激经济增长／生产／消费／发展【课件】
collocations.example: This new plan is to stimulate economic growth. 这个新计划旨在刺激经济增长。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: stimulate sb to do sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 激励某人去做某事【课件】
collocations.example: The conference stimulated him to study the subject in more depth. 这次会议激励他更深入地研究这门学科。（课件例句）

The concept took off, and today Guangzhou's restaurants stimulate customers' appetite with over a thousand offerings, each more delicate and delicious than the last. 这一理念大受欢迎，如今广州的餐馆以逾千种菜品刺激顾客的食欲，一道比一道精致美味。（课文原句）
A good question can stimulate students' interest in a subject. 一个好问题能激发学生对某学科的兴趣。
The government cut taxes to stimulate the economy. 政府减税以刺激经济。
Her praise stimulated him to work even harder. 她的赞扬激励他更加努力。
Unlike ready-made cartoons, a good bedtime story stimulates the imagination, letting children paint the dragons and castles for themselves. （议论文·教育·对比）
Gentle encouragement, rather than harsh criticism, is what truly stimulates a young person's growth. （议论文·教育方式·观点句）
A well-timed discount can stimulate demand, but genuine quality is what keeps customers coming back. （议论文·商业·论证）
The teacher's provocative claim was designed to stimulate discussion, and soon the whole class was arguing with unusual passion. （读后续写·课堂·氛围）
Her grandmother's quiet courage stimulated her to keep painting even when every gallery had turned her away. （读后续写·励志·坚持）

collocations.translation: 启迪思维的，有益智力的
collocations.example: The exchange programme offers a mentally stimulating environment where students are challenged to question, rather than merely memorize. （应用文·项目介绍·招募）

synonyms.example: The old teacher's unshakable faith in him inspired the once-hopeless boy to pick up his books again, night after weary night. （读后续写·师恩·励志）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：inspire 侧重从精神层面点燃热情或崇高志向，对象多为人，常搭配 inspire sb to do；stimulate 更中性，可用于人、经济、身体、想象力等，强调'使更活跃'。

synonyms.example: A few words of praise from the coach encouraged the timid girl to volunteer for the relay at last. （读后续写·体育·突破自我）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：encourage 强调给予信心和支持使某人敢于行动，encourage sb to do；stimulate 强调激发活力或反应，语气更正式、更书面，可跟 interest/economy 等抽象名词。

synonyms.example: The abandoned puppy's pleading eyes aroused a tenderness in the crowd that no appeal for donations ever could. （读后续写·善意·情感）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：arouse 多与情感、好奇、怀疑等心理反应搭配，强调'唤起某种感受'（arouse curiosity/suspicion）；stimulate 适用范围更广，含'促进发展/活动'之意，可接经济、需求、生长等。

advancedExpressions.expression: stimulate v. 激发/刺激 → stimulation n. 刺激（sensory stimulation 感官刺激 / intellectual stimulation 智力刺激）
advancedExpressions.example: Her interest in art was stimulated by her father, and that early stimulation shaped her whole life. 她对艺术的兴趣被父亲激发，那早年的启迪塑造了她的一生。（课件 stimulation n. sensory/intellectual）

advancedExpressions.expression: stimulate interest/curiosity 激发兴趣 | stimulate the economy/demand 刺激经济/需求 | stimulate growth 促进增长 | stimulate sb to do 激励某人做 | mentally stimulating 启迪思维的
advancedExpressions.example: A vibrant club can stimulate students' interest and stimulate them to think for themselves. 一个充满活力的社团能激发学生的兴趣，并激励他们独立思考。（'激发抽象名词'与'激励某人做事'两类搭配一并记）

advancedExpressions.expression: stimulate(v.)—stimulation(n.)—stimulating(adj.)—stimulus/stimuli(n.刺激物)
advancedExpressions.example: The stimulating lecture provided a fresh stimulus and left the audience craving more stimulation. 这场启迪思维的讲座提供了新的刺激，让听众意犹未尽。（动/名/形/可数名词四形串记，注意 stimuli）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth stimulated in sb a ... that had long lain dormant
advancedExpressions.example: That single act of trust stimulated in her a courage that had long lain dormant, and for the first time she dared to raise her hand. （抽象名词具象化+lain dormant 沉睡意象，续写情感段）

advancedExpressions.expression: not only would ... stimulate ..., but it would also ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not only would such a club stimulate our interest in science, but it would also foster the teamwork we so often talk about yet rarely practise. （倒装 Not only 强调+双重益处，建议信论证段）

advancedExpressions.expression: by stimulating ..., ... paves the way for ...
advancedExpressions.example: By stimulating independent thought rather than rote memory, a good education paves the way for a generation unafraid to question. （by doing 手段状语+paves the way for 结果，议论文主体段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The story made him want to learn more.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The story stimulated in him a thirst for knowledge so unquenchable that he read by candlelight long after the household had fallen silent. （读后续写·求知·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: stimulate in sb a thirst 抽象搭配 + so...that 结果状语 + by candlelight / fallen silent 环境细节营造画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Games can help children's brains grow.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is compelling evidence that well-designed games do far more than entertain: they stimulate cognitive development, cultivate problem-solving skills, and lay the groundwork for lifelong curiosity. （议论文·教育·三项递进）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There is compelling evidence that... 引出论据 + 冒号引出解释 + stimulate/cultivate/lay 三动词排比递进

original_sentence: The concept took off, and today Guangzhou’s restaurants stimulate customers’ appetite with over a thousand offerings, each more delicate and delicious than the last.
readingExamples: The concept took off, and today Guangzhou’s restaurants stimulate customers’ appetite with over a thousand offerings, each more delicate and delicious than the last.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the physical desire to eat, especially the pleasure taken in eating
(2) n. a strong wish, desire or enthusiasm for something
(3) n. a natural tendency or willingness to take on something (such as risk or challenge)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (对……的) 强烈欲望 / 渴求 (非食物)
uncommonMeanings.example: The city seemed to have an insatiable appetite for glass and steel, swallowing every quiet lane and every old courtyard in its restless march upward. （读后续写·城市化·怀旧场景）

posExamples.sentence: After weeks of illness, the boy's appetite finally returned, and the whole family watched with wet eyes as he reached, at last, for a second bowl of his grandmother's soup. （读后续写·康复·亲情场景）

Nothing whets a diner's appetite quite like the sizzle of a hot plate carried through the room, and our proposed food festival aims to fill the whole campus with exactly such tempting aromas. （应用文·活动倡议·美食节方案）
A healthy appetite for challenge, rather than a fear of failure, is what distinguishes those who grow from those who merely grow old. （议论文·成长心态·对比论证）
The more we feed young minds with easy answers, the more we dull their appetite for genuine inquiry — and a nation that stops questioning soon stops advancing. （议论文·教育与思考·递进论证）

idioms.translation: 勾起某人的兴趣/食欲，吊胃口

collocations.translation: 刺激食欲 / 吊起胃口
collocations.example: The rich aroma of roasting chestnuts drifting down the winter street was enough to whet anyone's appetite. （读后续写·冬日街头·氛围）

After a long day hiking in the crisp mountain air, the children came home with a healthy appetite and cheeks glowing pink. （读后续写·户外·画面）
Her appetite for adventure led her, one restless summer, to trade the safety of home for a rickety bicycle and an open road. （读后续写·冒险·励志）
No single victory could satisfy his appetite for excellence; each medal only made him hungrier for the next. （读后续写·体育·进取）

synonyms.example: Beneath his calm exterior burned a hunger for recognition that no polite applause could ever fully quiet. （读后续写·内心刻画·渴望）
