synonyms.example: A sudden craving for her mother's dumplings struck her in the crowded foreign supermarket, and homesickness rose like a tide. （读后续写·思乡·细节）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:craving 指突如其来、难以抑制的强烈欲望,常带一点'瘾'的意味;appetite 更持续、更温和、更书面。

synonyms.example: His desire to prove the doubters wrong burned steadily through every setback, never once flickering out. （读后续写·励志·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:desire 最正式、最宽泛,可指任何强烈愿望;appetite for sth 特指'跃跃欲试地想要更多'的那种带享受意味的欲望。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·appetite 三大高频搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: ①have a good/poor appetite 胃口好/差 ②whet / stimulate the appetite 吊起/刺激食欲（whet 本义'磨快'，喻'勾起'）③an appetite for sth 对某事物的强烈渴望（介词 for）。反义动作 lose one's appetite 没胃口。
advancedExpressions.example: The starter whetted our appetite, but my little brother, who has a poor appetite, showed no appetite for anything but dessert. 前菜吊起了我们的胃口，可胃口不好的弟弟除了甜点对什么都没兴趣。

advancedExpressions.expression: appetite（对食物或某事物带享受意味的持续欲求，可搭 for）/ hunger（生理饥饿，也强烈比喻渴求，语气迫切）/ craving（突如其来、难抑制的强烈欲望，带'瘾'味）/ desire（最正式最宽泛的强烈愿望）。
advancedExpressions.example: His hunger for success became a craving so fierce that no reward could ever satisfy his appetite for more. 他对成功的渴望变成一种狂热的瘾，任何回报都填不满他对'更多'的欲求。

advancedExpressions.expression: appetite n. 食欲/欲望 → appetizing adj. 开胃的、诱人的（appetizing smell 诱人的香味）→ appetizer n. 开胃菜、餐前小吃。注意 appetite 只作名词，无对应动词，'刺激食欲'用 whet/stimulate the appetite。
advancedExpressions.example: The appetizing aroma of the appetizers sharpened everyone's appetite before the main course arrived. 开胃菜诱人的香气在主菜上桌前勾起了每个人的食欲。

advancedExpressions.expression: the smell/sight of ... was enough to whet even ...'s appetite
advancedExpressions.example: The sight of golden dumplings steaming on the table was enough to whet even the exhausted traveller's appetite. （感官引发食欲，续写团圆场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is sure to be something to satisfy every appetite
advancedExpressions.example: From spicy hotpot to delicate desserts, there is sure to be something to satisfy every appetite at this year's food fair. （from...to... 罗列+满足各类需求，宣传文案）

advancedExpressions.expression: society's growing appetite for ... comes at the cost of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Society's growing appetite for instant gratification comes at the cost of the patience on which every worthwhile pursuit depends. （抽象搭配+代价论证，议论文批判段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was very hungry after the trip.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The long journey had sharpened his appetite to such an edge that the plainest bowl of rice, steaming on the table, seemed a feast fit for a king. （读后续写·归家·夸张画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: sharpen one's appetite to an edge 隐喻 + to such...that 结果状语 + a feast fit for a king 夸张收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: People always want more entertainment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is worth pondering why modern society's appetite for entertainment seems only to grow the more it is fed, as though amusement itself had become a hunger that no amount of distraction can ever truly satisfy. （议论文·社会反思·设问）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is worth pondering why... 引发思考 + the more...the... 递进 + as though 虚拟比喻收束

classPractice.question: Today Guangzhou's restaurants stimulate customers' ____ (appetite) with over a thousand delicate offerings.
classPractice.note: 课文原句改编；作宾语用名词单数 appetite

classPractice.question: The delicious smell drifting from the kitchen was enough to ____ everyone's ____. (吊起食欲)
classPractice.note: whet one's appetite 吊胃口、勾起兴趣；固定搭配，whet 不可换成 wet

classPractice.question: From childhood she showed a strong appetite ____ knowledge, reading everything she could find. (填介词)
classPractice.note: an appetite for sth 对某事物的强烈渴望，介词固定用 for

translation: 精致的，精细的，精巧的；娇弱的，脆弱的；微妙的
original_sentence: The original scroll is still in one piece despite its age, but it is extremely delicate.
readingExamples: The original scroll is still in one piece despite its age, but it is extremely delicate.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. finely made, soft and pleasing, requiring skill or care to produce or handle
(2) adj. easily broken, damaged or harmed; physically weak or fragile
(3) adj. needing to be dealt with carefully or sensitively; requiring tact
(4) adj. (of colours, tastes or smells) light, subtle and not strong

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (易碎/易损) fragile 脆弱的，精密易损的【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: the delicate ecological balance of the rainforest / the delicate mechanisms of a clock 热带雨林极易被破坏的生态平衡／钟的精密机件。（课件·delicate 义项一 = fragile）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (颜色/味道/香气) 清新柔和的，淡雅含蓄的 (light and pleasant, subtle)【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: a delicate fragrance / flavour / watercolours 清新的芳香；鲜美的味道；柔和的色彩。（课件·delicate 义项二）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (局势/问题) 微妙的，需谨慎处理的（高考高频）
uncommonMeanings.example: Raising the topic of money among close friends is always a delicate matter. 在密友之间提钱的话题总是件微妙的事。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (颜色/味道/香气) 淡雅的，柔和不浓烈的
uncommonMeanings.example: The soup had a delicate flavour, subtle yet unforgettable. 这汤味道清淡雅致，含蓄却令人难忘。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (身体) 娇弱的，易生病的；(物品) 易碎的，脆弱的
uncommonMeanings.example: Of delicate health since birth, the child was rarely allowed to play outside. 那孩子生来体弱，很少被允许在外面玩。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (局势/问题) 微妙的，需谨慎处理的
uncommonMeanings.example: Bringing up the subject of his late wife was a delicate matter, and she chose each word as carefully as one steps across thin ice. （读后续写·安慰·谨慎场景）

posExamples.sentence: In the trembling light of the lamp, the old master's hands moved over the delicate paper-cut with the tenderness of someone handling a living thing, afraid a single careless breath might tear generations of art in two. （读后续写·非遗传承·工艺细节）
We kindly remind all visitors that the ancient scrolls on display are extremely delicate, so please refrain from using flash photography or touching the glass cases. （应用文·通知·博物馆须知）
Maintaining a delicate balance between economic growth and environmental protection is perhaps the greatest challenge our generation will be asked to solve. （议论文·可持续发展·平衡论证）
A delicate fragrance of jasmine drifted in through the open window, and for a moment the whole cramped classroom seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·环境描写·嗅觉画面）

collocations.phrase: the delicate ecological balance【课件·易碎fragile】
collocations.translation: 极易被破坏的生态平衡【课件】
collocations.example: the delicate ecological balance of the rainforest 热带雨林极易被破坏的生态平衡。（课件·delicate=fragile 易碎/易损）

collocations.phrase: the delicate mechanisms of a clock【课件·易碎fragile】
collocations.example: the delicate mechanisms of a clock 钟的精密机件。（课件·delicate=fragile 精密易损）
Deciding who to blame was a delicate problem that no one wanted to touch. 决定归咎于谁是个微妙的问题，谁都不愿碰。（课件搭配 a delicate problem）

collocations.phrase: a delicate fragrance / flavour / watercolours【课件·(色/味/香)清新柔和】
collocations.translation: 清新的芳香／鲜美的味道／柔和的色彩【课件】
collocations.example: a delicate fragrance / flavour / watercolours 清新的芳香；鲜美的味道；柔和的色彩。（课件·(color/flavour/smell) light and pleasant, subtle）

collocations.translation: 精心地；小心翼翼地【课件】
collocations.example: delicately balanced flavour 精心调配的味道；He stepped delicately over the broken glass. 他小心翼翼地跨过碎玻璃。（课件·副词 delicately）
Green tea has a delicate flavour that many find soothing. 绿茶有一种清淡雅致的味道，许多人觉得很舒缓。
Telling him the bad news was a delicate matter. 把坏消息告诉他是件棘手的事。
Because of her delicate health, she seldom goes out in winter. 因为身体羸弱，她冬天很少出门。
The teacher handled the quarrel delicately so no one felt hurt. 老师谨慎地处理了这场争吵，没人受伤。
Nature keeps a delicate balance that centuries of human greed can shatter in a single careless generation. （议论文·生态·警示）
Caught between two quarrelling friends, she found herself in a delicate situation where every word risked deepening the rift. （读后续写·友情·两难）

collocations.translation: 精致的五官 / 纤细的手
collocations.example: Her delicate features, half-hidden behind a curtain of black hair, gave her the look of a figure stepped out of an old ink painting. （读后续写·人物出场·外貌）
Of delicate health since childhood, the girl had nonetheless a will of iron that startled everyone who mistook frailty for weakness. （读后续写·励志·反差刻画）
The teacher handled the boy's outburst with such delicacy that his wounded pride was soothed rather than shamed. （读后续写·师生·处理冲突）

collocations.translation: 清新雅致的味道 / 香气
collocations.example: The tea released a delicate aroma, faint yet unmistakable, that seemed to carry with it the mist of distant spring mountains. （读后续写·品茶·感官）
The delicate craftsmanship of the silver bracelet spoke of countless patient hours no machine could ever replicate. （读后续写·手艺·赞叹）

collocations.translation: 处于脆弱 / 危险的状态
collocations.example: The rescued fledgling was still in a delicate condition, so the children took turns watching over it through the long, anxious night. （读后续写·救助小动物·守护）

collocations.translation: 清淡雅致的味道 / 香气
collocations.example: The tea released a delicate aroma, faint yet unmistakable, that seemed to carry with it the mist of distant spring mountains. （读后续写·品茶·感官）

synonyms.example: The dream she had nursed in secret was fragile as a soap bubble, and a single mocking laugh nearly burst it forever. （读后续写·梦想·脆弱心理）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:fragile 侧重'一碰即碎',强调物理或情感上的易损坏;delicate 除脆弱外还含'精致、需精心呵护'的褒义色彩。

synonyms.example: There was a subtle change in his tone — not anger exactly, but a coldness — that told her the friendship had quietly cracked. （读后续写·人际·细腻感知）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:subtle 强调'细微到难以察觉',多修饰差别、变化、暗示;delicate 修饰对象更广,可指物品精致、局势棘手、身体娇弱等。

synonyms.example: The reporter avoided the sensitive topic, aware that one careless question could reopen a grieving mother's wounds. （读后续写·采访·分寸）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:sensitive 强调'容易引起强烈反应、需体谅';delicate 更侧重'处理起来棘手、需要技巧',二者在'棘手'义上近义,但侧重点不同。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·delicate 多义搭配一览
advancedExpressions.expression: ①精致的：delicate features/craftsmanship 精致的五官/工艺 ②娇弱易碎的：delicate health 体弱、a delicate scroll 脆弱的画卷 ③微妙棘手的：a delicate situation/matter/balance 微妙局面/问题/平衡 ④淡雅的：a delicate flavour/aroma 清淡的味道/香气。一词四义，看搭配定含义。
advancedExpressions.example: Her delicate hands, her delicate health, the delicate situation at home and the delicate aroma of her tea—all four 'delicates' mean different things. 她纤细的手、羸弱的身体、家中微妙的处境、她茶水淡雅的香气——四个 delicate 含义各不相同。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'脆弱/微妙/精致'（辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: delicate（精致又需精心呵护，褒义色彩，义项最广）/ fragile（一碰即碎，强调物理或情感易损）/ subtle（细微到难以察觉，多修饰差别、变化、暗示）/ sensitive（易引起强烈反应、需体谅，多指话题、人）。
advancedExpressions.example: The situation was so delicate and sensitive that one careless, fragile-sounding word could shatter the subtle trust between them. 局面如此微妙敏感，一句轻率脆弱的话就可能击碎他们之间微妙的信任。

advancedExpressions.expression: delicate adj. 精致/娇弱/微妙 → delicately adv. 精细地、谨慎地 → delicacy n.（①精致、微妙 ②美味佳肴，如 a local delicacy 地方美食）。注意名词 delicacy 兼有抽象'精妙'和具体'珍馐'两义。
advancedExpressions.example: She delicately arranged each delicacy on the plate, and the whole dish became a work of delicate art. 她精细地把每样美味摆上盘，整道菜成了一件精致的艺术品。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·工艺/人物刻画
advancedExpressions.expression: handle sth with the tenderness/care one reserves for ...
advancedExpressions.example: He unfolded the letter with the tenderness one reserves for something delicate and irreplaceable. （as if 隐含+reserve for 比拟，续写细节刻画）

advancedExpressions.expression: given that ... is extremely delicate, we kindly ask that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Given that the exhibits are extremely delicate, we kindly ask that visitors keep a respectful distance at all times. （Given that 状语+kindly ask 礼貌请求，通知文体）

advancedExpressions.expression: striking a delicate balance between ... and ... calls for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Striking a delicate balance between individual freedom and collective good calls for wisdom that no single rule can supply. （striking a balance 动名词主语+calls for 谓语，议论文论证段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old painting was easy to damage, so she was careful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Knowing how delicate the centuries-old painting was, she held her breath and lowered it into the frame with the trembling caution of one defusing a bomb. （读后续写·文物·紧张场景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Knowing how... 分词状语引出原因 + held her breath 动作细节 + with the caution of one defusing a bomb 比喻夸张营造张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: We must protect the environment but also develop the economy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: How to preserve the delicate balance of our ecosystem while pursuing economic prosperity is not a question we can afford to postpone to the next generation. （议论文·可持续发展·设问式论点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: How to... 疑问词短语作主语 + delicate balance 精准搭配 + not...we can afford to postpone 否定强调紧迫性

classPractice.question: The original scroll is still in one piece despite its age, but it is extremely ____ (delicate).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；作表语用形容词 delicate 脆弱的、易损的

classPractice.question: 辨析选词 (delicate / fragile): Discussing his failure in front of others was a ____ matter that needed great tact.
classPractice.note: delicate matter 微妙/棘手之事（需技巧处理）；fragile 侧重'易碎'，此处不合

classPractice.question: 老师小心谨慎地处理了这件棘手的事。The teacher handled the ____ situation ____ (delicate 的两种形式).
classPractice.note: 第一空修饰名词 situation 用形容词 delicate；第二空修饰动词 handled 用副词 delicately

original_sentence: The emphasis is rather on conversation about business, family or pleasure, and locals can spend hours together chatting, drinking tea and working their way through the menu.
readingExamples: The emphasis is rather on conversation about business, family or pleasure, and locals can spend hours together chatting, drinking tea and working their way through the menu.
definitionEn:
(1) n. special importance, value or attention given to something
(2) n. the extra force or stress given to a particular word or syllable when speaking
(3) n. the quality of standing out or being made especially noticeable

posExamples.sentence: As the coach ended his speech, the emphasis in his voice shifted from strategy to spirit, and the exhausted players felt something stubborn and warm rise again in their chests. （读后续写·赛前动员·情感转折）
I would suggest that our school place greater emphasis on physical education, for a sound body is surely the foundation upon which every academic ambition must rest. （应用文·建议信·主张）
The modern obsession with grades has, in my view, placed far too much emphasis on results and far too little on the curiosity that ought to drive all genuine learning. （议论文·教育反思·失衡论证）
By shifting the emphasis from competition to cooperation, the new classroom rules quietly transformed a room of rivals into a team. （议论文·教育方式·因果论证）

collocations.phrase: place / lay / put (great) emphasis on sth = give emphasis to sth【课件】
collocations.example: He places / lays / puts great emphasis on time management. = He gives great emphasis to time management. 他非常重视时间管理。（课件例句·两种同义结构）
The two reports reflect different emphases and viewpoints. 这两份报告体现出不同的侧重点和观点。（课件·emphasis 复数 emphases）
Our school puts great emphasis on reading. 我们学校非常重视阅读。
The coach lays emphasis on teamwork rather than personal glory. 教练着重于团队协作，而非个人荣誉。
In this class the emphasis is on speaking, not grammar rules. 这门课的重点在口语，而非语法规则。

collocations.phrase: shift the emphasis from A to B
collocations.example: We should shift the emphasis from scores to real ability. 我们该把重点从分数转到真正的能力上。
The old craftsman placed great emphasis on patience, repeating that a single hurried stroke could ruin a month's work. （读后续写·师徒·教诲）
Our proposed reading programme lays special emphasis on classics, believing that timeless books shape timeless minds. （应用文·倡议·方案）
It is high time we shifted the emphasis from memorizing facts to cultivating the courage to question them. （议论文·教育·呼吁）
"You must never give up," his father said with such emphasis that the words seemed to press themselves permanently into the boy's memory. （读后续写·父爱·教诲）
In this year's festival, the chief emphasis will fall on student-led performances rather than professional shows. （应用文·活动·说明）
A moment of silence before the announcement gave dramatic emphasis to the name that followed. （读后续写·颁奖·气氛）

collocations.phrase: an undue / excessive emphasis on sth
collocations.example: An undue emphasis on winning can rob young athletes of the very joy that first drew them to the sport. （议论文·体育教育·批判）
She repeated the number twice, slowly, for emphasis, until every hand in the room had written it down. （读后续写·课堂·细节）

synonyms.example: The teacher laid particular stress on honesty, telling us that a single lie could undo years of trust. （读后续写·师训·品德）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:stress 与 emphasis 在'强调'义上几乎可互换,但 stress 更口语、更常与压力义并存;正式书面论述中 emphasis 略显庄重。

synonyms.example: Few of us grasp the importance of sleep until a single restless night leaves the whole world grey and heavy. （议论文·健康·反思）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:importance 指'重要性'这一客观属性;emphasis 指人为地'把注意力/分量放在某处'的行为或倾向,含主动选择之意。

synonyms.example: In the weeks before the exam, sleep and steady effort must become our top priority, not last-minute cramming. （应用文·经验分享·建议）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:priority 强调'排在前面、优先处理的事项',含次序意味;emphasis 强调'投入的关注与分量',不一定涉及先后顺序。

advancedExpressions.type: 词块·work one's way through【课件·链接】
advancedExpressions.expression: work one's way through sth 自始至终做完（尤指费时费力）；work one's way through school / college / university 勤工俭学，半工半读
advancedExpressions.example: The board are still working their way through the application forms. 董事会仍在逐一审阅所有申请表。/ He worked his way through university, waiting tables every evening. 他靠勤工俭学读完大学，每晚都去餐厅端盘子。（课件原句·课文 working their way through the menu 慢慢吃遍菜单）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·emphas- 词族（含 emphasize 用法）【课件】
advancedExpressions.expression: emphasis n. 强调（复数 emphases /-siːz/）→ emphasize vt. 强调，重视；使突出，使明显（emphasize (that)... / emphasize doing / emphasize sth）→ emphatic adj. 强调的 → emphatically adv.。名词用 place emphasis on，动词直接 emphasize sth。
advancedExpressions.example: The dress emphasized the shape of her body, and she emphasized that comfort mattered more than fashion. 这条裙子突出了她的身材，而她强调舒适比时髦更重要。（课件·emphasize 兼'强调'与'使突出'两义）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·emphasis 核心搭配（介词是关键）
advancedExpressions.expression: ①place/put/lay emphasis on sth 强调、重视某事（重点用介词 on）②the emphasis is on sth 重点在于… ③shift the emphasis from A to B 把重点从A转到B ④for emphasis 为了强调 ⑤with emphasis 着重地。看到 emphasis 先想介词 on。
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of placing so much emphasis on grades, we should shift the emphasis to genuine curiosity—the emphasis, in short, must be on learning itself. 与其如此看重分数，我们更该把重点转向真正的好奇心——简言之，重点应放在学习本身。

advancedExpressions.expression: emphasis（人为地把关注/分量放在某处，正式书面）/ stress（几乎同义，更口语，也常与'压力'义并存）/ importance（客观'重要性'属性）/ priority（含'排在前面、优先处理'的次序意味）。
advancedExpressions.example: The report laid stress on safety, gave priority to workers' lives, and made clear the emphasis it placed on their importance. 报告强调安全，把工人的生命放在首位，并表明它对其重要性的重视。

advancedExpressions.expression: with an emphasis that ... , sb said ...
advancedExpressions.example: With an emphasis that left no room for argument, she said, "We finish this together, or not at all." （介词短语前置+直接引语，续写高潮对话）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest placing greater emphasis on ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would suggest placing greater emphasis on hands-on experiments, since knowledge truly takes root only when it is tested by one's own hands. （委婉建议句式+since 因果，建议信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: too much emphasis on ... at the expense of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Placing too much emphasis on short-term profit at the expense of long-term trust is a bargain no wise enterprise should ever make. （at the expense of 代价结构，议论文批判段）

advancedExpressions.expression: emphasis n. 强调（复数 emphases /-siːz/）→ emphasize / emphasise v. 强调（emphasize (that)... / emphasize doing）→ emphatic adj. 强调的、坚决的 → emphatically adv. 断然地、强调地。名词用 place emphasis on，动词直接 emphasize sth。
advancedExpressions.example: He emphasized, with an emphatic nod, the point on which he wished to place the greatest emphasis. 他用力点头，强调了他最想着重突出的那一点。

sentenceUpgrade.original: He said the last word very strongly.

sentenceUpgrade.original: Schools care too much about exam scores.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is regrettable that so many schools continue to place undue emphasis on examination scores, treating grades as the sole measure of a young person whose true worth no number could ever capture. （议论文·教育批判·观点段）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is regrettable that... 评价性主句 + undue emphasis 精准搭配 + whose true worth no number could capture 定语从句升华

translation: vt. & vi. 蒸；散发蒸汽 | n. 蒸汽；蒸汽动力；水汽
original_sentence: From beef balls to rice noodle rolls, there are various dishes that have been baked, boiled, steamed or fried.
readingExamples: From beef balls to rice noodle rolls, there are various dishes that have been baked, boiled, steamed or fried.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the hot gas that water turns into when it boils; the mist formed as this gas cools
(2) n. the power produced by steam under pressure, used to drive engines and machines
(3) vt. & vi. to cook food using the heat of steam; to give off steam or become covered with mist
(4) vi. (of a ship or train) to move under steam power

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 精力，干劲 (常用于 run out of steam / pick up steam)
uncommonMeanings.example: Halfway up the final slope the boy ran out of steam, his legs turning to lead, yet the sight of his father waving at the summit gave him one last surge of will. （读后续写·登山·意志考验场景）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (steam up) 发怒，冒火 (口语，get steamed up)
uncommonMeanings.example: There was no point getting steamed up over a bus he had already missed, so he took a deep breath and set off on foot instead. （读后续写·情绪管理·转念场景）

posExamples.sentence: Steam curled up lazily from the bowl of noodles his mother had left on the table, and in that small rising cloud he suddenly smelled the whole of his faraway childhood. （读后续写·思乡·嗅觉记忆场景）
Our cookery club will teach beginners how to steam fish so that it stays tender and delicate, a skill far healthier than the deep-frying most students rely on. （应用文·社团招募·活动介绍）
As the old locomotive steamed out of the station, hissing and groaning, the boy pressed his face to the glass and watched his hometown shrink slowly into memory. （读后续写·离别·火车站场景）
The Industrial Revolution, driven by the raw power of steam, transformed not only how goods were made but also how millions of ordinary people lived, worked and dreamed. （议论文·科技与社会·历史论证）

wordForms.other: steamer (n. 蒸笼；汽船)

idioms.example: After the tense exam, the whole class rushed onto the basketball court to let off steam, their laughter finally breaking the weeks of silent strain. （读后续写·考后放松·情绪宣泄场景）
The volunteer campaign that had begun so passionately soon ran out of steam once the novelty faded and the hard, thankless work remained. （议论文·坚持·转折论证）
Refusing all offers of help, she finished the project under her own steam, prouder of the struggle than of the prize. （读后续写·独立·励志场景）
What started as a handful of students planting trees soon picked up steam, until half the town had joined the greening drive. （应用文·环保活动·发展）
With the sponsors finally on board, it was full steam ahead for the charity concert. （应用文·活动筹备·推进）

collocations.example: Steam the fish for ten minutes to keep it tender. 把鱼蒸十分钟，保持鲜嫩。
A cloud of steam rose from the hot noodles. 一团蒸汽从热腾腾的面条上升起。
After the exam, we played football to let off steam. 考试后我们踢球来发泄一下。
The project started well but soon ran out of steam. 项目开头不错，可很快就后劲不足了。
Steam rose from the manhole covers as the frozen city slowly woke, and the streetlights glowed like pale moons in the mist. （读后续写·清晨都市·环境描写）
The kettle shrieked, sending a cloud of steam billowing across the tiny kitchen where grandmother hummed an old tune. （读后续写·温馨家庭·画面）
The invention of the steam engine is often regarded as the spark that set the modern industrial age ablaze. （议论文·科技·历史论断）

collocations.translation: 蒸饺 / 蒸鱼 / 蒸饭
collocations.example: A basket of freshly steamed dumplings, still trembling with heat, sat at the centre of the reunion table. （读后续写·团圆饭·细节）
His glasses steamed up the moment he stepped from the freezing street into the crowded, fragrant teahouse. （读后续写·冬日·细节）

collocations.phrase: be baked, boiled, steamed or fried
collocations.example: At the night market, every imaginable snack — baked, boiled, steamed or fried — sent its aroma drifting into the warm evening air. （读后续写·夜市·嗅觉画面）
The ferry steamed out of the harbour just as the first ray of sunlight touched the water. （读后续写·启程·画面）
By June the whole school was working at full steam to prepare for the centennial celebration. （应用文·活动筹备·氛围）

synonyms.example: A thin vapour hung over the paddy fields at dawn, softening the harsh outlines of the mountains beyond. （读后续写·田园·环境）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:vapour 泛指任何气态的水汽或雾气,更科学、更书面;steam 特指水沸腾产生的、通常带热气的蒸汽,更具体、更日常。

synonyms.example: As the mist lifted from the valley, a hidden village of grey rooftops emerged, as if the mountain had been keeping a secret. （读后续写·山谷·揭示场景）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:mist 指自然界悬浮的薄雾,营造朦胧氛围;steam 由沸水或高温产生,常与烹饪、机器、呼吸的白气相关。

synonyms.translation: 精力，能量 (对应 steam 的'干劲'义)
synonyms.example: By the last mile of the marathon her energy was all but gone, yet somehow her feet kept moving. （读后续写·马拉松·意志）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:当 steam 作'精力/干劲'解时,近义于 energy,但 steam 多用于 run out of / let off steam 等固定习语中,更口语、更形象。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·steam 习语群（'精力/干劲'的比喻）
advancedExpressions.expression: steam 除'蒸汽'外常喻'精力、干劲'：①let off steam 发泄情绪、宣泄精力 ②run out of steam 后劲不足、精疲力竭 ③pick up / gather steam 势头增强、渐入佳境 ④full steam ahead 全速前进 ⑤under one's own steam 靠自己的力量。
advancedExpressions.example: The campaign gathered steam at first, then ran out of steam; the tired volunteers just needed to let off steam. 运动起初势头渐旺，随后后劲不足；疲惫的志愿者只是需要发泄一下。

advancedExpressions.expression: steam（沸水/高温产生、通常带热气的蒸汽，与烹饪、机器、呼吸白气相关）/ vapour（泛指任何气态水汽，更科学书面）/ mist（自然界悬浮的薄雾，营造朦胧氛围）。厨房里升腾的白气用 steam，山谷晨雾用 mist。
advancedExpressions.example: Steam curled from the hot bowl, while outside a thin mist and morning vapour still hung over the fields. 热碗上蒸汽缭绕，屋外田野上还笼着一层薄雾和晨间水汽。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·steam 词族与动词用法
advancedExpressions.expression: steam 既是名词也是动词（steam the fish 蒸鱼 / the train steamed out 火车喷着蒸汽驶出）→ steamed adj. 蒸的（steamed buns 馒头）→ steamy adj. 热气腾腾的、雾气弥漫的 → steamer n. 蒸笼；汽船。烹饪法对比：bake 烤 / boil 煮 / steam 蒸 / fry 炸。
advancedExpressions.example: In the steamy kitchen she put the steamed fish back into the bamboo steamer. 在雾气弥漫的厨房里，她把蒸鱼又放回竹蒸笼。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境/感官描写
advancedExpressions.expression: steam curled up from ..., carrying with it ...
advancedExpressions.example: Steam curled up from the bowl, carrying with it the warm smell of home and a rush of memories she thought she had forgotten. （拟人化 curl up+carry with it 引出情感，续写触景生情段）

advancedExpressions.expression: with ..., it was full steam ahead for ...
advancedExpressions.example: With every classroom decorated and every rehearsal finished, it was full steam ahead for the graduation ceremony. （With 独立结构铺陈+习语 full steam ahead 收束，活动类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: many begin with great enthusiasm, only to run out of steam when ...
advancedExpressions.example: Many begin their resolutions with great enthusiasm, only to run out of steam the moment the first real obstacle appears. （only to 表意外结果+run out of steam 习语，议论文对比段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Steam came out of the bowl of soup on the table.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From the bowl on the table steam rose in slow, trembling wisps, curling toward the ceiling and filling the cramped little room with the unmistakable warmth of being home at last. （读后续写·归家·感官画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: From the bowl 地点状语前置倒装 + in slow trembling wisps 精细状语 + curling / filling 现在分词伴随 + 主题词 warmth of being home 升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: The project failed because people lost their energy after a while.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The project faltered not for lack of a worthy goal, but because its organizers, so fiery at the outset, gradually ran out of steam once the applause died down and the tedious work began. （议论文·善始善终·因果分析）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not for..., but because... 平行否定强调真因 + so fiery at the outset 插入对比 + run out of steam 习语 + once 时间状语点出转折时机

classPractice.question: From beef balls to rice noodle rolls, there are various dishes that have been baked, boiled, ____ (steam) or fried.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；与 baked/boiled/fried 并列作过去分词，构成被动，用 steamed

classPractice.question: After a stressful week, going for a long run is a great way to ____ ____ ____. (发泄情绪)
classPractice.note: let off steam 发泄情绪/宣泄精力；固定习语，steam 不可数

classPractice.question: 辨析选词 (let off steam / run out of steam): The marathon runner ____ in the last mile and had to slow to a walk.
classPractice.note: run out of steam 后劲不足、精疲力竭；let off steam 是'发泄'，此处指体力耗尽

original_sentence: Make a sentence with the grammar.
readingExamples: Make a sentence with the grammar.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a unit for measuring weight in the metric system, equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
(2) n. (informal) a very small amount of a quality or feeling

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一丁点儿（引申义，常用于否定句强调数量之微）
uncommonMeanings.example: For all his boasting, there was not a single gram of genuine courage in him when the moment of danger finally arrived. （读后续写·人物揭示·外强中干）

posExamples.sentence: Grandmother measured out exactly two hundred grams of flour, her weathered hands moving with a precision that no kitchen scale could ever rival, as the morning light spilled across the wooden table. （读后续写·亲情·厨房记忆）
To ensure a fair comparison in our science experiment, I would suggest that each group weigh out precisely fifty grams of the sample before recording any observations. （应用文·实验建议）
A diet rich in vegetables can supply the body with several grams of dietary fibre daily, which explains why nutritionists so strongly advocate a return to plant-based meals. （议论文·健康饮食）

wordForms.other: 公制重量单位换算：1 kilogram (kg 千克) = 1000 grams (g 克)，1 gram = 1000 milligrams (mg 毫克)；英式拼写 gramme；缩写 g，前接数字复数加 s：200 grams。同为计量单位：litre 升、metre 米、tonne 吨。

collocations.example: Add two hundred grams of flour to the bowl. 往碗里加两百克面粉。
The newborn puppy weighed only about ninety grams. 刚出生的小狗只有大约九十克重。
This rare tea costs several yuan per gram. 这种珍稀茶叶每克要好几元。
In baking, it is safer to measure ingredients in grams. 烘焙时，用克来称量食材更保险。
A few grams of yeast, once dissolved in warm water, can transform a lifeless lump of dough into a soft, breathing loaf. （读后续写·烘焙·生活温度）
The report noted that the pollutant had reached forty grams per litre, a figure that sent a wave of alarm through the entire community. （应用文·调查报告）
The newborn kitten weighed barely a hundred grams, yet its faint, insistent mewing filled the whole room with tender urgency. （读后续写·生命·柔弱）
In precise cooking, ingredients are best measured in grams rather than cups, for accuracy is the invisible backbone of every reliable recipe. （应用文·说明文）
Priced far higher per gram than gold, the rare spice had journeyed across three continents to reach the merchant's stall. （读后续写·历史·异域）
There was not a gram of truth in the rumour, yet it spread through the town like wildfire, reminding us how fragile a good name can be. （议论文·舆论）

synonyms.example: She poured every ounce of her energy into the final rehearsal, determined that no effort would be spared. （读后续写·奋斗）
synonyms.usage: 英制重量单位，约28克；在'every ounce of'固定短语中表'全部的力气/情感'，比gram更常用于抽象强调

synonyms.example: Not a particle of doubt clouded his mind as he stepped forward to accept the challenge. （读后续写·坚定）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'极微小的颗粒或抽象上的一丁点'，比gram更文学化，多用于否定强调

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·计量单位的数与介词
advancedExpressions.expression: gram 是可数名词：two grams（复数加 s），但作前置定语修饰名词时用单数：a 200-gram bag 一个200克的袋子（连字符连接，gram 不加 s）。'多少克的某物'用 grams of sth；'每克'用 per gram；'以克计量'用 in grams。
advancedExpressions.example: She bought a 500-gram bag of sugar, that is, five hundred grams measured to the last gram. 她买了一袋500克的糖，也就是精确到克的五百克。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·词根前缀构成公制单位
advancedExpressions.expression: kilo-（千）+ gram = kilogram 千克；milli-（千分之一）+ gram = milligram 毫克。同类前缀通用：kilometre 千米、millimetre 毫米、kilolitre 千升。掌握 kilo-/milli- 一组前缀，一批单位迎刃而解。
advancedExpressions.example: The medicine dose was just a few milligrams, though the whole package weighed nearly a kilogram. 药量只有几毫克，尽管整包重近一千克。

advancedExpressions.expression: with a precision measured in grams
advancedExpressions.example: She adjusted each ingredient with a precision measured in grams, as though the fate of the entire dinner rested on a single delicate balance. （以'量化词'具象化人物的专注，化抽象为可感）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the sake of accuracy, ... in grams rather than ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the sake of accuracy, all quantities in this recipe are given in grams rather than approximate spoonfuls, so that beginners may reproduce the dish with confidence. （说明文中体现严谨与体贴）

advancedExpressions.expression: not a single gram of ... , yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not a single gram of hesitation showed on the volunteers' faces, yet their quiet resolve spoke louder than any grand declaration ever could. （用微量否定反衬精神之重，欲扬先抑）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She added some sugar to the bowl.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She sprinkled in the last few grams of sugar with the reverence of a chemist completing a formula, watching the crystals vanish into the warm batter like snow melting into spring soil. （读后续写·细节+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 量化(few grams)增强画面精确度 + 类比(the reverence of a chemist)刻画专注 + 比喻(snow melting into spring soil)营造温度

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should measure the ingredients carefully.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that every ingredient should be measured down to the last gram, for it is precisely this attention to the smallest detail that separates a memorable dish from a mediocre one. （议论文·严谨精神）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...正式主句 + down to the last gram夸张强调 + it is...that强调句凸显'细节决定成败'的论点

classPractice.question: The recipe asks for two hundred ____ (gram) of flour and fifty grams of sugar.
classPractice.note: gram 可数名词，two hundred 后接复数 grams

classPractice.question: For accuracy, professional chefs prefer to measure everything ____ grams rather than in cups. (填介词)
classPractice.note: measure sth in grams 以克为单位计量；表'用……为单位'介词用 in

classPractice.question: 这枚戒指重约五克。
classPractice.answer: This ring weighs about five grams. / The ring weighs around five grams.
classPractice.note: weigh ... grams 重达……克；five 后 gram 用复数 grams

definitionEn:
(1) n. a large round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves that can be eaten cooked or raw
(2) n. (British, informal, offensive) a person who is no longer able to think or move because of brain damage

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式俚语，冒犯性）（因脑损伤而）丧失思维能力的人；植物人
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctors had feared he would remain a cabbage after the accident, yet against every prediction, a faint squeeze of his fingers one grey morning announced that the man they knew was fighting his way back. （读后续写·医院·奇迹）

posExamples.sentence: In the frost-bitten garden, a single cabbage stood defiant among the withered stalks, its tight green leaves glistening with dew as if refusing to surrender to the coming winter. （读后续写·自然·坚韧）
I am writing to recommend that our canteen add more locally grown cabbage to the menu, as it is both nutritious and affordable for students on a limited budget. （应用文·建议信）
Humble vegetables such as the cabbage are too often dismissed as poor man's food, yet they carry a nutritional value that many expensive imported foods can scarcely match. （议论文·饮食文化）

wordForms.other: 可数：a cabbage 一棵卷心菜（two cabbages）；论'一颗'常说 a head of cabbage。厨房蔬菜词族：cabbage 卷心菜/甘蓝、Chinese cabbage 大白菜、lettuce 生菜、spinach 菠菜、celery 芹菜、broccoli 西兰花。

collocations.example: In winter, northern families store a lot of Chinese cabbage. 冬天，北方家庭会储存很多大白菜。
She bought a head of cabbage at the market. 她在市场买了一颗卷心菜。
First shred the cabbage, then stir-fry it quickly. 先把卷心菜切丝，然后快速翻炒。
Pickled cabbage goes perfectly with steamed rice. 酸菜配蒸米饭正好。
Clutching a head of cabbage to her chest, the little girl trudged home through the snow, her cheeks glowing red against the icy wind. （读后续写·童年·冬日）
First shred the cabbage finely, then toss it with a pinch of salt and let it soften before adding the dressing. （应用文·食谱说明）
The tangy aroma of pickled cabbage drifting from the kitchen instantly carried me back to the winters of my grandmother's northern village. （读后续写·味觉·乡愁）
The retired teacher spent his mornings planting cabbages, finding in the quiet rhythm of the soil a peace that decades in the classroom had never quite offered. （读后续写·退休·田园）
The children raced through the cabbage patch at dusk, their laughter scattering the sparrows into the amber sky. （读后续写·乡村·童趣）

synonyms.example: A colourful plate of fresh vegetables can brighten not only a meal but also the mood of everyone gathered round the table. （应用文·健康倡议）
synonyms.usage: 泛指所有蔬菜的上位词；当无需特指卷心菜、只需强调'蔬菜类'时使用

synonyms.example: 'Eat your greens,' my mother always said, though back then I could hardly see the wisdom hidden in such a simple command. （读后续写·亲情·回忆）
synonyms.usage: 口语中泛指绿叶菜（含卷心菜、菠菜等），常用于'eat one's greens'这类日常表达，比cabbage更口语化、更笼统

definitionEn:
(1) n. a piece of paper, plastic, or other material that is wrapped around something, especially to protect it or as packaging
(2) n. a thin flat piece of dough that is wrapped around a filling, as in dumplings or spring rolls
(3) n. a loose outer garment such as a dressing gown or robe (dated)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 宽松的外袍；晨衣（旧用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: She drew her thin wrapper tightly around her shoulders and stepped onto the frost-covered balcony, watching the first pale light break over the sleeping town. （读后续写·清晨·孤独）

posExamples.sentence: The empty sweet wrapper drifted across the deserted playground, a small, glittering ghost of the laughter that had once filled this now-silent corner of the school. （读后续写·物是人非·怀旧）
I would like to propose that we replace all plastic wrappers in the school shop with biodegradable paper ones, a simple step that could greatly reduce the waste piling up on our campus. （应用文·倡议书）
Every discarded wrapper tossed carelessly onto the street is a small betrayal of the environment, reminding us that the fight against pollution begins with the tiniest of daily choices. （议论文·环保）

wordForms.other: wrap v. 包，裹（wrap sth up 把…包起来；wrapped-wrapped，双写 p）；wrap n. 披肩、围巾；包裹食物的卷饼；wrapping n. 包装材料（wrapping paper 包装纸）；-er 后缀表'施动/工具'（wrap→wrapper 包装物, open→opener, contain→container）。

collocations.example: He dropped the sweet wrapper into the bin. 他把糖纸扔进了垃圾桶。

In the bottom of his old coat pocket he found a faded chocolate wrapper — the last, tiny relic of the childhood friend he had lost touch with years ago. （读后续写·回忆·友情）
Mountains of plastic wrappers now choke our rivers, a silent testimony to a throwaway culture that we can no longer afford to ignore. （议论文·污染）

collocations.translation: 包在鲜艳糖纸里的糖果

Please do not discard your wrappers on the trail; every scrap we carry out helps keep this mountain as pristine as we found it. （应用文·公告/须知）

synonyms.example: Excessive packaging not only wastes resources but also misleads consumers into paying for what they can neither eat nor use. （议论文·消费）

synonyms.example: She slipped a protective cover over the fragile book before tucking it safely into her bag. （应用文·说明）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·wrapper / wrap 搭配对照

advancedExpressions.example: She wrapped the present in bright paper, then noticed a stray sweet wrapper on the floor. 她用鲜艳的纸把礼物包好，随后发现地上有一张散落的糖纸。

advancedExpressions.expression: 动词加 -er 表'做…的人/物、工具'：wrap→wrapper 包装物、open→opener 开瓶器、contain→container 容器、cook→cooker 炊具、print→printer 打印机。注意 wrap 以'短元音+单辅音'结尾，加 -er/-ed/-ing 时双写 p：wrapper/wrapped/wrapping。

advancedExpressions.expression: a faded wrapper — the last relic of ...

original_sentence: Fill the dumpling wrappers with the mixture.

definitionEn:
(1) n. a combination of two or more substances or things that are mixed together
(2) n. the state of being mixed, or the process of mixing
(3) n. a combination of different qualities, feelings, styles, or elements

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （情感、性质等的）交织，掺杂（高考高频抽象义）
uncommonMeanings.example: As she read the final line of the letter, a strange mixture of relief and sorrow washed over her, and she could no longer tell whether the tears on her cheeks were of joy or of loss. （读后续写·情感·复杂心理）

posExamples.sentence: Watching her son walk onto the stage, the mother felt a mixture of pride and anxiety swell in her chest, her hands clasped so tightly that her knuckles turned white. （读后续写·亲情·矛盾心理）
I would suggest that participants first prepare the mixture of flour and water according to the instructions before attempting the more delicate steps of the workshop. （应用文·活动说明）
A truly harmonious society is a rich mixture of diverse voices, where differences are not merely tolerated but genuinely celebrated as a source of collective strength. （议论文·多元包容）

wordForms.other: mix (n. 混合物); mix-up (n. 混淆，误会)

collocations.phrase: a mixture of A and B

collocations.phrase: a mixture of A and B
collocations.example: His face wore a mixture of exhaustion and quiet triumph as he crossed the finish line, the last runner still standing after the fiercest storm of the season. （读后续写·体育·坚持）

With mixed feelings, she closed the door of her childhood home for the last time, carrying away both the weight of memory and the promise of a new beginning. （读后续写·告别·成长）
The old market was a heady mixture of colour, sound and scent, where centuries of tradition breathed in every crowded lane. （读后续写·异域·感官）
Keep folding gently until you obtain an even mixture, for any lump left behind will spoil the smoothness of the finished cake. （应用文·说明文）
The city's architecture is a striking mixture of East and West, where ancient temple roofs stand shoulder to shoulder with gleaming glass towers. （议论文·文化融合）

synonyms.example: The novel is a masterful blend of humour and heartbreak, drawing the reader in from its very first page. （议论文·文学评论）

advancedExpressions.example: A mixture of relief and regret washed over her; she watched them leave with mixed feelings. 一种如释重负又夹带懊悔的复杂情绪涌上心头；她怀着复杂的心情看着他们离开。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'混合/结合'（辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: mixture（把不同成分混在一起，可随意，中性，也可指情感交织）/ blend（和谐融合、界限难分，偏褒）/ combination（有目的地组合成整体，界限清晰可分）/ medley（音乐、节目、色彩声音的集锦式混杂，愉悦丰富）。
advancedExpressions.example: The dish was not a careless mixture but a clever combination of flavours, blended into a seamless whole. 这道菜不是随意的混合，而是味道的巧妙组合，融为浑然一体。

advancedExpressions.example: Mix the dry and wet ingredients until the mixture is even; a good mix means no lumps and no mix-up in the order. 把干湿食材混合至均匀；混得好意味着没有结块，顺序也不会弄错。

Before the results came out, the whole class was on edge. 成绩公布前，全班都紧张不安。

collocations.phrase: have / gain the edge over sb
collocations.example: Hard training gave her the edge over her rivals. 刻苦训练让她比对手略胜一筹。
This lab is at the cutting edge of green technology. 这个实验室处于绿色科技的最前沿。
The cat edged closer to the warm fire. 那只猫慢慢向温暖的炉火挪近。

collocations.phrase: the edge of the table / cliff / forest

Mastering a second language can give job-seekers a genuine competitive edge in today's increasingly global market. （议论文·就业·语言）

collocations.phrase: the edge of a knife / blade
collocations.example: He tested the edge of the blade against his thumb, satisfied only when it was sharp enough to slice a falling leaf. （读后续写·细节·工匠）

collocations.phrase: on the edge of (tears / disaster / a breakthrough)

At the water's edge, an old fisherman cast his line into the golden dusk, utterly at peace with the passing day. （读后续写·宁静·意境）
Her calm under pressure gave her a crucial edge when the interview took an unexpected turn. （应用文·经验分享）

synonyms.example: A row of ancient willows marked the border between the two neighbouring farms. （读后续写·乡村·意境）
synonyms.usage: 指'分界线'或'区域的边界'，较正式；edge更常指'物体的外沿'，且能引申为'优势/刀刃'，border没有这些引申义

synonyms.example: Starting early gave the small company a lasting advantage in a market that would soon grow fiercely crowded. （议论文·先机）
synonyms.usage: 泛指'有利条件'，最普通；edge强调'微弱但关键的领先/一点点优势'，语气更生动、更口语化

synonyms.example: The last drop of tea trembled on the rim of the delicate porcelain cup. （读后续写·细节·静物）
synonyms.usage: 特指杯、盘、轮等圆形物体的'外圈边缘'；edge范围更广，可指任何物体的边、也可抽象化，rim不能表'优势'

advancedExpressions.expression: the edge of（边缘）｜have/gain the edge over（占优势）｜on edge（紧张）｜the cutting edge（前沿）｜edge forward（慢慢挪）
advancedExpressions.example: 同一个edge：名词'边缘/优势/刀刃'，动词'缓慢移动'，短语on edge'紧张'——一网打尽，写作时按语境切换。

advancedExpressions.expression: have the edge over sb ≈ have an advantage over sb ≈ be one step ahead of sb ≈ gain the upper hand over sb
advancedExpressions.example: Thorough preparation gave our team the edge over / an advantage over the others. edge比advantage更生动、更强调'微弱却关键'的领先。

advancedExpressions.expression: be on edge ≈ be nervous / anxious ≈ be on tenterhooks ≈ have one's nerves on edge
advancedExpressions.example: Waiting for the phone to ring, she was on edge all evening. 用on edge替换nervous，更地道生动。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·edge作动词表'缓慢移动'
advancedExpressions.expression: sb. edge + 方向副词/介词短语（forward / closer / along / out of ...）
advancedExpressions.example: He edged along the narrow ledge. edge作不及物动词，后接方向状语，一词传神地写出'小心翼翼、一点点地挪'。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. edged ... , every movement ... against ...
advancedExpressions.example: She edged forward inch by inch, every movement weighed against the groaning ice beneath her feet. （用edge的'缓慢移动'义配合细节，营造窒息般的紧张）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... will give us a real edge over ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am confident that our thorough rehearsal will give us a real edge over the other teams in Friday's competition. （发言稿中表达信心，edge比advantage更有感染力）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is what gives ... a lasting competitive edge
advancedExpressions.example: Ceaseless innovation, rather than sheer scale, is what gives a nation a lasting competitive edge in the global arena. （强调句突出'创新决定竞争力'）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He walked carefully along the narrow path on the mountain.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Heart pounding, he edged along the narrow mountain path, his back pressed flat against the cold rock face while a sheer drop yawned just beyond the toes of his boots. （读后续写·冒险·紧张）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: edged替换walked carefully，一词传神 + Heart pounding独立主格 + a sheer drop yawned拟人化环境描写渲染险境

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good preparation helps us win the competition.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is thorough, unglamorous preparation that ultimately hands us the winning edge, for talent may open the door, yet only diligence can carry us through it. （议论文·准备的价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that强调句 + winning edge具象化'胜算' + talent...yet diligence对比句式深化'努力胜于天赋'的论点

classPractice.question: Before the final exam, everyone in the class was ____ edge, jumping at the slightest noise.
classPractice.note: 固定短语be on edge=紧张不安；注意介词是on，不是in/at。

classPractice.question: The frightened kitten ____ (edge) slowly out from beneath the sofa toward the bowl of milk.
classPractice.note: edge作动词'缓慢移动'，此处为过去时叙述，用edged。

classPractice.question: 刻苦的训练使她比对手占据了优势。(edge)  Years of hard training ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ her rivals.
classPractice.note: give sb the edge over sb=使某人胜过某人；固定搭配edge over。

classPractice.question: 这所学校始终处于人工智能研究的最前沿。(cutting edge)
classPractice.answer: This school is always at / on the cutting edge of artificial intelligence research.

original_sentence: Don’t overfill the dumplings, or they will fall apart when you boil them.
readingExamples: Don’t overfill the dumplings, or they will fall apart when you boil them.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. separated by a distance or an interval in space or time
(2) adv. into separate pieces or parts
(3) adv. to or on one side; away from other people or things
(4) adj. (used after a noun) considered separately; distinct

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 相隔，相距（表时间或空间距离，常置于数量短语后）
uncommonMeanings.example: The two villages lie ten kilometres apart. 这两个村庄相距十公里。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使区别开来，使与众不同（set sb/sth apart）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was not her talent alone but her unshakeable kindness that set her apart from every other contestant on that glittering stage. （读后续写·品格·脱颖而出）

posExamples.sentence: Though an ocean now lay between them, and years had pulled their two lives apart, the promise they had whispered under the old oak tree still bound their hearts as one. （读后续写·离别·情谊）
I would advise everyone to stand at least one metre apart during the fire drill, so that the whole class can leave the building safely and without confusion. （应用文·安全须知）
When a community is torn apart by suspicion and blame, no amount of wealth or technology can restore the trust that once held it together. （议论文·信任·社会）

wordForms.other: apartness (n. 分离，隔离，较少用)；apartment (n. 公寓，美式，词源同'分隔的房间')；★易混辨析：apart(分开) ↔ a part of(……的一部分，反义)：apart是一个词=分开，a part是两个词=一部分，切勿混淆

idioms.example: Don't overfill the dumplings, or they will fall apart the moment they touch the boiling water. （应用文·食谱提醒）
The twins were so alike that even their own mother could scarcely tell them apart in the dim evening light. （读后续写·细节·亲情）

idioms.translation: 使……与众不同，使脱颖而出
idioms.example: What sets a great leader apart is not the loudness of the voice but the quiet steadiness of the heart. （议论文·领导力）
As a boy he would take every broken clock apart, spreading its tiny gears across the floor in a quest to understand how time itself was made. （读后续写·童年·好奇）
Though the two brothers were poles apart in temperament, adversity had a way of drawing them shoulder to shoulder. （读后续写·亲情·反差）
Apart from being a gifted musician, she devoted every free weekend to teaching orphaned children the joy of the piano. （应用文·人物介绍）

collocations.example: Don't overfill the dumplings, or they will fall apart when you boil them. 别把饺子馅放太多，否则煮的时候会破。（课文原句·食谱提醒）
Apart from English, she also speaks French. 除了英语，她还会说法语。
I can't tell the twins apart. 我分不清这对双胞胎。
He took the old clock apart to see how it worked. 他把旧钟拆开看它怎么运转。
Stand about one metre apart, please. 请大家相隔约一米站好。

collocations.translation: 使……与众不同，使脱颖而出
collocations.example: Her kindness sets her apart from the rest. 她的善良使她与众不同。
As the last thread of hope snapped, she felt her carefully built composure come apart at the seams. （读后续写·情感·崩溃）
War tore the once-peaceful village apart, scattering families to the four corners of a frightened world. （读后续写·战争·离散）
Over the years the two old friends slowly drifted apart, until a single unexpected letter rekindled everything they had almost let die. （读后续写·友情·重逢）
He chose to stand apart from the quarrelling crowd, believing that a cool head served far better than an angry tongue. （议论文·理性）
As their dreams pointed in opposite directions, the childhood companions could feel themselves quietly growing apart. （读后续写·成长·分离）

collocations.translation: 天差地别；截然不同的世界
collocations.example: The bustling city and her sleepy hometown were a world apart, yet both, she realised, had shaped the person she had become. （读后续写·身份·反思）
Under the crushing weight of exam pressure, his once-perfect routine began to come apart at the seams. （读后续写·压力·失控）
Arrange the seedlings evenly apart, for crowding will only rob each young plant of the light it needs to thrive. （应用文·说明文）

synonyms.example: The referee asked the two teams to warm up separately before the final match began. （应用文·活动安排）
synonyms.usage: 强调'各自单独地进行'某动作；apart更强调'空间或情感上的分离状态、相距'，二者角度不同

synonyms.example: She set her own worries aside and rushed to comfort the sobbing child. （读后续写·善良·无私）
synonyms.usage: 指'移到一边、搁置'，常用于set/put...aside；apart侧重'彼此分离、相隔'，不用于'搁置'之意

synonyms.translation: 分离，四分五裂（文学/正式）
synonyms.example: The mighty storm rent the ancient oak asunder in a single blinding flash. （读后续写·自然·震撼）
synonyms.usage: 极正式、偏文学的书面语，多与tear/rend连用；日常写作用apart即可，asunder用于渲染磅礴或古典氛围

advancedExpressions.expression: apart from（除了）｜tell ... apart（区分）｜take ... apart（拆开）｜set ... apart（使与众不同）｜fall/come apart（散架）｜drift/grow apart（疏远）
advancedExpressions.example: 一个apart，'分开'为核心义，向外辐射出'区分/拆开/疏远/崩溃/与众不同'一整族短语，考试高频。

advancedExpressions.expression: apart from ≈ except for ≈ besides ≈ in addition to（后两者表'除了……还有'的递加义）
advancedExpressions.example: Apart from being kind, she is also brave. 注意apart from兼有'除去(=except for)'和'除此之外还(=besides)'两义，靠语境判断。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·apart放数量短语之后
advancedExpressions.expression: 数量短语（two metres / ten years / an ocean）+ apart
advancedExpressions.example: They were born three years apart. 表'相隔'时，apart紧跟在表示距离/时间的数量短语之后，是固定语序。

advancedExpressions.expression: though ... lay between them, ... still bound their hearts as one
advancedExpressions.example: Though continents lay between them, the memory of that summer still bound their hearts as one. （用'空间相隔'反衬'情感相连'，续写抒情经典对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would advise everyone to stand ... apart, so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would advise everyone to stand a safe distance apart, so that the evacuation may proceed calmly and in perfect order. （安全须知中提出清晰、可执行的建议）

advancedExpressions.expression: what sets ... apart is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What sets a truly educated mind apart is not the sheer volume of facts it stores, but the wisdom with which it uses them. （'not...but...'辨析式论证，凸显本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They lived far away from each other but were still good friends.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though half a world now kept them apart, distance had done nothing to weaken the bond forged in their childhood; if anything, absence had only made each letter dearer than the last. （读后续写·友情·距离）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: kept them apart替换lived far away + 让步状语Though引导 + if anything, ...only...递进结构强化'距离反增情谊'的情感张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good person is different from others because of kindness.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What truly sets a person apart is seldom talent or fortune, but the quiet, unwavering kindness that shines brightest precisely when the world grows dark. （议论文·品格）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What...sets a person apart主语从句 + not...but...对比 + precisely when the world grows dark时间状语升华，凸显善良在逆境中的珍贵

classPractice.question: ____ ____ maths, Lucy is also good at physics and chemistry. (除……之外，还)
classPractice.note: apart from此处=besides表'除……之外还有'，句中有also提示是递加义。

classPractice.question: The twins look so alike that few people can ____ them ____. (区分)
classPractice.note: tell ... apart=区分、分辨，宾语放在tell和apart中间。

classPractice.question: 正是她那份沉着冷静，使她在众多选手中脱颖而出。  It was her calmness that ____ ____ ____ from all the other contestants.
classPractice.note: set sb apart (from)=使某人与众不同/脱颖而出；It was...that强调句中动词用一般过去时set。

classPractice.question: The two houses stand about fifty metres ____ (apart / a part) from each other.
classPractice.note: 表'相隔'用一个词apart；a part(两个词)意为'一部分'，此处不通。

original_sentence: Angry and sad, Liang falls sick and dies.
readingExamples: Angry and sad, Liang falls sick and dies.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to break into pieces, usually because something is old or badly made
(2) phr. (of a system, organization, or relationship) to stop working effectively; to collapse or fail completely
(3) phr. to become unable to deal with your problems and control your emotions; to have a mental or emotional breakdown
(4) phr. (of a plan, argument, or story) to be shown to have no coherence when examined

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (人在压力下)精神崩溃，情绪失控
uncommonMeanings.example: For weeks she had held everything together with a brittle smile, but the moment the hospital doors closed behind her, she simply fell apart, sliding down the corridor wall until she was sitting on the cold floor, sobbing. （读后续写·情感崩溃·压抑后的释放）

posExamples.sentence: As the storm hammered the fragile shelter through the night, the boards began to fall apart one by one, and by dawn the children were huddled beneath nothing but the pale, indifferent sky. （读后续写·灾难求生·环境崩塌）

I am writing to express my deep concern that, without adequate volunteers, the community reading programme we cherish so dearly may soon fall apart, depriving hundreds of children of their only window to the wider world. （应用文·倡议信·呼吁支持）

History teaches us that no civilisation, however mighty, is immune to decline: once its shared values fall apart, even the grandest empire crumbles from within long before any enemy breaches its gates. （议论文·文明兴衰·内因论证）
When their long friendship began to fall apart over a trivial misunderstanding, Tom finally realised how carelessly he had taken the one person who had always stood by him. （读后续写·友情裂痕·悔悟）

idioms.translation: (计划/组织/人)彻底垮掉，从里到外崩溃
idioms.example: By the final act of the play, the ambitious student production was falling apart at the seams — actors forgot their lines, the curtain jammed, and yet the audience, sensing their courage, rose to applaud the sheer heart of it. （读后续写·校园表演·失败中的温情）

collocations.example: The old chair finally fell apart when he sat on it. 那把旧椅子在他坐下时终于散架了。
A good leader won't fall apart under pressure. 优秀的领导者不会在压力下崩溃。
When the plan failed, everything fell apart. 计划失败后，一切都乱套了。
Their friendship began to fall apart over a small quarrel. 他们的友谊因一次小争吵开始破裂。
As funding dried up, the once-thriving charity slowly fell apart at the seams, its offices emptied and its promises left unfulfilled. （应用文·报道·组织衰败）
Their marriage did not fall apart overnight; it dissolved slowly, in a thousand unspoken words and unshared silences. （读后续写·婚姻破裂·细节渲染）
The ancient letter, yellowed and brittle, threatened to fall apart in her trembling hands as she unfolded her grandmother's final words. （读后续写·遗物·细腻画面）
It is agonising to watch a dream you have nurtured for years fall apart, yet it is precisely in such ruins that resilience is forged. （议论文·逆境成长·哲理）

collocations.phrase: hold sth together / stop sth (from) falling apart
collocations.example: Throughout the crisis, it was the old teacher's quiet steadiness that held the frightened class together and stopped the whole trip from falling apart. （读后续写·危机领导·人物光辉）

synonyms.example: Without the support of its members, the club soon collapsed, leaving behind only fond memories and an empty room. （应用文·社团·衰落）
synonyms.usage: 更书面、更突然、更彻底，多指系统/建筑/身体一次性坍塌；fall apart 更口语化，强调逐步散架的过程

synonyms.example: As mutual trust vanished, the negotiating team gradually disintegrated into rival camps. （议论文·合作破裂·正式）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面词，强调整体裂解为碎块，常用于组织/物质；比 fall apart 更学术、更冷静客观

synonyms.translation: (机器)出故障；(人)情绪崩溃；(谈判)失败
synonyms.example: Halfway through her speech she broke down in tears, unable to finish the tribute to her late mentor. （读后续写·情感崩溃·演讲）
synonyms.usage: 指机器故障或谈判/关系中途失败，也指情绪崩溃；与 fall apart 的‘精神崩溃’义高度重合，但 break down 更强调‘某一刻失灵/失控’

synonyms.example: One by one, his excuses crumbled under the lawyer's relentless questioning. （议论文·论辩·比喻）
synonyms.usage: 本义指(石/土)碎裂剥落，引申指逐渐、由外向内地瓦解；比 fall apart 更有‘一点点剥落’的画面感

advancedExpressions.expression: 实物散架（the chair fell apart）｜组织/关系瓦解（the team/marriage fell apart）｜精神崩溃（she fell apart）｜计划垮掉（the plan fell apart）
advancedExpressions.example: 同一个fall apart，从'具体的散架'到'抽象的崩溃'层层递进，写作时可一词多用，画面感强。

advancedExpressions.expression: fall apart ≈ break down（机器故障/情绪崩溃）≈ collapse（突然彻底垮）≈ disintegrate（正式·解体）≈ crumble（一点点剥落）≈ go to pieces（情绪垮掉）
advancedExpressions.example: Under stress she almost fell apart / went to pieces. fall apart偏口语、强调'逐步散架'的过程。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·fall apart的过去式与语态
advancedExpressions.expression: fall-fell-fallen apart；不及物短语动词，无被动语态，主语即散架/崩溃者
advancedExpressions.example: The empire had fallen apart long before the enemy arrived. 用现在完成/过去完成表'已崩溃'；不可说 be fallen apart 的被动。

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment ..., sb. simply fell apart, + 分词伴随描写崩溃细节
advancedExpressions.example: The moment she saw the empty stable, she simply fell apart, sinking to her knees in the muddy straw where her beloved horse had once stood. （the moment 引导时间状语 + 崩溃后连续动作特写，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: without ..., the ... we cherish may soon fall apart
advancedExpressions.example: Without the wholehearted commitment of every member, the volunteer network we cherish may soon fall apart. （without 引导条件 + we cherish 定语从句注入情感，倡议信呼吁段）

advancedExpressions.expression: once ... fall apart, even ... crumbles from within
advancedExpressions.example: Once shared trust and common purpose fall apart, even the most gifted team crumbles from within long before external rivals can defeat it. （once 引导条件 + from within 强调内因 + 时间状语对比，论证由内而外的崩塌逻辑）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Their friendship fell apart.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Their friendship did not fall apart with a single crash; it came undone thread by thread, until one day they looked up and found that the closeness they had once taken for granted had quietly slipped through their fingers like sand. （读后续写·友情破裂·细节+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not ... with a single crash 否定强调渐变 + thread by thread 渐进意象 + like sand 明喻收尾 + slip through one's fingers 惯用搭配升级

sentenceUpgrade.original: If we don't help, the project will fail.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that, unless we act now and act together, this meaningful project — the fruit of countless hours of devotion — will inevitably fall apart, and with it, the hopes of every child who has come to depend on it. （应用文·倡议信·正式呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + unless 双重 act 排比 + 破折号插入语补充情感分量 + and with it 追加后果升华

classPractice.question: Don't overfill the dumplings, or they will ____ ____ when you boil them. (散架)
classPractice.note: fall apart表'（因做工/太满而）散架、破碎'，此处指饺子煮破。

classPractice.question: By the time help arrived, the old bridge had already ____ (fall) apart in the flood.
classPractice.note: fall-fell-fallen；had already后接过去分词fallen表'早已散架'。

classPractice.question: Under such pressure, many people would break down.  → Under such pressure, many people would ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 此处break down（情绪崩溃）≈ fall apart（精神崩溃），两者可互换。

classPractice.question: 如果我们现在不行动，这个我们珍视的项目很快就会垮掉。(fall apart)
classPractice.answer: If we don't act now, the project (that / which) we cherish will soon fall apart.
classPractice.note: fall apart表抽象的'（项目/组织）垮掉、瓦解'；条件句主句用will。
